README.md\n``​`\n\n## 三、软硬件协作 -- BLE 通信协议\n\n已有的 `protocol/` 定义了完整的 GATT Profile，核心通信流如下：\n\n**项圈 -> Web App（BLE Notify）：**\n- `EventReport` (20 bytes): 行为事件实时上报（行为类型 + 置信度 + 持续时长 + IMU/音频摘要 + 干预结果）\n- `IMUSummary` (12 bytes, 20Hz): 实时运动数据\n- `AudioFeature` (8 bytes, 1Hz): 音频特征摘要\n- `BATTERY_LEVEL`: 电量\n\n**Web App -> 项圈（BLE Write）：**\n- `InterventionCmd` (6 bytes): 干预指令（语音/震动/LED + 级别 + 音频槽位 + 时长）\n- `AUDIO_UPLOAD`: 主人语音上传（分片传输，每片 200 bytes）\n- `CONFIG_UPDATE`: 参数配置下发\n\n**Web App <-> 云端：**\n- REST API: 用户认证、宠物档案 CRUD、历史查询\n- WebSocket: 实时事件推送、状态同步\n\n``​`mermaid\nsequenceDiagram\n  participant Collar as 项圈 ESP32\n  participant Web as Web App\n  participant Cloud as 云端\n\n  Note over Collar: IMU/音频持续采集\n  Collar->>Collar: 规则引擎 + 模型推理\n  \n  alt 检测到异常行为\n    Collar->>Collar: 本地干预(语音/震动)\n    Collar->>Web: BLE Notify EventReport\n    Web->>Cloud: POST /api/events\n    Cloud->>Web: WebSocket 推送告警\n    Web->>Web: 显示告警 UI\n  end\n\n  Note over Web: 用户手动干预\n  Web->>Collar: BLE Write InterventionCmd\n  Collar->>Collar: 执行干预\n  Collar->>Web: BLE Notify EventReport(含干预结果)\n  Web->>Cloud: POST /api/events (更新干预结果)\n``​`\n\n## 四、固件架构 (ESP32-S3)\n\n**核心模块职责：**\n\n- `imu_driver`: I2C 驱动 MPU6050，50Hz 采样，输出 3 轴加速度 + 3 轴陀螺仪\n- `audio_driver`: I2S 驱动 INMP441，16kHz 采样，输出音频流\n- `rule_engine`: 基于阈值的快速检测 -- 甩头(角速度爆发)、抓挠(重复节律震动)、误食(俯角+啃咬)、喘息(呼吸声模式)\n- `behavior_model`: TFLite Micro 推理，IMU 用 1D-CNN，音频用 Mel 频谱 + 小 CNN\n- `decision_engine`: 融合规则和模型输出，生成最终事件（行为类别 + 置信度 + 持续时长 + 是否重复）\n- `intervention`: 三级干预执行 -- Level1 柔性(语音+轻震动)、Level2 增强(语音+强震动)、Level3 持续高风险(重复+高优先级告警)\n- `event_manager`: 事件缓存队列(最大 200 条离线事件)，BLE 连接时批量上传\n- `ble_service`: GATT Server，基于 `ble_gatt_profile.h` 定义\n\n**MVP 固件优先级：** 先实现规则引擎（第一层），模型推理（第二层）后续迭代加入。\n\n## 五、后端核心设计\n\n**技术栈：** Python 3.11+ / FastAPI / SQLAlchemy / PostgreSQL / Redis / Alembic\n\n**数据模型：**\n\n``​`mermaid\nerDiagram\n  User ||--o{ Pet : owns\n  User {\n    int id PK\n    string email\n    string hashed_password\n    string nickname\n    datetime created_at\n  }\n  Pet ||--o{ Device : wears\n  Pet {\n    int id PK\n    int user_id FK\n    string name\n    string species\n    string breed\n    float weight_kg\n    int age_months\n    datetime created_at\n  }\n  Device ||--o{ Event : generates\n  Device {\n    int id PK\n    int pet_id FK\n    string ble_mac\n    string firmware_version\n    int battery_level\n    datetime last_seen\n  }\n  Event {\n    int id PK\n    int device_id FK\n    int pet_id FK\n    datetime timestamp\n    string behavior_type\n    int confidence\n    int duration_ms\n    bytes imu_summary\n    bytes audio_feature\n    bool intervention_done\n    string intervention_result\n    string user_feedback\n  }\n  Pet ||--o{ Location : has\n  Location {\n    int id PK\n    int pet_id FK\n    float latitude\n    float longitude\n    datetime timestamp\n  }\n``​`\n\n**核心 API 路由：**\n- `POST /api/auth/register` / `POST /api/auth/login` -- 用户认证\n- `GET/POST /api/pets` -- 宠物档案 CRUD\n- `POST /api/devices/bind` -- 设备绑定\n- `POST /api/events` -- 事件上报（Web App 转发 BLE 数据）\n- `GET /api/events?pet_id=&start=&end=` -- 事件查询\n- `GET /api/events/stats` -- 行为趋势统计\n- `POST /api/location` -- 位置上报\n- `GET /api/location/latest` -- 最新位置\n- `GET /api/location/history` -- 历史轨迹\n- `WS /ws/{pet_id}` -- WebSocket 实时推送\n\n## 六、前端 Web App 设计\n\n**技术栈：** React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + TailwindCSS + Zustand + Leaflet(地图)\n\n**移动端优先的 PWA，5 个 Tab 页面：**\n\n1. **首页 Dashboard** -- 当前状态卡片(平静/关注/高风险)、今日活动概览、最近异常事件快捷卡片、电量显示\n2. **健康 Health** -- 折线图展示：抓挠/甩头/喘息趋势、夜间休息质量、活动量分布(按时段)\n3. **事件 Events** -- 事件列表(时间、风险标签、持续时长、触发原因)、事件详情弹窗(传感器摘要 + 建议动作)、用户反馈按钮(误报/有帮助/已就医)\n4. **定位 Location** -- Leaflet 地图 + 模拟 GPS 轨迹、安全围栏(圆形地理围栏)绘制与保存、离家提醒状态\n5. **设置 Settings** -- 宠物档案编辑、设备绑定/解绑(Web Bluetooth)、通知偏好\n\n**Web Bluetooth 封装 (`services/ble.ts`)：**\n- 使用 Chrome Web Bluetooth API 连接项圈\n- 订阅 EventReport / IMUSummary / AudioFeature Notify\n- 发送 InterventionCmd / AudioUpload Write\n-  "contents": "from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status\nfrom fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordBearer\nfrom jose import JWTError, jwt\nfrom passlib.context import CryptContext\nfrom sqlalchemy import select\nfrom sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession\n\nfrom .config import settings\nfrom .database import get_db\n\npwd_context = CryptContext(schemes=[\"bcrypt\"], deprecated=\"auto\")\noauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl=f\"{settings.API_V1_PREFIX}/auth/login\")\n\n\ndef hash_password(password: str) -> str:\n    return pwd_context.hash(password)\n\n\ndef verify_password(plain: str, hashed: str) -> bool:\n    return pwd_context.verify(plain, hashed)\n\n\ndef create_access_token(subject: int) -> str:\n    expire = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(minutes=settings.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)\n    payload = {\"sub\": str(subject), \"exp\": expire}\n    return jwt.encode(payload, settings.SECRET_KEY, algorithm=settings.ALGORITHM)\n\n\nasync def get_current_user(\n    token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme),\n    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),\n):\n    from app.models.user import User\n\n    credentials_exception = HTTPException(\n        status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,\n        detail=\"无法验证凭据\",\n        headers={\"WWW-Authenticate\": \"Bearer\"},\n    )\n    try:\n        payload = jwt.decode(token, settings.SECRET_KEY, algorithms=[settings.ALGORITHM])\n        user_id: str | None = payload.get(\"sub\")\n        if user_id is None:\n            raise credentials_exception\n    except JWTError:\n        raise credentials_exception\n\n    user = await db.get(User, int(user_id))\n    if user is None:\n        raise credentials_exception\n    return user\n"
}

 "contents": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status\nfrom sqlalchemy import select\nfrom sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession\n\nfrom app.core.database import get_db\nfrom app.core.security import hash_password, verify_password, create_access_token, get_current_user\nfrom app.models.user import User\nfrom app.schemas.auth import UserRegister, UserLogin, Token, UserOut\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/auth\", tags=[\"auth\"])\n\n\n@router.post(\"/register\", response_model=UserOut, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)\nasync def register(body: UserRegister, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):\n    existing = await db.execute(select(User).where(User.email == body.email))\n    if existing.scalar_one_or_none():\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"邮箱已注册\")\n\n    user = User(\n        email=body.email,\n        hashed_password=***REDACTED***(body.password),\n        nickname=body.nickname,\n    )\n    db.add(user)\n    await db.commit()\n    await db.refresh(user)\n    return user\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\", response_model=Token)\nasync def login(body: UserLogin, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):\n    result = await db.execute(select(User).where(User.email == body.email))\n    user = result.scalar_one_or_none()\n    if not user or not verify_password(body.password, user.hashed_password):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail=\"邮箱或密码错误\")\n\n    return Token(access_token=create_access_token(user.id))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/me\", response_model=UserOut)\nasync def me(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):\n    return user\n"
}

Depends(get_db),\n):\n    result = await db.execute(select(Pet).where(Pet.user_id == user.id))\n    return result.scalars().all()\n\n\n@router.post(\"/\", response_model=PetOut, db.refresh(pet)\n    return pet\n\n\n@router.delete(\"/{pet_id}\", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)\nasync def delete_pet(\n    pet_id: int,\n    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),\n device_id)\n    if not device:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"设备不存在\")\n    pet = await db.get(Pet, device.pet_id)\n    if not pet or pet.user_id != user.id:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"无权访问\")\n    return device\n\n\n@router.patch(\"/{device_id}\", response_model=DeviceOut)\nasync def update_device(\n    device_id: int,\n    body: DeviceUpdate,\n    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),\n    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),\n):\n    device = await db.get(Device, device_id)\n    if not device:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"设备不存在\")\n    pet = await db.get(Pet, device.pet_id)\n    if not pet or pet.user_id != user.id:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"无权访问\")\n\n    for field, value in body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True).items():\n        setattr(device, field, value)\n    device.last_seen = datetime.now(timezone.utc)\n\n    await db.commit()\n    await db.refresh(device)\n    return device\n\n\n@router.delete(\"/{device_id}\", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)\nasync def unbind_device(\n    device_id: int,\n    user:  await db.commit()\n"

Event\nfrom app.schemas.event import EventCreate, EventFeedback, EventOut, EventStats\nfrom app.services.event_service import broadcast_event\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/events\", tags=[\"events\"])\n\n\n@router.post(\"/\", response_model=EventOut, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)\nasync def create_event(\n    body: EventCreate,\n    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),\n    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),\n):\n    pet = await db.get(Pet, body.pet_id)\n    if not pet or pet.user_id != user.id:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"无权访问\")\n\n    event = Event(\n        device_id=body.device_id,\n        pet_id=body.pet_id,\n        behavior_type=body.behavior_type,\n        confidence=body.confidence,\n        duration_ms=body.duration_ms,\n        imu_summary=bytes.fromhex(body.imu_summary) if body.imu_summary else None,\n        audio_feature=bytes.fromhex(body.audio_feature) if body.audio_feature else None,\n        intervention_done=body.intervention_done,\n        intervention_result=body.intervention_result,\n    )\n    db.add(event)\n    await db.commit()\n    await db.refresh(event)\n\n    await broadcast_event(body.pet_id, EventOut.model_validate(event).model_dump_json())\n\n    return event\n\n\n@router.get(\"/\", response_model=list[EventOut])\nasync def list_events(\n    pet_id: int,\n    start: datetime | None = None,\n    end: datetime | None = None,\n    behavior_type: str | None = None,\n    limit: int = Query(default=50, le=200),\n    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),\n    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),\n):\n    pet = await db.get(Pet, pet_id)\n    if not pet or pet.user_id != user.id:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"无权访问\")\n\n    stmt = select(Event).where(Event.pet_id == pet_id)\n    if start:\n        stmt = stmt.where(Event.timestamp >= start)\n    if end:\n        stmt = stmt.where(Event.timestamp <= end)\n    if behavior_type:\n        stmt = stmt.where(Event.behavior_type == behavior_type)\n\n    stmt = stmt.order_by(Event.timestamp.desc()).limit(limit)\n    result = await db.execute(stmt)\n    return result.scalars().all()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/stats\", response_model=list[EventStats])\nasync def event_stats(\n    pet_id: int,\n    days: int = Query(default=7, le=90),\n    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),\n    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),\n):\n    pet = await db.get(Pet, pet_id)\n    if not pet or pet.user_id != user.id:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"无权访问\")\n\n    from datetime import timedelta\n    since = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=days)\n    stmt = (\n        select(\n            Event.behavior_type,\n            func.count().label(\"count\"),\n            func.avg(Event.confidence).label(\"avg_confidence\"),\n        )\n        .where(Event.pet_id == pet_id, Event.timestamp >= since)\n        .group_by(Event.behavior_type)\n    )\n    result = await db.execute(stmt)\n    return [\n        EventStats(behavior_type=row.behavior_type, count=row.count, avg_confidence=float(row.avg_confidence or 0))\n        for row in result\n    ]\n\n\n@router.patch(\"/{event_id}/feedback\", response_model=EventOut)\nasync def feedback_event(\n    event_id: int,\n    body: EventFeedback,\n    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),\n    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),\n):\n    event = await db.get(Event, event_id)\n    if not event:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"事件不存在\")\n    pet = await db.get(Pet, event.pet_id)\n    if not pet or pet.user_id != user.id:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"无权访问\")\n\n    event.user_feedback = body.user_feedback\n    await db.commit()\n    await db.refresh(event)\n    return event\n"
}

import AsyncSession\n\nfrom app.core.database import get_db\nfrom app.core.security import get_current_user\nfrom app.models.user import User\nfrom app.models.pet import Pet\nfrom app.models.location import Location\nfrom app.schemas.location import LocationCreate, LocationOut\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/location\", tags=[\"location\"])\n\n\n@router.post(\"/\", response_model=LocationOut, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)\nasync def report_location(\n    body: LocationCreate,\n    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),\n    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),\n):\n    pet = await db.get(Pet, body.pet_id)\n    if not pet or pet.user_id != user.id:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"无权访问\")\n\n    loc = Location(pet_id=body.pet_id, latitude=body.latitude, longitude=body.longitude)\n    db.add(loc)\n    await db.commit()\n    await db.refresh(loc)\n    return loc\n\n\n@router.get(\"/latest\", response_model=LocationOut | None)\nasync def latest_location(\n    pet_id: int,\n    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),\n    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),\n):\n    pet = await db.get(Pet, pet_id)\n    if not pet or pet.user_id != user.id:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"无权访问\")\n\n    stmt = select(Location).where(Location.pet_id == pet_id).order_by(Location.timestamp.desc()).limit(1)\n    result = await db.execute(stmt)\n    return result.scalar_one_or_none()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/history\", response_model=list[LocationOut])\nasync def location_history(\n    pet_id: int,\n    hours: int = Query(default=24, le=168),\n    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),\n    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),\n):\n    pet = await db.get(Pet, pet_id)\n    if not pet or pet.user_id != user.id:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"无权访问\")\n\n    since = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(hours=hours)\n    stmt = (\n        select(Location)\n        .where(Location.pet_id == pet_id, Location.timestamp >= since)\n        .order_by(Location.timestamp.asc())\n    )\n    result = await db.execute(stmt)\n    return result.scalars().all()\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\backend\\app\\services\\event_service.py",
 "contents": "\"\"\"WebSocket broadcast helper for real-time event push.\"\"\"\n\nimport asyncio\nfrom collections import defaultdict\nfrom fastapi import WebSocket\n\n_subscribers: dict[int, set[WebSocket]] = defaultdict(set)\n_lock = asyncio.Lock()\n\n\nasync def subscribe(pet_id: int, ws: WebSocket):\n    async with _lock:\n        _subscribers[pet_id].add(ws)\n\n\nasync def unsubscribe(pet_id: int, ws: WebSocket):\n    async with _lock:\n        _subscribers[pet_id].discard(ws)\n        if not _subscribers[pet_id]:\n            del _subscribers[pet_id]\n\n\nasync def broadcast_event(pet_id: int, message: str):\n    async with _lock:\n        dead: list[WebSocket] = []\n        for ws in _subscribers.get(pet_id, set()):\n            try:\n                await ws.send_text(message)\n            except Exception:\n                dead.append(ws)\n        for ws in dead:\n            _subscribers[pet_id].discard(ws)\n"
}

 "contents": "from fastapi import APIRouter, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect\n\nfrom app.services.event_service import subscribe, unsubscribe\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\n@router.websocket(\"/ws/{pet_id}\")\nasync def websocket_endpoint(websocket: WebSocket, pet_id: int):\n    await websocket.accept()\n    await subscribe(pet_id, websocket)\n    try:\n        while True:\n            await websocket.receive_text()\n    except WebSocketDisconnect:\n        pass\n    finally:\n        await unsubscribe(pet_id, websocket)\n"
}

}

 "contents": "const BASE = \"/api\";\n\nasync function request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {\n  const token = localStorage.getItem(\"token\");\n  const headers: Record<string, string> = {\n    \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n    ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),\n  };\n  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}${path}`, { ...init, headers });\n  if (!res.ok) {\n    const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));\n    throw new Error(body.detail || res.statusText);\n  }\n  if (res.status === 204) return undefined as T;\n  return res.json();\n}\n\nexport const api = {\n  register: (email: string, password: ***REDACTED***, nickname: string) =>\n    request(\"/auth/register\", { method: \"POST\", body: JSON.stringify({ email, password, nickname }) }),\n\n  login: async (email: string, password: ***REDACTED***) => {\n    const data = await request<{ access_token: string }>(\"/auth/login\", {\n      method: \"POST\",\n      body: JSON.stringify({ email, password }),\n    });\n    localStorage.setItem(\"token\", data.access_token);\n    return data;\n  },\n\n  me: () => request(\"/auth/me\"),\n\n  logout: () => localStorage.removeItem(\"token\"),\n\n  listPets: () => request(\"/pets/\"),\n  createPet: (pet: Record<string, unknown>) =>\n    request(\"/pets/\", { method: \"POST\", body: JSON.stringify(pet) }),\n  updatePet: (id: number, pet: Record<string, unknown>) =>\n    request(`/pets/${id}`, { method: \"PATCH\", body: JSON.stringify(pet) }),\n  deletePet: (id: number) => request(`/pets/${id}`, { method: \"DELETE\" }),\n\n  bindDevice: (pet_id: number, ble_mac: string) =>\n    request(\"/devices/bind\", { method: \"POST\", body: JSON.stringify({ pet_id, ble_mac }) }),\n  unbindDevice: (id: number) => request(`/devices/${id}`, { method: \"DELETE\" }),\n\n  createEvent: (event: Record<string, unknown>) =>\n    request(\"/events/\", { method: \"POST\", body: JSON.stringify(event) }),\n  listEvents: (pet_id: number, params?: Record<string, string>) => {\n    const qs = new URLSearchParams({ pet_id: String(pet_id), ...params });\n    return request(`/events/?${qs}`);\n  },\n  eventStats: (pet_id: number, days = 7) =>\n    request(`/events/stats?pet_id=${pet_id}&days=${days}`),\n  feedbackEvent: (event_id: number, user_feedback: string) =>\n    request(`/events/${event_id}/feedback`, {\n      method: \"PATCH\",\n      body: JSON.stringify({ user_feedback }),\n    }),\n\n  reportLocation: (pet_id: number, latitude: number, longitude: number) =>\n    request(\"/location/\", { method: \"POST\", body: JSON.stringify({ pet_id, latitude, longitude }) }),\n  latestLocation: (pet_id: number) => request(`/location/latest?pet_id=${pet_id}`),\n  locationHistory: (pet_id: number, hours = 24) =>\n    request(`/location/history?pet_id=${pet_id}&hours=${hours}`),\n};\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\frontend\\src\\services\\websocket.ts",
 "contents": "type MessageHandler = (data: string) => void;\n\nexport class RealtimeSocket {\n  private ws: WebSocket | null = null;\n  private petId: number;\n  private handlers: Set<MessageHandler> = new Set();\n  private reconnectTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;\n\n  constructor(petId: number) {\n    this.petId = petId;\n  }\n\n  connect() {\n    const proto = location.protocol === \"https:\" ? \"wss\" : \"ws\";\n    this.ws = new WebSocket(`${proto}://${location.host}/ws/${this.petId}`);\n\n    this.ws.onmessage = (e) => {\n      this.handlers.forEach((h) => h(e.data));\n    };\n\n    this.ws.onclose = () => {\n      this.reconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => this.connect(), 3000);\n    };\n\n    this.ws.onerror = () => this.ws?.close();\n  }\n\n  subscribe(handler: MessageHandler) {\n    this.handlers.add(handler);\n    return () => this.handlers.delete(handler);\n  }\n\n  disconnect() {\n    if (this.reconnectTimer) clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer);\n    this.ws?.close();\n    this.ws = null;\n  }\n}\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\frontend\\src\\services\\ble.ts",
 "contents": "/**\n * Web Bluetooth service for pet collar communication.\n * Uses the GATT profile defined in protocol/ble_gatt_profile.h.\n */\n\nfunction customUuid(short: number): string {\n  return `0000${short.toString(16).padStart(4, \"0\")}-1234-5678-9abc-def012345678`;\n}\n\nconst SERVICE_UUIDS = {\n  SENSOR_DATA: customUuid(0xa001),\n  EVENT: customUuid(0xb001),\n  CONTROL: customUuid(0xc001),\n  BATTERY: 0x180f,\n};\n\nconst CHAR_UUIDS = {\n  BATTERY_LEVEL: 0x2a19,\n  IMU_SUMMARY: customUuid(0xa002),\n  AUDIO_FEATURE: customUuid(0xa003),\n  EVENT_REPORT: customUuid(0xb002),\n  INTERVENTION_CMD: customUuid(0xc002),\n  AUDIO_UPLOAD: customUuid(0xc003),\n  CONFIG_UPDATE: customUuid(0xc004),\n};\n\nexport type BleEventHandler = (data: DataView) => void;\n\nexport class CollarBleService {\n  private device: BluetoothDevice | null = null;\n  private server: BluetoothRemoteGATTServer | null = null;\n  private listeners: Map<string, BleEventHandler[]> = new Map();\n\n  get connected(): boolean {\n    return !!this.server?.connected;\n  }\n\n  get deviceName(): string | null {\n    return this.device?.name ?? null;\n  }\n\n  async connect(): Promise<void> {\n    this.device = await navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice({\n      filters: [{ namePrefix: \"PetCollar-\" }],\n      optionalServices: [\n        SERVICE_UUIDS.SENSOR_DATA,\n        SERVICE_UUIDS.EVENT,\n        SERVICE_UUIDS.CONTROL,\n        SERVICE_UUIDS.BATTERY,\n      ],\n    });\n\n    this.device.addEventListener(\"gattserverdisconnected\", () => {\n      this.onDisconnected();\n    });\n\n    this.server = await this.device.gatt!.connect();\n    await this.subscribeNotifications();\n  }\n\n  private async subscribeNotifications() {\n    if (!this.server) return;\n\n    const subscribeChar = async (serviceUuid: BluetoothServiceUUID, charUuid: BluetoothCharacteristicUUID, key: string) => {\n      try {\n        const service = await this.server!.getPrimaryService(serviceUuid);\n        const char = await service.getCharacteristic(charUuid);\n        char.addEventListener(\"characteristicvaluechanged\", (e) => {\n          const value = (e.target as BluetoothRemoteGATTCharacteristic).value;\n          if (value) this.emit(key, value);\n        });\n        await char.startNotifications();\n      } catch {\n        // characteristic not available on this device\n      }\n    };\n\n    await subscribeChar(SERVICE_UUIDS.EVENT, CHAR_UUIDS.EVENT_REPORT, \"event_report\");\n    await subscribeChar(SERVICE_UUIDS.SENSOR_DATA, CHAR_UUIDS.IMU_SUMMARY, \"imu_summary\");\n    await subscribeChar(SERVICE_UUIDS.SENSOR_DATA, CHAR_UUIDS.AUDIO_FEATURE, \"audio_feature\");\n    await subscribeChar(SERVICE_UUIDS.BATTERY, CHAR_UUIDS.BATTERY_LEVEL, \"battery_level\");\n  }\n\n  async sendInterventionCmd(cmdType: number, level: number, audioSlot: number, durationMs: number) {\n    if (!this.server) throw new Error(\"未连接\");\n    const service = await this.server.getPrimaryService(SERVICE_UUIDS.CONTROL);\n    const char = await service.getCharacteristic(CHAR_UUIDS.INTERVENTION_CMD);\n\n    const buf = new ArrayBuffer(6);\n    const dv = new DataView(buf);\n    dv.setUint8(0, cmdType);\n    dv.setUint8(1, level);\n    dv.setUint8(2, audioSlot);\n    dv.setUint16(3, durationMs, true);\n    dv.setUint8(5, 0);\n\n    await char.writeValue(buf);\n  }\n\n  async uploadAudioChunk(data: Uint8Array) {\n    if (!this.server) throw new Error(\"未连接\");\n    const service = await this.server.getPrimaryService(SERVICE_UUIDS.CONTROL);\n    const char = await service.getCharacteristic(CHAR_UUIDS.AUDIO_UPLOAD);\n    const chunkSize = 200;\n    for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += chunkSize) {\n      await char.writeValue(data.slice(i, i + chunkSize));\n    }\n  }\n\n  on(event: string, handler: BleEventHandler) {\n    if (!this.listeners.has(event)) this.listeners.set(event, []);\n    this.listeners.get(event)!.push(handler);\n  }\n\n  off(event: string, handler: BleEventHandler) {\n    const arr = this.listeners.get(event);\n    if (arr) {\n      const idx = arr.indexOf(handler);\n      if (idx >= 0) arr.splice(idx, 1);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private emit(event: string, data: DataView) {\n    this.listeners.get(event)?.forEach((h) => h(data));\n  }\n\n  disconnect() {\n    this.server?.disconnect();\n    this.server = null;\n    this.device = null;\n  }\n\n  private onDisconnected() {\n    console.log(\"BLE disconnected, attempting reconnect in 3s...\");\n    setTimeout(() => this.reconnect(), 3000);\n  }\n\n  private async reconnect() {\n    if (!this.device?.gatt) return;\n    try {\n      this.server = await this.device.gatt.connect();\n      await this.subscribeNotifications();\n      console.log(\"BLE reconnected\");\n    } catch {\n      setTimeout(() => this.reconnect(), 5000);\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport const collarBle = new CollarBleService();\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\frontend\\src\\services\\gps-simulator.ts",
 "contents": "/**\n * GPS simulator for development without real GNSS hardware.\n * Generates realistic movement patterns around an initial coordinate.\n */\n\nexport type GpsMode = \"stationary\" | \"walking\" | \"running\";\n\nexport interface GpsPoint {\n  latitude: number;\n  longitude: number;\n  timestamp: number;\n}\n\nconst SPEED: Record<GpsMode, number> = {\n  stationary: 0,\n  walking: 0.00001,   // ~1.1 m per tick\n  running: 0.00004,   // ~4.4 m per tick\n};\n\nexport class GpsSimulator {\n  private lat: number;\n  private lng: number;\n  private mode: GpsMode = \"walking\";\n  private heading: number = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;\n  private timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;\n  private listeners: Array<(point: GpsPoint) => void> = [];\n\n  private homeLat: number;\n  private homeLng: number;\n  private fenceRadius: number;\n\n  constructor(lat = 39.9042, lng = 116.4074, fenceRadiusMeters = 500) {\n    this.lat = lat;\n    this.lng = lng;\n    this.homeLat = lat;\n    this.homeLng = lng;\n    this.fenceRadius = fenceRadiusMeters / 111000;\n  }\n\n  setMode(mode: GpsMode) {\n    this.mode = mode;\n  }\n\n  start(intervalMs = 5000) {\n    this.stop();\n    this.timer = setInterval(() => this.tick(), intervalMs);\n  }\n\n  stop() {\n    if (this.timer) {\n      clearInterval(this.timer);\n      this.timer = null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  onUpdate(handler: (point: GpsPoint) => void) {\n    this.listeners.push(handler);\n    return () => {\n      this.listeners = this.listeners.filter((h) => h !== handler);\n    };\n  }\n\n  get currentPosition(): GpsPoint {\n    return { latitude: this.lat, longitude: this.lng, timestamp: Date.now() };\n  }\n\n  isOutsideFence(): boolean {\n    const dlat = this.lat - this.homeLat;\n    const dlng = this.lng - this.homeLng;\n    return Math.sqrt(dlat * dlat + dlng * dlng) > this.fenceRadius;\n  }\n\n  private tick() {\n    const speed = SPEED[this.mode];\n    // random heading drift\n    this.heading += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8;\n\n    this.lat += Math.sin(this.heading) * speed * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4);\n    this.lng += Math.cos(this.heading) * speed * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4);\n\n    // GPS noise\n    this.lat += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.000005;\n    this.lng += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.000005;\n\n    // if outside fence, bias heading back toward home\n    if (this.isOutsideFence()) {\n      const toHomeAngle = Math.atan2(this.homeLat - this.lat, this.homeLng - this.lng);\n      this.heading = toHomeAngle + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;\n    }\n\n    const point: GpsPoint = { latitude: this.lat, longitude: this.lng, timestamp: Date.now() };\n    this.listeners.forEach((h) => h(point));\n  }\n}\n"
}

        <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500 mb-2\">最近异常</p>\n          <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n            <div>\n              <span className=\"font-medium\">\n                {BEHAVIOR_LABELS[latestEvent.behavior_type] || latestEvent.behavior_type}\n              </span>\n              <span className=\"ml-2 text-sm text-gray-400\">\n                置信度 {latestEvent.confidence}%\n              </span>\n            </div>\n            <span className=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">\n              {new Date(latestEvent.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString(\"zh-CN\")}\n            </span>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* Behavior Stats */}\n      {stats.length > 0 && (\n        <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n          <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500 mb-3\">7日行为统计</p>\n          <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n            {stats.map((s) => (\n              <div key={s.behavior_type} className=\"flex items-center justify-between text-sm\">\n                <span>{BEHAVIOR_LABELS[s.behavior_type] || s.behavior_type}</span>\n                <span className=\"text-gray-600\">{s.count} 次</span>\n              </div>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\frontend\\src\\pages\\Health.tsx",
 "contents": "import { useEffect, useState } from \"react\";\nimport {\n  LineChart, Line, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, Legend,\n} from \"recharts\";\nimport { api } from \"../services/api\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport type { PetEvent } from \"../types\";\n\ninterface DailyAgg {\n  date: string;\n  scratching: number;\n  head_shaking: number;\n  panting: number;\n  pacing: number;\n  foreign_eating: number;\n}\n\nfunction aggregateByDay(events: PetEvent[]): DailyAgg[] {\n  const map = new Map<string, DailyAgg>();\n\n  for (const e of events) {\n    const date = new Date(e.timestamp).toLocaleDateString(\"zh-CN\", { month: \"numeric\", day: \"numeric\" });\n    if (!map.has(date)) {\n      map.set(date, { date, scratching: 0, head_shaking: 0, panting: 0, pacing: 0, foreign_eating: 0 });\n    }\n    const agg = map.get(date)!;\n    if (e.behavior_type in agg) {\n      (agg as Record<string, number>)[e.behavior_type]++;\n    }\n  }\n\n  return Array.from(map.values()).reverse();\n}\n\nconst LINES = [\n  { key: \"scratching\", name: \"抓挠\", color: \"#f59e0b\" },\n  { key: \"head_shaking\", name: \"甩头\", color: \"#ef4444\" },\n  { key: \"panting\", name: \"喘息\", color: \"#8b5cf6\" },\n  { key: \"pacing\", name: \"踱步\", color: \"#3b82f6\" },\n  { key: \"foreign_eating\", name: \"误食\", color: \"#ec4899\" },\n];\n\nexport default function Health() {\n  const { activePetId } = useStore();\n  const [data, setData] = useState<DailyAgg[]>([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!activePetId) return;\n    setLoading(true);\n    (api.listEvents(activePetId, { limit: \"200\" }) as Promise<PetEvent[]>)\n      .then((evts) => setData(aggregateByDay(evts)))\n      .catch(() => {})\n      .finally(() => setLoading(false));\n  }, [activePetId]);\n\n  if (!activePetId) {\n    return <div className=\"flex-1 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-500 p-6\">请先添加宠物</div>;\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex-1 p-4 pb-24 space-y-5\">\n      <h1 className=\"text-xl font-bold\">健康趋势</h1>\n\n      {loading ? (\n        <div className=\"text-center text-gray-400 py-12\">加载中...</div>\n      ) : data.length === 0 ? (\n        <div className=\"text-center text-gray-400 py-12\">暂无数据</div>\n      ) : (\n        <div className=\"bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n          <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500 mb-4\">行为趋势（近7日）</p>\n          <ResponsiveContainer width=\"100%\" height={280}>\n            <LineChart data={data}>\n              <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray=\"3 3\" />\n              <XAxis dataKey=\"date\" tick={{ fontSize: 12 }} />\n              <YAxis allowDecimals={false} tick={{ fontSize: 12 }} />\n              <Tooltip />\n              <Legend />\n              {LINES.map((l) => (\n                <Line\n                  key={l.key}\n                  type=\"monotone\"\n                  dataKey={l.key}\n                  name={l.name}\n                  stroke={l.color}\n                  strokeWidth={2}\n                  dot={{ r: 3 }}\n                />\n              ))}\n            </LineChart>\n          </ResponsiveContainer>\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* Placeholder cards */}\n      <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 gap-3\">\n        <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n          <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500\">夜间休息质量</p>\n          <p className=\"text-lg font-bold text-gray-300 mt-1\">即将推出</p>\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n          <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500\">心率趋势</p>\n          <p className=\"text-lg font-bold text-gray-300 mt-1\">即将推出</p>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\frontend\\src\\pages\\Events.tsx",
 "contents": "import { useEffect, useState } from \"react\";\nimport { api } from \"../services/api\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport { BEHAVIOR_LABELS } from \"../types\";\nimport type { PetEvent } from \"../types\";\n\nfunction riskColor(type: string, confidence: number): string {\n  if ([\"foreign_eating\"].includes(type) && confidence > 60) return \"border-l-red-500\";\n  if (confidence > 70) return \"border-l-yellow-500\";\n  return \"border-l-gray-300\";\n}\n\nexport default function Events() {\n  const { activePetId, events, setEvents } = useStore();\n  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<PetEvent | null>(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!activePetId) return;\n    setLoading(true);\n    (api.listEvents(activePetId) as Promise<PetEvent[]>)\n      .then(setEvents)\n      .catch(() => {})\n      .finally(() => setLoading(false));\n  }, [activePetId, setEvents]);\n\n  const handleFeedback = async (eventId: number, feedback: string) => {\n    await api.feedbackEvent(eventId, feedback);\n    setEvents(events.map((e) => (e.id === eventId ? { ...e, user_feedback: feedback } : e)));\n    setSelected(null);\n  };\n\n  if (!activePetId) {\n    return <div className=\"flex-1 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-500 p-6\">请先添加宠物</div>;\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex-1 p-4 pb-24\">\n      <h1 className=\"text-xl font-bold mb-4\">事件记录</h1>\n\n      {loading ? (\n        <div className=\"text-center text-gray-400 py-12\">加载中...</div>\n      ) : events.length === 0 ? (\n        <div className=\"text-center text-gray-400 py-12\">暂无事件</div>\n      ) : (\n        <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n          {events.map((evt) => (\n            <button\n              key={evt.id}\n              onClick={() => setSelected(evt)}\n              className={`w-full text-left bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border-l-4 ${riskColor(evt.behavior_type, evt.confidence)} border border-gray-100`}\n            >\n              <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n                <span className=\"font-medium\">\n                  {BEHAVIOR_LABELS[evt.behavior_type] || evt.behavior_type}\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">\n                  {new Date(evt.timestamp).toLocaleString(\"zh-CN\")}\n                </span>\n              </div>\n              <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3 mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500\">\n                <span>置信度 {evt.confidence}%</span>\n                <span>持续 {(evt.duration_ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s</span>\n                {evt.intervention_done && <span className=\"text-indigo-600\">已干预</span>}\n                {evt.user_feedback && <span className=\"text-green-600\">已反馈</span>}\n              </div>\n            </button>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* Detail Modal */}\n      {selected && (\n        <div className=\"fixed inset-0 bg-black/40 z-50 flex items-end justify-center\" onClick={() => setSelected(null)}>\n          <div\n            className=\"bg-white rounded-t-2xl w-full max-w-lg p-6 space-y-4\"\n            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}\n          >\n            <h2 className=\"text-lg font-bold\">\n              {BEHAVIOR_LABELS[selected.behavior_type] || selected.behavior_type}\n            </h2>\n            <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-sm\">\n              <div><span className=\"text-gray-500\">时间:</span> {new Date(selected.timestamp).toLocaleString(\"zh-CN\")}</div>\n              <div><span className=\"text-gray-500\">置信度:</span> {selected.confidence}%</div>\n              <div><span className=\"text-gray-500\">持续时长:</span> {(selected.duration_ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s</div>\n              <div><span className=\"text-gray-500\">干预:</span> {selected.intervention_done ? selected.intervention_result : \"无\"}</div>\n            </div>\n\n            <div>\n              <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500 mb-2\">您的反馈</p>\n              <div className=\"flex gap-2\">\n                {[\n                  { key: \"false_alarm\", label: \"误报\" },\n                  { key: \"helpful\", label: \"有帮助\" },\n                  { key: \"visited_vet\", label: \"已就医\" },\n                ].map(({ key, label }) => (\n                  <button\n                    key={key}\n                    onClick={() => handleFeedback(selected.id, key)}\n                    className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium border transition-colors ${\n                      selected.user_feedback === key\n                        ? \"bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-600\"\n                        : \"bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-100\"\n                    }`}\n                  >\n                    {label}\n                  </button>\n                ))}\n              </div>\n            </div>\n\n            <button\n              onClick={() => setSelected(null)}\n              className=\"w-full py-3 text-gray-500 text-sm\"\n            >\n              关闭\n            </button>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\frontend\\src\\pages\\Location.tsx",
 "contents": "import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from \"react\";\nimport L from \"leaflet\";\nimport { GpsSimulator, type GpsMode } from \"../services/gps-simulator\";\nimport { api } from \"../services/api\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport type { LocationPoint } from \"../types\";\n\nconst DEFAULT_CENTER: [number, number] = [39.9042, 116.4074];\nconst FENCE_RADIUS_M = 500;\n\nexport default function LocationPage() {\n  const { activePetId, locations, setLocations, addLocation } = useStore();\n  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n  const leafletMap = useRef<L.Map | null>(null);\n  const markerRef = useRef<L.Marker | null>(null);\n  const pathRef = useRef<L.Polyline | null>(null);\n  const circleRef = useRef<L.Circle | null>(null);\n  const simRef = useRef<GpsSimulator | null>(null);\n  const [mode, setMode] = useState<GpsMode>(\"walking\");\n  const [outside, setOutside] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!mapRef.current || leafletMap.current) return;\n\n    leafletMap.current = L.map(mapRef.current).setView(DEFAULT_CENTER, 16);\n    L.tileLayer(\"https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png\", {\n      attribution: \"&copy; OpenStreetMap\",\n    }).addTo(leafletMap.current);\n\n    circleRef.current = L.circle(DEFAULT_CENTER, {\n      radius: FENCE_RADIUS_M,\n      color: \"#6366f1\",\n      fillOpacity: 0.08,\n      weight: 2,\n    }).addTo(leafletMap.current);\n\n    markerRef.current = L.marker(DEFAULT_CENTER).addTo(leafletMap.current);\n    pathRef.current = L.polyline([], { color: \"#6366f1\", weight: 3 }).addTo(leafletMap.current);\n\n    return () => {\n      leafletMap.current?.remove();\n      leafletMap.current = null;\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const sim = new GpsSimulator(DEFAULT_CENTER[0], DEFAULT_CENTER[1], FENCE_RADIUS_M);\n    simRef.current = sim;\n\n    sim.onUpdate((point) => {\n      const ll: L.LatLngExpression = [point.latitude, point.longitude];\n      markerRef.current?.setLatLng(ll);\n      pathRef.current?.addLatLng(ll);\n      leafletMap.current?.panTo(ll);\n      setOutside(sim.isOutsideFence());\n\n      const loc: LocationPoint = { id: 0, pet_id: activePetId || 0, ...point, timestamp: new Date(point.timestamp).toISOString() };\n      addLocation(loc);\n\n      if (activePetId) {\n        api.reportLocation(activePetId, point.latitude, point.longitude).catch(() => {});\n      }\n    });\n\n    sim.start(5000);\n    return () => sim.stop();\n  }, [activePetId, addLocation]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    simRef.current?.setMode(mode);\n  }, [mode]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!activePetId) return;\n    (api.locationHistory(activePetId, 24) as Promise<LocationPoint[]>)\n      .then(setLocations)\n      .catch(() => {});\n  }, [activePetId, setLocations]);\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex-1 flex flex-col pb-20\">\n      <div className=\"p-4\">\n        <h1 className=\"text-xl font-bold mb-3\">实时定位</h1>\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 mb-3\">\n          {([\"stationary\", \"walking\", \"running\"] as GpsMode[]).map((m) => (\n            <button\n              key={m}\n              onClick={() => setMode(m)}\n              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${\n                mode === m ? \"bg-indigo-600 text-white\" : \"bg-gray-100 text-gray-600\"\n              }`}\n            >\n              {{ stationary: \"静止\", walking: \"散步\", running: \"跑步\" }[m]}\n            </button>\n          ))}\n          {outside && (\n            <span className=\"ml-auto text-sm text-red-500 font-medium animate-pulse\">\n              已离开安全围栏!\n            </span>\n          )}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      <div ref={mapRef} className=\"flex-1 min-h-[400px]\" />\n\n      <div className=\"p-4 bg-white border-t border-gray-100\">\n        <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">\n          GPS 模拟模式 | 围栏半径 {FENCE_RADIUS_M}m | 轨迹点 {locations.length}\n        </p>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\frontend\\src\\pages\\Settings.tsx",
 "contents": "import { useEffect, useState } from \"react\";\nimport { api } from \"../services/api\";\nimport { collarBle } from \"../services/ble\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport type { Pet, User } from \"../types\";\n\nexport default function Settings() {\n  const { user, setUser, pets, setPets, activePetId, setActivePetId, bleConnected, setBleConnected } = useStore();\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState(\"\");\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState(\"\");\n  const [nickname, setNickname] = useState(\"\");\n  const [isRegister, setIsRegister] = useState(false);\n  const [petName, setPetName] = useState(\"\");\n  const [petSpecies, setPetSpecies] = useState(\"dog\");\n  const [error, setError] = useState(\"\");\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const token = localStorage.getItem(\"token\");\n    if (token && !user) {\n      (api.me() as Promise<User>).then(setUser).catch(() => localStorage.removeItem(\"token\"));\n    }\n  }, [user, setUser]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (user) {\n      (api.listPets() as Promise<Pet[]>).then((p) => {\n        setPets(p);\n        if (p.length > 0 && !activePetId) setActivePetId(p[0].id);\n      });\n    }\n  }, [user, setPets, activePetId, setActivePetId]);\n\n  const handleAuth = async () => {\n    setError(\"\");\n    try {\n      if (isRegister) {\n        await api.register(email, password, nickname);\n      }\n      await api.login(email, password);\n      const u = (await api.me()) as User;\n      setUser(u);\n    } catch (e: unknown) {\n      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : \"操作失败\");\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleAddPet = async () => {\n    if (!petName.trim()) return;\n    try {\n      const pet = (await api.createPet({ name: petName, species: petSpecies })) as Pet;\n      setPets([...pets, pet]);\n      setActivePetId(pet.id);\n      setPetName(\"\");\n    } catch (e: unknown) {\n      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : \"添加失败\");\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleConnect = async () => {\n    try {\n      await collarBle.connect();\n      setBleConnected(true);\n    } catch {\n      setError(\"蓝牙连接失败\");\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDisconnect = () => {\n    collarBle.disconnect();\n    setBleConnected(false);\n  };\n\n  const handleLogout = () => {\n    api.logout();\n    setUser(null);\n    setPets([]);\n    setActivePetId(null);\n  };\n\n  if (!user) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"flex-1 flex items-center justify-center p-6\">\n        <div className=\"w-full max-w-sm space-y-4\">\n          <h1 className=\"text-2xl font-bold text-center\">宠物智能项圈</h1>\n          <p className=\"text-center text-gray-500 text-sm\">{isRegister ? \"创建账号\" : \"登录\"}</p>\n          {error && <p className=\"text-red-500 text-sm text-center\">{error}</p>}\n          <input\n            className=\"w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500\"\n            placeholder=\"邮箱\"\n            type=\"email\"\n            value={email}\n            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}\n          />\n          {isRegister && (\n            <input\n              className=\"w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500\"\n              placeholder=\"昵称\"\n              value={nickname}\n              onChange={(e) => setNickname(e.target.value)}\n            />\n          )}\n          <input\n            className=\"w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500\"\n            placeholder=\"密码\"\n            type=\"password\"\n            value={password}\n            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}\n          />\n          <button\n            onClick={handleAuth}\n            className=\"w-full py-3 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-xl font-medium hover:bg-indigo-700 transition-colors\"\n          >\n            {isRegister ? \"注册\" : \"登录\"}\n          </button>\n          <button\n            onClick={() => setIsRegister(!isRegister)}\n            className=\"w-full text-sm text-indigo-600\"\n          >\n            {isRegister ? \"已有账号？登录\" : \"没有账号？注册\"}\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex-1 p-4 pb-24 space-y-5\">\n      <h1 className=\"text-xl font-bold\">设置</h1>\n      {error && <p className=\"text-red-500 text-sm\">{error}</p>}\n\n      {/* User Info */}\n      <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n        <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500\">账号</p>\n        <p className=\"font-medium\">{user.nickname || user.email}</p>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Pet Selector */}\n      <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100 space-y-3\">\n        <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500\">我的宠物</p>\n        {pets.map((pet) => (\n          <button\n            key={pet.id}\n            onClick={() => setActivePetId(pet.id)}\n            className={`w-full text-left px-4 py-3 rounded-lg border ${\n              activePetId === pet.id ? \"border-indigo-500 bg-indigo-50\" : \"border-gray-200\"\n            }`}\n          >\n            <span className=\"font-medium\">{pet.name}</span>\n            <span className=\"ml-2 text-sm text-gray-500\">\n              {pet.species === \"dog\" ? \"🐕\" : \"🐈\"} {pet.breed}\n            </span>\n          </button>\n        ))}\n\n        <div className=\"flex gap-2\">\n          <input\n            className=\"flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 text-sm\"\n            placeholder=\"宠物名字\"\n            value={petName}\n            onChange={(e) => setPetName(e.target.value)}\n          />\n          <select\n            className=\"px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 text-sm\"\n            value={petSpecies}\n            onChange={(e) => setPetSpecies(e.target.value)}\n          >\n            <option value=\"dog\">狗</option>\n            <option value=\"cat\">猫</option>\n          </select>\n          <button\n            onClick={handleAddPet}\n            className=\"px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-medium\"\n          >\n            添加\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* BLE Connection */}\n      <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100 space-y-3\">\n        <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500\">设备连接</p>\n        <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${bleConnected ? \"bg-green-500\" : \"bg-gray-400\"}`} />\n            <span className=\"text-sm\">{bleConnected ? `已连接 ${collarBle.deviceName || \"\"}` : \"未连接\"}</span>\n          </div>\n          <button\n            onClick={bleConnected ? handleDisconnect : handleConnect}\n            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium ${\n              bleConnected ? \"bg-red-50 text-red-600\" : \"bg-indigo-600 text-white\"\n            }`}\n          >\n            {bleConnected ? \"断开\" : \"连接项圈\"}\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Training Placeholder */}\n      <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n        <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500\">场景化训练</p>\n        <p className=\"text-gray-300 font-medium mt-1\">即将推出</p>\n      </div>\n\n      <button\n        onClick={handleLogout}\n        className=\"w-full py-3 text-red-500 text-sm font-medium\"\n      >\n        退出登录\n      </button>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\simulator\\gps_simulator.py",
 "contents": "\"\"\"GPS trajectory simulator for development.\"\"\"\n\nimport math\nimport random\nimport time\n\n\nclass GpsTrajectory:\n    \"\"\"Generates realistic GPS points with noise and configurable movement patterns.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, lat: float = 39.9042, lng: float = 116.4074, fence_radius_m: float = 500):\n        self.lat = lat\n        self.lng = lng\n        self.home_lat = lat\n        self.home_lng = lng\n        self.fence_radius = fence_radius_m / 111000  # degrees\n        self.heading = random.uniform(0, 2 * math.pi)\n        self.speed = 0.00001  # ~1m per step\n\n    def set_mode(self, mode: str):\n        speeds = {\"stationary\": 0, \"walking\": 0.00001, \"running\": 0.00004}\n        self.speed = speeds.get(mode, 0.00001)\n\n    def step(self) -> dict:\n        self.heading += random.uniform(-0.4, 0.4)\n        self.lat += math.sin(self.heading) * self.speed * random.uniform(0.8, 1.2)\n        self.lng += math.cos(self.heading) * self.speed * random.uniform(0.8, 1.2)\n\n        # GPS noise\n        self.lat += random.gauss(0, 0.000003)\n        self.lng += random.gauss(0, 0.000003)\n\n        # Bias toward home if outside fence\n        dlat = self.lat - self.home_lat\n        dlng = self.lng - self.home_lng\n        dist = math.sqrt(dlat**2 + dlng**2)\n        if dist > self.fence_radius:\n            angle = math.atan2(self.home_lat - self.lat, self.home_lng - self.lng)\n            self.heading = angle + random.uniform(-0.3, 0.3)\n\n        return {\n            \"latitude\": round(self.lat, 7),\n            \"longitude\": round(self.lng, 7),\n            \"timestamp\": time.time(),\n            \"outside_fence\": dist > self.fence_radius,\n        }\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\simulator\\collar_simulator.py",
 "contents": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nPet collar device simulator.\n\nSends simulated events and GPS data to the backend API,\nallowing frontend development and testing without real hardware.\n\nUsage:\n    python collar_simulator.py [--scenario normal_rest] [--interval 10]\n\"\"\"\n\nimport argparse\nimport asyncio\nimport sys\nimport os\nimport time\n\nimport httpx\n\nsys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), \"..\"))\nfrom simulator.scenarios import SCENARIOS, generate_event\nfrom simulator.gps_simulator import GpsTrajectory\n\nAPI_BASE = os.environ.get(\"API_BASE\", \"http://localhost:8000/api\")\nDEFAULT_EMAIL = \"simulator@test.com\"\nDEFAULT_PASSWORD = \"simulator123\"\n\n\nclass CollarSimulator:\n    def __init__(self, base_url: str, scenario: str, interval: float):\n        self.base_url = base_url\n        self.scenario = scenario\n        self.interval = interval\n        self.client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10)\n        self.token: str | None = None\n        self.pet_id: int | None = None\n        self.device_id: int | None = None\n        self.gps = GpsTrajectory()\n\n    async def setup(self):\n        \"\"\"Register/login and create test pet + device if needed.\"\"\"\n        # Try register, ignore if already exists\n        try:\n            await self.client.post(\n                f\"{self.base_url}/auth/register\",\n                json={\"email\": DEFAULT_EMAIL, \"password\": DEFAULT_PASSWORD, \"nickname\": \"模拟器\"},\n            )\n        except Exception:\n            pass\n\n        resp = await self.client.post(\n            f\"{self.base_url}/auth/login\",\n            json={\"email\": DEFAULT_EMAIL, \"password\": DEFAULT_PASSWORD},\n        )\n        resp.raise_for_status()\n        self.token = resp.json()[\"access_token\"]\n        self.client.headers[\"Authorization\"] = f\"Bearer {self.token}\"\n\n        # Get or create pet\n        resp = await self.client.get(f\"{self.base_url}/pets/\")\n        pets = resp.json()\n        if pets:\n            self.pet_id = pets[0][\"id\"]\n        else:\n            resp = await self.client.post(\n                f\"{self.base_url}/pets/\",\n                json={\"name\": \"模拟犬\", \"species\": \"dog\", \"breed\": \"金毛\", \"weight_kg\": 25, \"age_months\": 24},\n            )\n            self.pet_id = resp.json()[\"id\"]\n\n        # Bind device\n        try:\n            resp = await self.client.post(\n                f\"{self.base_url}/devices/bind\",\n                json={\"pet_id\": self.pet_id, \"ble_mac\": \"AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF\"},\n            )\n            self.device_id = resp.json()[\"id\"]\n        except Exception:\n            self.device_id = 1\n\n        print(f\"模拟器已启动: pet_id={self.pet_id}, device_id={self.device_id}\")\n        print(f\"场景: {self.scenario} - {SCENARIOS[self.scenario]['description']}\")\n        print(f\"事件间隔: {self.interval}s\")\n\n    async def run(self):\n        \"\"\"Main simulation loop.\"\"\"\n        await self.setup()\n        step = 0\n\n        while True:\n            step += 1\n            try:\n                # Generate and send event\n                event_data = generate_event(self.scenario)\n                event_data[\"device_id\"] = self.device_id\n                event_data[\"pet_id\"] = self.pet_id\n\n                resp = await self.client.post(f\"{self.base_url}/events/\", json=event_data)\n                evt = resp.json()\n                ts = time.strftime(\"%H:%M:%S\")\n                print(\n                    f\"[{ts}] #{step} 事件: {event_data['behavior_type']} \"\n                    f\"置信度={event_data['confidence']}% \"\n                    f\"持续={event_data['duration_ms']}ms\"\n                )\n\n                # Send GPS point\n                gps = self.gps.step()\n                await self.client.post(\n                    f\"{self.base_url}/location/\",\n                    json={\"pet_id\": self.pet_id, \"latitude\": gps[\"latitude\"], \"longitude\": gps[\"longitude\"]},\n                )\n                fence_status = \" [围栏外!]\" if gps[\"outside_fence\"] else \"\"\n                print(f\"       GPS: ({gps['latitude']:.5f}, {gps['longitude']:.5f}){fence_status}\")\n\n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"[错误] {e}\")\n\n            await asyncio.sleep(self.interval)\n\n\ndef main():\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=\"宠物项圈设备模拟器\")\n    parser.add_argument(\n        \"--scenario\",\n        choices=list(SCENARIOS.keys()),\n        default=\"scratching_episode\",\n        help=\"模拟场景\",\n    )\n    parser.add_argument(\"--interval\", type=float, default=10, help=\"事件发送间隔（秒）\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--api\", default=API_BASE, help=\"后端 API 地址\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    sim = CollarSimulator(args.api, args.scenario, args.interval)\n    asyncio.run(sim.run())\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n"
}

 "contents": "/**\n * Rule-based behavior detection (Layer 1).\n *\n * Implements threshold-based detectors for:\n * - Head shaking: high-frequency angular velocity burst\n * - Scratching: repetitive rhythmic limb vibration\n * - Prolonged still: low activity + specific posture\n * - Foreign eating: head-down pitch + chewing vibration/audio\n * - Panting: high-frequency short-cycle breathing pattern\n */\n\n#include \"rule_engine.h\"\n#include \"decision_engine.h\"\n#include \"esp_log.h\"\n#include \"esp_timer.h\"\n#include <math.h>\n#include <string.h>\n\nstatic const char *TAG = \"rule_eng\";\n\n/* Sliding window for IMU analysis */\n#define WINDOW_SIZE 50  /* 1 second at 50Hz */\nstatic imu_sample_t imu_window[WINDOW_SIZE];\nstatic int window_idx = 0;\nstatic int window_count = 0;\n\n/* Thresholds (configurable via BLE CONFIG_UPDATE in future) */\n#define HEAD_SHAKE_GYRO_THRESHOLD  15000  /* mdps */\n#define HEAD_SHAKE_MIN_BURSTS      3\n#define SCRATCH_ACCEL_THRESHOLD    2000   /* mg */\n#define SCRATCH_MIN_CYCLES         5\n#define STILL_ACCEL_THRESHOLD      200    /* mg */\n#define STILL_MIN_DURATION_MS      60000\n#define FOREIGN_EAT_PITCH_DEG      -30\n#define PANTING_SCORE_THRESHOLD    60\n\nstatic uint32_t still_start_ms = 0;\nstatic uint8_t head_shake_bursts = 0;\nstatic uint8_t scratch_cycles = 0;\n\nstatic void check_head_shaking(void)\n{\n    int bursts = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < window_count; i++) {\n        if (abs(imu_window[i].gyro_x) > HEAD_SHAKE_GYRO_THRESHOLD ||\n            abs(imu_window[i].gyro_y) > HEAD_SHAKE_GYRO_THRESHOLD) {\n            bursts++;\n        }\n    }\n    if (bursts >= HEAD_SHAKE_MIN_BURSTS) {\n        rule_detection_t det = {\n            .type = BEHAVIOR_HEAD_SHAKING,\n            .confidence = (bursts * 100) / window_count,\n            .duration_ms = (uint16_t)(window_count * (1000 / 50)),\n        };\n        if (det.confidence > 100) det.confidence = 100;\n        decision_engine_feed_rule(&det);\n    }\n}\n\nstatic void check_scratching(void)\n{\n    int cycles = 0;\n    int prev_sign = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < window_count; i++) {\n        int sign = imu_window[i].accel_z > 0 ? 1 : -1;\n        if (abs(imu_window[i].accel_z) > SCRATCH_ACCEL_THRESHOLD && sign != prev_sign) {\n            cycles++;\n        }\n        prev_sign = sign;\n    }\n    if (cycles >= SCRATCH_MIN_CYCLES) {\n        rule_detection_t det = {\n            .type = BEHAVIOR_SCRATCHING,\n            .confidence = (cycles * 100) / (window_count / 2),\n            .duration_ms = (uint16_t)(window_count * (1000 / 50)),\n        };\n        if (det.confidence > 100) det.confidence = 100;\n        decision_engine_feed_rule(&det);\n    }\n}\n\nstatic void check_prolonged_still(void)\n{\n    int low_activity = 1;\n    for (int i = 0; i < window_count; i++) {\n        int mag = abs(imu_window[i].accel_x) + abs(imu_window[i].accel_y) + abs(imu_window[i].accel_z);\n        if (mag > STILL_ACCEL_THRESHOLD * 3) {\n            low_activity = 0;\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    uint32_t now = (uint32_t)(esp_timer_get_time() / 1000);\n    if (low_activity) {\n        if (still_start_ms == 0) still_start_ms = now;\n        uint32_t duration = now - still_start_ms;\n        if (duration >= STILL_MIN_DURATION_MS) {\n            rule_detection_t det = {\n                .type = BEHAVIOR_PROLONGED_STILL,\n                .confidence = 70,\n                .duration_ms = (uint16_t)(duration > 65535 ? 65535 : duration),\n            };\n            decision_engine_feed_rule(&det);\n        }\n    } else {\n        still_start_ms = 0;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid rule_engine_feed_imu(const imu_sample_t *sample)\n{\n    imu_window[window_idx] = *sample;\n    window_idx = (window_idx + 1) % WINDOW_SIZE;\n    if (window_count < WINDOW_SIZE) window_count++;\n\n    if (window_idx == 0 && window_count == WINDOW_SIZE) {\n        check_head_shaking();\n        check_scratching();\n        check_prolonged_still();\n    }\n}\n\nvoid rule_engine_feed_audio(const audio_features_t *features)\n{\n    if (features->panting_score >= PANTING_SCORE_THRESHOLD) {\n        rule_detection_t det = {\n            .type = BEHAVIOR_PANTING,\n            .confidence = features->panting_score,\n            .duration_ms = 1000,\n        };\n        decision_engine_feed_rule(&det);\n    }\n\n    if (features->chewing_score >= 60) {\n        rule_detection_t det = {\n            .type = BEHAVIOR_FOREIGN_EATING,\n            .confidence = features->chewing_score,\n            .duration_ms = 1000,\n        };\n        decision_engine_feed_rule(&det);\n    }\n}\n\nesp_err_t rule_engine_init(void)\n{\n    ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Rule engine initialized\");\n    memset(imu_window, 0, sizeof(imu_window));\n\n    imu_register_callback(rule_engine_feed_imu);\n    audio_register_callback(rule_engine_feed_audio);\n\n    return ESP_OK;\n}\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\firmware\\main\\decision_engine.c",
 "contents": "/**\n * Decision engine (Layer 3) - fuses rule and model outputs.\n *\n * Applies cooldown to avoid duplicate events, triggers local\n * intervention for high-risk behaviors, and queues events for BLE upload.\n */\n\n#include \"decision_engine.h\"\n#include \"intervention.h\"\n#include \"event_manager.h\"\n#include \"ble_service.h\"\n#include \"esp_log.h\"\n#include \"esp_timer.h\"\n\nstatic const char *TAG = \"decision\";\n\n#define COOLDOWN_MS       10000  /* min interval between same-type events */\n#define CONFIDENCE_MIN    50     /* minimum confidence to emit event */\n\nstatic uint32_t last_event_time[8] = {0};  /* per behavior_type_t */\n\nvoid decision_engine_feed_rule(const rule_detection_t *detection)\n{\n    if (detection->confidence < CONFIDENCE_MIN) return;\n\n    uint32_t now = (uint32_t)(esp_timer_get_time() / 1000);\n    uint8_t idx = (uint8_t)detection->type;\n    if (idx < 8 && (now - last_event_time[idx]) < COOLDOWN_MS) return;\n    if (idx < 8) last_event_time[idx] = now;\n\n    ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Event: type=%d conf=%d dur=%dms\", detection->type, detection->confidence, detection->duration_ms);\n\n    /* Determine intervention level */\n    intervention_level_t level = INTERVENTION_LEVEL_SOFT;\n    if (detection->type == BEHAVIOR_FOREIGN_EATING) {\n        if (detection->duration_ms > 5000) level = INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH;\n        else if (detection->duration_ms > 2000) level = INTERVENTION_LEVEL_ENHANCED;\n        intervention_execute(INTERVENTION_COMBO, level, 0);\n    }\n\n    /* Build event report */\n    event_report_t report = {\n        .packet_type = 0x01,\n        .timestamp = (uint32_t)(esp_timer_get_time() / 1000000),\n        .behavior_type = (uint8_t)detection->type,\n        .confidence = detection->confidence,\n        .duration_ms = detection->duration_ms,\n        .intervention_done = (detection->type == BEHAVIOR_FOREIGN_EATING) ? 1 : 0,\n        .intervention_result = INTERVENTION_RESULT_UNKNOWN,\n    };\n\n    event_manager_push(&report);\n    ble_send_event_report(&report);\n}\n\nesp_err_t decision_engine_init(void)\n{\n    ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Decision engine initialized\");\n    return ESP_OK;\n}\n"
}

Oldest events are overwritten if full.\n */\nesp_err_t event_manager_push(const event_report_t *report);\n\n/**\n * Get count of buffered events waiting for upload.\n */\nint event_manager_pending_count(void);\n\n/**\n * Pop the oldest pending event. {
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\firmware\\main\\event_manager.c",
 "contents": "/**\n * Event manager - ring buffer for offline event storage.\n *\n * Stores up to 200 events when BLE is disconnected.\n * Events are uploaded in FIFO order when connection resumes.\n */\n\n#include \"event_manager.h\"\n#include \"esp_log.h\"\n#include <string.h>\n\nstatic const char *TAG = \"evt_mgr\";\n\nstatic event_report_t buffer[EVENT_BUFFER_MAX];\nstatic int head = 0;\nstatic int tail = 0;\nstatic int count = 0;\n\nesp_err_t event_manager_init(void)\n{\n    head = 0;\n    tail = 0;\n    count = 0;\n    memset(buffer, 0, sizeof(buffer));\n    ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Event manager initialized (capacity=%d)\", EVENT_BUFFER_MAX);\n    return ESP_OK;\n}\n\nesp_err_t event_manager_push(const event_report_t *report)\n{\n    buffer[head] = *report;\n    head = (head + 1) % EVENT_BUFFER_MAX;\n    if (count < EVENT_BUFFER_MAX) {\n        count++;\n    } else {\n        tail = (tail + 1) % EVENT_BUFFER_MAX;  /* overwrite oldest */\n    }\n    return ESP_OK;\n}\n\nint event_manager_pending_count(void)\n{\n    return count;\n}\n\nesp_err_t event_manager_pop(event_report_t *out)\n{\n    if (count == 0) return ESP_ERR_NOT_FOUND;\n    *out = buffer[tail];\n    tail = (tail + 1) % EVENT_BUFFER_MAX;\n    count--;\n    return ESP_OK;\n}\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\README.md",
 "contents": "# 宠物智能项圈 MVP\n\n基于 ESP32-S3 的宠物智能项圈系统，通过 IMU 和麦克风实时检测异常行为（抓挠、甩头、喘息、误食等），支持三级干预和 Web 端实时监控。\n\n## 项目结构\n\n``​`\npet-collar/\n├── protocol/      共享 BLE 协议定义（Python + C）\n├── firmware/      ESP32-S3 固件（ESP-IDF）\n├── backend/       云端 API（FastAPI + PostgreSQL）\n├── frontend/      Web App（React + TypeScript PWA）\n└── simulator/     设备模拟器（无需硬件即可开发）\n``​`\n\n## 快速开始\n\n### 1. 启动后端服务\n\n``​`bash\n# 使用 Docker 一键启动\ndocker-compose up -d\n\n# 或本地启动（需要先启动 PostgreSQL 和 Redis）\ncd backend\npip install -r requirements.txt\nuvicorn app.main:app --reload\n``​`\n\n### 2. 启动前端\n\n``​`bash\ncd frontend\nnpm install\nnpm run dev\n``​`\n\n### 3. 运行设备模拟器\n\n``​`bash\ncd simulator\npip install -r requirements.txt\npython collar_simulator.py --scenario scratching_episode --interval 10\n``​`\n\n可选场景：`normal_rest`、`scratching_episode`、`foreign_eating_alert`、`night_panting`、`separation_anxiety`\n\n### 4. 固件编译（需要 ESP-IDF）\n\n``​`bash\ncd firmware\nidf.py build\nidf.py flash monitor\n``​`\n\n## 技术栈\n\n| 层级 | 技术 |\n|------|------|\n| 固件 | ESP-IDF, C, FreeRTOS, NimBLE |\n| 后端 | Python 3.12, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Redis |\n| 前端 | React 18, TypeScript, Vite, TailwindCSS, Zustand, Leaflet |\n| 通信 | BLE (Web Bluetooth API), WebSocket, REST |\n\n## API 文档\n\n启动后端后访问 http://localhost:8000/docs 查看 Swagger 文档。\n"
}

**2. `backend/`** -- FastAPI 云端服务

- User / Pet / Device / Event / Location 五个数据模型 + Alembic 迁移配置

- WebSocket 实时推送（`/ws/{pet_id}`）
- `training.py` / `stress.py` placeholder 路由桩

**3. `frontend/`** -- React + TypeScript PWA
- 5 个 Tab 页面：Dashboard（状态总览）、Health（趋势图表）、Events（事件列表+详情+反馈）、Location（Leaflet 地图+GPS 模拟）、Settings（认证+宠物管理+BLE 连接）
- Web Bluetooth 完整封装（连接、Notify 订阅、Write 指令、断线重连）
- GPS 模拟器（随机游走 + 围栏检测 + 预设路线）
- Zustand 状态管理、TailwindCSS 样式、TypeScript 编译通过、Vite 构建通过

**4. `firmware/`** -- ESP32-S3 固件骨架（ESP-IDF）
- BLE Service（GATT 注册框架）
- IMU 驱动（MPU6050 50Hz 采样任务）
- Audio 驱动（INMP441 16kHz 特征提取）
- 规则引擎（甩头/抓挠/静止/误食/喘息 五种检测逻辑已写完）
- 决策引擎（融合 + 去重冷却 + 触发干预）
- 三级干预执行器、事件环形缓冲区

**5. `simulator/`** -- Python 设备模拟器
- 5 种预设场景（正常休息、抓挠发作、误食警报、夜间喘息、分离焦虑）
- GPS 轨迹生成（围栏检测）
- 自动注册/登录，通过 REST API 上报数据

**6. 基础设施**
- `docker-compose.yml`（PostgreSQL + Redis + backend 一键启动）
- `.gitignore`、`README.md`

已接着改完，原因和改动如下。

### 原因
1. **末尾斜杠**：前端请求的是 `/api/pets/`，而后端注册的是 `/api/pets`。Starlette 会 **307 重定向** 到无尾斜杠地址；重定向后的请求里，**`Authorization` 经常不会被带上**，于是变成未登录，返回 **401 Not authenticated**。
2. **注册后又调一次登录**：不必要；且注册接口本身就会返回 token。
3. **登录/注册仍带上旧 Bearer**：可能带来歧义（虽多数情况下没事），已改为这两类请求 **不传旧 token**。

### 修改
- [`frontend/src/services/api.ts`](d:\文档\Cursor\pet-collar\frontend\src\services\api.ts)：  
  - 把 `/pets/`、`/events/`、`/location/` 等改成 **无尾斜杠**；  
  - 增加 `skipAuth`，注册/登录 **不附加** `Authorization`；  
  - **注册成功后**立刻把返回的 `access_token` 写入 `localStorage`；  
  - 顺带改进了 `detail` 为数组时的错误提示。
- [`frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx`](d:\文档\Cursor\pet-collar\frontend\src\pages\Settings.tsx)：  
  - 注册只走 `register`，登录只走 `login`，**不再注册后再登录两次**。

db.refresh(event)\n    return event\n\n\nasync def get_events(\n    db: AsyncSession,\n    pet_id: int,\n    start: datetime | None = None,\n    end: datetime | None = None,\n    limit: int = 50,\n    offset: int = 0,\n) -> list[Event]:\n    query = select(Event).where(Event.pet_id == pet_id)\n    if start:\n        query = query.where(Event.timestamp >= start)\n    if end:\n        query = query.where(Event.timestamp <= end)\n    query = query.order_by(Event.timestamp.desc()).limit(limit).offset(offset)\n    result = await db.execute(query)\n    return list(result.scalars().all())\n\n\nasync def get_event(db: AsyncSession, event_id: int) -> Event | None:\n    return await db.get(Event, event_id)\n\n\nasync def update_feedback(db: AsyncSession, event: Event, feedback: str) -> Event:\n    event.user_feedback = feedback\n    await db.commit()\n    await db.refresh(event)\n    return event\n\n\nasync def get_event_stats(\n    db: AsyncSession,\n    pet_id: int,\n    start: datetime | None = None,\n    end: datetime | None = None,\n) -> list[EventStats]:\n    query = (\n        select(\n            Event.behavior_type,\n            func.count().label(\"count\"),\n            func.avg(Event.confidence).label(\"avg_confidence\"),\n            func.avg(Event.duration_ms).label(\"avg_duration_ms\"),\n        )\n        .where(Event.pet_id == pet_id)\n        .group_by(Event.behavior_type)\n    )\n    if start:\n        query = query.where(Event.timestamp >= start)\n    if end:\n        query = query.where(Event.timestamp <= end)\n\n    result = await db.execute(query)\n    return [\n        EventStats(\n            behavior_type=row.behavior_type,\n            count=row.count,\n            avg_confidence=float(row.avg_confidence or 0),\n            avg_duration_ms=float(row.avg_duration_ms or 0),\n        )\n        for row in result.all()\n    ]\n"

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\backend\\app\\services\\notification_service.py",
 "contents": "\"\"\"Notification service: manages WebSocket connections and broadcasts events to subscribers.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport asyncio\nimport json\nfrom collections import defaultdict\n\nfrom fastapi import WebSocket\n\n\nclass ConnectionManager:\n    \"\"\"Tracks active WebSocket connections per pet_id and broadcasts messages.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        self._connections: dict[int, list[WebSocket]] = defaultdict(list)\n        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()\n\n    async def connect(self, pet_id: int, ws: WebSocket) -> None:\n        await ws.accept()\n        async with self._lock:\n            self._connections[pet_id].append(ws)\n\n    async def disconnect(self, pet_id: int, ws: WebSocket) -> None:\n        async with self._lock:\n            conns = self._connections.get(pet_id, [])\n            if ws in conns:\n                conns.remove(ws)\n                if not conns:\n                    del self._connections[pet_id]\n\n    async def broadcast(self, pet_id: int, message: dict) -> None:\n        async with self._lock:\n            conns = list(self._connections.get(pet_id, []))\n\n        payload = json.dumps(message, default=str)\n        dead: list[WebSocket] = []\n        for ws in conns:\n            try:\n                await ws.send_text(payload)\n            except Exception:\n                dead.append(ws)\n\n        for ws in dead:\n            await self.disconnect(pet_id, ws)\n\n\nmanager = ConnectionManager()\n"
}

## 后端搭建完成 — 文件清单

### 核心基础设施 (`app/core/`)
- **`config.py`** — 基于 `pydantic-settings` 的环境配置，支持 `.env` 文件
- **`database.py`** — SQLAlchemy 2.0 async engine + session factory
- **`security.py`** — bcrypt 密码哈希 + JWT 令牌生成/验证 + `get_current_user` 依赖注入

### 数据模型 (`app/models/`)
- **User** — 用户（email, hashed_password, nickname）
- **Pet** — 宠物档案（species, breed, weight, age）
- **Device** — 项圈设备（ble_mac, firmware_version, battery_level）
- **Event** — 行为事件（behavior_type, confidence, duration, imu/audio 摘要, 干预结果）
- **Location** — GPS 定位（latitude, longitude, timestamp）

### API 路由 (`app/api/`)
| 路由 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| `POST /api/auth/register` | 用户注册 |
| `POST /api/auth/login` | 用户登录 |
| `GET /api/auth/me` | 当前用户信息 |
| `CRUD /api/pets` | 宠物档案管理 |
| `POST /api/devices/bind` | 设备绑定 |
| `POST /api/events` | 事件上报（自动 WebSocket 广播） |
| `GET /api/events?pet_id=&start=&end=` | 事件查询 |
| `GET /api/events/stats` | 行为趋势统计 |
| `POST /api/location` | 位置上报 |
| `GET /api/location/latest` | 最新位置 |
| `GET /api/location/history` | 历史轨迹 |
| `WS /ws/{pet_id}` | WebSocket 实时推送 |
| `/api/training/*` | 训练模块 placeholder |
| `/api/stress/*` | 应激指数 placeholder |

### 部署配置
- **`docker-compose.yml`** — 一键启动 PostgreSQL + Redis + Backend
- **`Dockerfile`** — Python 3.12 slim 镜像
- **`alembic/`** — 异步数据库迁移配置

### 启动方式

```bash
# 方式一：Docker 一键启动
docker-compose up -d

# 方式二：本地开发（需先启动 PG + Redis）
cd backend
pip install -r requirements.txt
uvicorn app.main:app --reload
```

启动后访问 `http://localhost:8000/docs` 即可看到完整的 Swagger API 文档。

waypoint-based routes (park loop, neighbourhood stroll, etc.)\n *   - Geofence system: circle & polygon fences with enter/leave callbacks\n *   - Auto-report to backend Location API\n */\n\n// ─── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport type MovementMode = \"stationary\" | \"walking\" | \"running\" | \"route\";\n\nexport interface GpsPoint {\n  latitude: number;\n  longitude: number;\n  timestamp: number;\n}\n\nexport interface RouteWaypoint {\n  lat: number;\n  lng: number;\n  /** Optional pause at this waypoint in ms */\n  pauseMs?: number;\n}\n\nexport interface PresetRoute {\n  name: string;\n  label: string;\n  waypoints: RouteWaypoint[];\n  loop: boolean;\n}\n\n// ─── Geofence types ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport interface CircleFence {\n  type: \"circle\";\n  id: string;\n  label: string;\n  center: { lat: number; lng: number };\n  radiusMeters: number;\n}\n\nexport interface PolygonFence {\n  type: \"polygon\";\n  id: string;\n  label: string;\n  /** Vertices in order; automatically closed */\n  vertices: Array<{ lat: number; lng: number }>;\n}\n\nexport type Geofence = CircleFence | PolygonFence;\n\nexport type FenceEventType = \"enter\" | \"leave\";\n\nexport interface FenceEvent {\n  fence: Geofence;\n  eventType: FenceEventType;\n  point: GpsPoint;\n}\n\n// ─── Constants ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nconst DEG_PER_METER = 1 / 111_320;\n\n/** Base speed in degrees-per-tick for each mode */\nconst MODE_SPEED: Record<Exclude<MovementMode, \"route\">, number> = {\n  stationary: 0,\n  walking: 1.2 * DEG_PER_METER,   // ~1.2 m / tick\n  running: 4.5 * DEG_PER_METER,   // ~4.5 m / tick\n};\n\n/** Heading drift range (radians) per tick */\nconst HEADING_DRIFT = 0.6;\n\n/** GPS white-noise amplitude (degrees) */\nconst GPS_NOISE = 0.3 * DEG_PER_METER;\n\n/** Route following: snap-to-waypoint threshold (degrees) */\nconst ROUTE_SNAP = 3 * DEG_PER_METER;\n\n/** Route speed (degrees per tick) */\nconst ROUTE_SPEED = 1.5 * DEG_PER_METER;\n\n// ─── Preset route ({\n    lat: homeLat + dy * DEG_PER_METER,\n    lng: homeLng + dx * DEG_PER_METER / cosLat,\n    pauseMs,\n  }));\n}\n\nexport function getPresetRoutes(homeLat: number, homeLng: number): PresetRoute[] {\n  return [\n    {\n      name: \"park_loop\",\n      label: \"公园散步\",\n      loop: true,\n      waypoints: offsetRoute(homeLat, homeLng, [\n        { dx: 0, dy: 0 },\n        { dx: 50, dy: 30 },\n        { dx: 120, dy: 80, pauseMs: 5000 },\n        { dx: 150, dy: 200 },\n        { dx: 80, dy: 280, pauseMs: 3000 },\n        { dx: -20, dy: 250 },\n        { dx: -60, dy: 150 },\n        { dx: -30, dy: 50 },\n      ]),\n    },\n    {\n      name: \"neighbourhood\",\n      label: \"小区遛弯\",\n      loop: true,\n      waypoints: offsetRoute(homeLat, homeLng, [\n        { dx: 0, dy: 0 },\n        { ## GPS 模拟器实现总结

### 核心引擎 `gps-simulator.ts`

**1. 随机游走（惯性模型）**
- 带加速/减速的平滑速度变化（不是瞬间切换）
- 航向角随机漂移 + 5% 概率大幅度转弯（模拟宠物探索行为）
- GPS 白噪声叠加（±0.3m），模拟真实 GNSS 抖动
- 三种模式：`stationary`（静止）、`walking`（~1.2m/tick）、`running`（~4.5m/tick）

**2. 预设路线系统**
- 基于 waypoint 序列的路线跟随（自动插值移动到下一个路标点）
- 4 条内置路线，所有坐标基于家的位置自动偏移：

| 路线 | 说明 | 循环 |
|------|------|------|
| `park_loop` | 公园散步，含停留点 | 是 |
| `neighbourhood` | 小区遛弯，矩形路线 | 是 |
| `morning_run` | 晨跑路线，较大范围 | 是 |
| `escape` | 出逃模拟，持续远离家 | 否 |

- 支持路标点暂停（`pauseMs`），模拟嗅闻/休息
- 可配置是否循环

**3. 围栏检测系统**
- **圆形围栏**：基于 Haversine 公式精确计算球面距离
- **多边形围栏**：Ray-casting 算法判定点是否在多边形内
- **进出事件**：维护每个围栏的内/外状态，状态翻转时触发 `enter`/`leave` 回调
- 支持多围栏同时存在，独立检测
- 便捷方法 `addHomeFence(radius)` 一键创建家的围栏

### React Hook `useGpsSimulator.ts`

把模拟器与应用状态和后端 API 完整串联：

```typescript
const {
  position,       // 当前 GPS 坐标
  mode,           // 当前运动模式
  running,        // 是否在运行
  trail,          // 轨迹历史 (最多 500 点)
  fences,         // 当前围栏列表
  fenceAlerts,    // 围栏进出告警记录
  routes,         // 预设路线列表
  distanceToHome, // 距家距离 (米)

  start,          // 启动模拟
  stop,           // 停止模拟
  reset,          // 重置到家
  setMode,        // 切换 stationary/walking/running
  followRoute,    // 跟随预设路线
  addFence,       // 添加围栏
  removeFence,    // 移除围栏
  clearAlerts,    // 清空告警
} = useGpsSimulator({ lat: 39.9042, lng: 116.4074 });
```

- 每次位置更新自动调用 `api.reportLocation()` 上报到后端
- 位置变更自动同步到 Zustand store 中的 `locations`
- 围栏告警维护最近 50 条记录

## 识别结果

- **芯片**：沁恒 **CH342**（双串口 USB 转 UART），VID `1A86`、PID `55D2`。
- **状态**：`OK`，驱动已正常加载。
- **串口**：
  - **COM3**：USB-Enhanced-SERIAL-**B** CH342  
  - **COM4**：USB-Enhanced-SERIAL-**A** CH342  

很多开发板会把 **UART0（下载/调试）** 接到其中一个口、**UART1** 或别的功能接到另一个口，具体以你板子原理图或说明为准。一般烧录/串口监视先试 **COM3 或 COM4** 里和 “USB” 标注对应的那一个。

## 接下来你可以怎么做

1. 在 **设备管理器 → 端口 (COM 和 LPT)** 里确认名称与 COM 号一致。  
2. 用 esptool、串口助手或你工程里的工具选 **COM3 或 COM4** 做烧录/打印。  
3. 若只有一个口有输出，换另一个 COM 试一次即可。

如果你告诉我板子型号（例如 ESP32-S3 某款）或用的是 Arduino / ESP-IDF / PlatformIO，我可以帮你对一下该用哪个 COM、波特率一般是多少。

## T5AI-CORE 简要说明

- **生态**：走 **涂鸦 TuyaOpen**（开源设备 SDK），板级在仓库里有 **T5AI** 相关定义，例如 [TuyaOpen `boards/T5AI`](https://github.com/tuya/TuyaOpen/tree/master/boards/T5AI)。
- **文档入口**：[T5 AI Core Overview（TuyaOpen）](https://tuyaopen.io/docs/hardware-specific/tuya-t5/t5-ai-core/overview-t5-ai-core)（若打不开可换网络或从 GitHub 文档镜像进）。
- **引脚（Arduino 文档里的常见映射）**：
  - **UART0（默认 `Serial`）**：TX → **P11**，RX → **P10**（板子丝印常标 **TX/RX**）。
  - 另有 UART1、UART2 等，见 [Pinmux 说明](https://tuyaopen.io/docs/hardware-specific/tuya-t5/develop-with-Arduino/Pinmux)。

## 和你当前 COM 口怎么对应

- **COM3 / COM4** 里，**有一个**一般是 **下载 + 串口打印**（烧录、看 `Serial` 输出用这个）。
- 另一个可能是 **第二路串口** 或工具链里单独用途；**以 TuyaOpen 文档里 “Download / Log” 标注为准**。
- 实操：**两个都试一下**（同一波特率，常见 **115200** 或文档指定值），看哪个有下载进度/日志即可。

## 本地仓库

当前 **pet-collar** 工程里 **没有** 搜到 `T5AI` / Tuya 相关引用；若你要在这项目里接 T5AI，需要单独加 TuyaOpen 工程或适配层。

| 烧录命令 | `idf.py flash` | `tos.py` 等（见下文） |

所以：**不能把现在这份 ESP-IDF 工程直接 `idf.py flash` 到 T5AI-CORE 上**，要跑本仓库固件需要 **ESP32-S3 开发板**；若坚持用 T5AI，要在 **TuyaOpen 里新开/移植工程**，工作量是另一档事。

## 路线 A：继续做这个「宠物项圈」MVP（推荐和 README 一致）

2. 装 [ESP-IDF](https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-idf/)（Windows 用安装器最省事）。
