```

把 `COMx` 换成设备管理器里 **ESP32 那一颗 USB 转串口** 的口（不是 CH342 双口时也可能是单 COM，以实际为准）。

**T5AI-CORE** 可以当别的涂鸦/TuyaOpen 学习用，和这条线并行即可。

1. **环境（官方要求）**

### 👤 用户

> 我们计划的是ESP32+Tuya T5AI-CORE/因为这个tuya的这个板子上没有能接摄影头组件的接口所以打算用ESP32来接这个摄像头然后把两块板连一起

### 🤖 Agent

这个思路是成立的：**T5AI 负责涂鸦生态/联网/语音或端侧推理**，**ESP32 专门接摄像头并做采集与压缩**，两块板用串行总线连在一起，很常见。

下面按「怎么分工、怎么连线、数据量要注意什么」说清楚，方便你们定接口和协议。

## 1. 分工建议（可按产品再调）

| 模块 | 适合做的事 |
|------|------------|
| **ESP32（带摄像头，例如 ESP32-S3 + 摄像头模组）** | 图像采集、ISP/缩放、**JPEG 编码**、简单事件（移动侦测）、把「图片或特征」送给 T5AI |
| **Tuya T5AI-CORE** | 配网、涂鸦云、语音/对话、业务逻辑、若算力允许可做轻量视觉或只做上传与联动 |

核心点：**尽量不要在两块板之间传原始 RGB 高清视频流**，UART 带宽不够；**传 JPEG 单帧、降分辨率、或只传检测结果**更现实。

## 2. 板间怎么连（优先 UART）

你们之前这块 T5AI 上 **CH342 双串口** 是 **USB↔PC** 调试用的；**和 ESP32 通信**要用板上的 **MCU UART 引脚**（例如文档里的 **P10/P11 的 UART0**，或 **UART1/2**），和 PC 的 COM 口不是一回事。

- **三线最少**：ESP32 `TX` ↔ T5AI `RX`，ESP32 `RX` ↔ T5AI `TX`，**GND 共地**（必须）。
- **电平**：双方都是 **3.3V TTL UART**，一般可直接连；若有 5V UART 才需要电平转换。
- **波特率**：控制与小数据可用 **115200**；若传较大 JPEG，可提到 **921600** 或 **3M**（需两端驱动与布线都支持，且做流控/分包协议）。

若以后觉得 UART 仍不够：**SPI（主从）** 吞吐量更大，但软硬件复杂度明显高于 UART，适合第二阶段再考虑。

## 3. 数据与协议（建议一开始就定死）

- **传什么**：例如「每次告警一张 **JPEG**（几十～几百 KB）」或「只传检测框/类别 + 可选缩略图」。
- **怎么传**：自定义帧头（魔数 + 长度 + 类型 + CRC）+ **分包**，避免粘包；大文件分片发送，T5AI 侧重组。
- **谁主谁从**：常见是 **ESP32 主动上报**（有事件就发），T5AI **下发命令**（改分辨率、触发抓拍等），双向都可走同一 UART，用消息类型区分。

## 4. 和本仓库（ESP32-S3 固件）的关系

当前 **pet-collar** 固件是按 **单芯片 ESP32-S3 + ESP-IDF** 设计的。若采用 **ESP32 + T5AI 双板**：

- ESP32 侧：继续在 IDF 里做摄像头、编码、UART 发送。
- T5AI 侧：在 **TuyaOpen** 里写接收解析、云侧逻辑；**不会**用同一套 `idf.py` 工程同时管两块芯片。

这是**两套固件、一条物理链路**，需要在文档里写清引脚与协议版本，避免以后接线混乱。

## 5. 小结

- **架构合理**：缺摄像头接口的 T5AI + 带摄像头的 ESP32 是常见组合。  
- **关键工程点**：**GND 共地**、用 **MCU UART 引脚**互连（不是 PC 的 COM3/COM4）、**以 JPEG/事件为主**定 UART 协议、预留波特率/分包与校验。

若你愿意下一步落到「具体引脚表 + 一帧报文格式」，可以说一下：准备用 **ESP32 的哪几个 GPIO 做 UART**、以及 **T5AI 上打算用 UART0 还是 UART1**，我可以按你们选型给一版可直接写在设计说明里的接线表和帧格式草案（仍不写进仓库文档，除非你明确要求）。

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\backend\\app\\services\\geofence_service.py",
 "contents": "import json\n\nfrom sqlalchemy import select\nfrom sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession\n\nfrom app.models.geofence import Geofence\nfrom app.schemas.geofence import GeofenceCreate, GeofenceResponse, VertexPoint\n\n\nasync def create_geofence(db: AsyncSession, data: GeofenceCreate) -> Geofence:\n    vertices_json = None\n    if data.vertices:\n        vertices_json = json.dumps([v.model_dump() for v in data.vertices])\n\n    fence = Geofence(\n        pet_id=data.pet_id,\n        name=data.name,\n        fence_type=data.fence_type,\n        center_lat=data.center_lat,\n        center_lng=data.center_lng,\n        radius_meters=data.radius_meters,\n        vertices_json=vertices_json,\n    )\n    db.add(fence)\n    await db.commit()\n    await db.refresh(fence)\n    return fence\n\n\nasync def get_geofences(db: AsyncSession, pet_id: int) -> list[Geofence]:\n    result = await db.execute(\n        select(Geofence)\n        .where(Geofence.pet_id == pet_id, Geofence.is_active == True)\n        .order_by(Geofence.created_at)\n    )\n    return list(result.scalars().all())\n\n\nasync def delete_geofence(db: AsyncSession, fence_id: int) -> bool:\n    result = await db.execute(select(Geofence).where(Geofence.id == fence_id))\n    fence = result.scalar_one_or_none()\n    if not fence:\n        return False\n    await db.delete(fence)\n    await db.commit()\n    return True\n\n\ndef fence_to_response(fence: Geofence) -> GeofenceResponse:\n    vertices = None\n    if fence.vertices_json:\n        vertices = [VertexPoint(**v) for v in json.loads(fence.vertices_json)]\n    return GeofenceResponse(\n        id=fence.id,\n        pet_id=fence.pet_id,\n        name=fence.name,\n        fence_type=fence.fence_type,\n        center_lat=fence.center_lat,\n        center_lng=fence.center_lng,\n        radius_meters=fence.radius_meters,\n        vertices=vertices,\n        is_active=fence.is_active,\n        created_at=fence.created_at,\n    )\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\backend\\app\\api\\geofence.py",
 "contents": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException\nfrom sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession\n\nfrom app.core.database import get_db\nfrom app.core.security import get_current_user\nfrom app.models.user import User\nfrom app.schemas.geofence import GeofenceCreate, GeofenceResponse\nfrom app.services import geofence_service\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\n@router.post(\"\", response_model=GeofenceResponse, status_code=201)\nasync def create_geofence(\n    body: GeofenceCreate,\n    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),\n    _user: User = Depends(get_current_user),\n):\n    fence = await geofence_service.create_geofence(db, body)\n    return geofence_service.fence_to_response(fence)\n\n\n@router.get(\"\", response_model=list[GeofenceResponse])\nasync def list_geofences(\n    pet_id: int,\n    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),\n    _user: User = Depends(get_current_user),\n):\n    fences = await geofence_service.get_geofences(db, pet_id)\n    return [geofence_service.fence_to_response(f) for f in fences]\n\n\n@router.delete(\"/{fence_id}\", status_code=204)\nasync def delete_geofence(\n    fence_id: int,\n    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),\n    _user: User = Depends(get_current_user),\n):\n    deleted = await geofence_service.delete_geofence(db, fence_id)\n    if not deleted:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"围栏不存在\")\n"
}

## 完成内容

### 后端 (4 个新文件 + 2 个修改)

- **`backend/app/models/geofence.py`** — `Geofence` 数据库模型，支持 `circle` 和 `polygon` 两种围栏类型，多边形顶点以 JSON 存储
- **`backend/app/schemas/geofence.py`** — Pydantic 请求/响应 schema，含 `VertexPoint`、`GeofenceCreate`、`GeofenceResponse`
- **`backend/app/services/geofence_service.py`** — 围栏 CRUD 业务逻辑，含 JSON 序列化/反序列化处理
- **`backend/app/api/geofence.py`** — 三个 API 端点：`POST /api/geofence`（创建）、`GET /api/geofence`（列表）、`DELETE /api/geofence/{id}`（删除）
- 修改了 `models/__init__.py` 和 `api/__init__.py` 注册新模块，以及 `Pet` 模型增加 `geofences` 关系

### 前端 (2 个修改)

**`api.ts`** — 新增 `createGeofence`、`listGeofences`、`deleteGeofence` 三个 API 方法

**`Location.tsx`** — 完整重写，新增功能：

1. **轨迹面板**（底部 Tab "轨迹"）：
   - 实时轨迹点计数 + 历史记录数
   - 显示/隐藏实时轨迹和历史轨迹的开关
   - 历史轨迹用浅色虚线在地图上渲染
   - 清除实时轨迹按钮

2. **自定义围栏**（底部 Tab "围栏"）：
   - **圆形围栏绘制**：点击按钮进入绘制模式 -> 点击地图设圆心 -> 弹窗输入名称和滑块设置半径 -> 确认
   - **多边形围栏绘制**：点击按钮进入绘制模式 -> 逐点点击地图 -> 双击或点"完成绘制"按钮闭合 -> 弹窗输入名称 -> 确认
   - 绘制过程有地图顶部提示条和顶点标记实时预览
   - 围栏列表展示所有围栏（含默认"家"围栏），每项可定位或删除
   - 围栏数据自动同步到后端持久化

3. **围栏告警 Toast**：宠物进出围栏时顶部弹出颜色区分的提示条

4. **预设路线选择器**：下拉框可选公园散步/小区遛弯/晨跑路线/出逃模拟

\"idle\";\n}\n\nfunction DogSVG({ pose }: { pose: PetPose }) {\n  const isSleeping = pose === \"sleeping\";\n  const isBarking = pose === \"barking\";\n  const isEating = pose === \"eating\";\n  const isPanting = pose === \"panting\";\n\n  return (\n    <svg viewBox=\"0 0 120 120\" width=\"120\" height=\"120\" className=\"pet-torso\">\n      {/* Body */}\n      <ellipse cx=\"60\" cy=\"72\" rx=\"28\" ry=\"20\" fill=\"#D4A574\" />\n      <ellipse cx=\"60\" cy=\"75\" rx=\"24\" ry=\"15\" fill=\"#E8C9A0\" />\n\n      {/* Legs */}\n      <g className=\"pet-paw-left\">\n        <rect x=\"38\" y=\"85\" width=\"10\" height=\"18\" rx=\"5\" fill=\"#D4A574\" />\n        <ellipse cx=\"43\" cy=\"103\" rx=\"6\" ry=\"3\" fill=\"#C49A6C\" />\n      </g>\n      <g className=\"pet-paw-right\">\n        <rect x=\"72\" y=\"85\" width=\"10\" height=\"18\" rx=\"5\" fill=\"#D4A574\" />\n        <ellipse cx=\"77\" cy=\"103\" rx=\"6\" ry=\"3\" fill=\"#C49A6C\" />\n      </g>\n\n      {/* Tail */}\n      <g className=\"pet-tail\" style={{ transformOrigin: \"85px 65px\" }}>\n        <path\n          d=\"M85 65 Q95 50 100 55 Q105 60 95 68\"\n          fill=\"none\"\n          stroke=\"#D4A574\"\n          strokeWidth=\"5\"\n          strokeLinecap=\"round\"\n        />\n      </g>\n\n      {/* Head */}\n      <g className=\"pet-head\" style={{ transformOrigin: \"48px 48px\" }}>\n        <ellipse cx=\"48\" cy=\"50\" rx=\"20\" ry=\"18\" fill=\"#D4A574\" />\n        {/* Ears */}\n        <ellipse cx=\"33\" cy=\"36\" rx=\"7\" ry=\"12\" fill=\"#C49A6C\" transform=\"rotate(-15 33 36)\" />\n        <ellipse cx=\"63\" cy=\"36\" rx=\"7\" ry=\"12\" fill=\"#C49A6C\" transform=\"rotate(15 63 36)\" />\n        <ellipse cx=\"33\" cy=\"36\" rx=\"4\" ry=\"8\" fill=\"#E8B4B4\" transform=\"rotate(-15 33 36)\" />\n        <ellipse cx=\"63\" cy=\"36\" rx=\"4\" ry=\"8\" fill=\"#E8B4B4\" transform=\"rotate(15 63 36)\" />\n\n        {/* Eyes */}\n        <g className=\"pet-eyes\">\n          {isSleeping ? (\n            <>\n              <line x1=\"38\" y1=\"48\" x2=\"46\" y2=\"48\" stroke=\"#5C4033\" strokeWidth=\"2\" strokeLinecap=\"round\" />\n              <line x1=\"50\" y1=\"48\" x2=\"58\" y2=\"48\" stroke=\"#5C4033\" strokeWidth=\"2\" strokeLinecap=\"round\" />\n            </>\n          ) : (\n            <>\n              <circle cx=\"42\" cy=\"48\" r=\"3\" fill=\"#5C4033\" />\n              <circle cx=\"54\" cy=\"48\" r=\"3\" fill=\"#5C4033\" />\n              <circle cx=\"43\" cy=\"47\" r=\"1\" fill=\"white\" />\n              <circle cx=\"55\" cy=\"47\" r=\"1\" fill=\"white\" />\n            </>\n          )}\n        </g>\n\n        {/* Nose */}\n        <ellipse cx=\"48\" cy=\"55\" rx=\"3\" ry=\"2\" fill=\"#5C4033\" />\n\n        {/* Mouth */}\n        <g className=\"pet-mouth\">\n          {isBarking ? (\n            <ellipse cx=\"48\" cy=\"60\" rx=\"5\" ry=\"4\" fill=\"#E85D75\" />\n          ) : (\n            <path d=\"M45 57 Q48 60 51 57\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#5C4033\" strokeWidth=\"1\" />\n          )}\n        </g>\n\n        {/* Tongue for panting */}\n        {isPanting && (\n          <g className=\"pet-tongue\" style={{ display: \"block\" }}>\n            <ellipse cx=\"48\" cy=\"63\" rx=\"3\" ry=\"4\" fill=\"#F87171\" />\n          </g>\n        )}\n      </g>\n\n      {/* Barking waves */}\n      {isBarking && (\n        <g style={{ position: \"relative\" }}>\n          <circle cx=\"75\" cy=\"48\" r=\"4\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#F59E0B\" strokeWidth=\"1.5\" opacity=\"0.6\">\n            <animate attributeName=\"r\" from=\"4\" to=\"12\" dur=\"0.6s\" repeatCount=\"indefinite\" />\n            <animate attributeName=\"opacity\" from=\"0.6\" to=\"0\" dur=\"0.6s\" repeatCount=\"indefinite\" />\n          </circle>\n          <circle cx=\"78\" cy=\"44\" r=\"3\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#F59E0B\" strokeWidth=\"1.5\" opacity=\"0.6\">\n            <animate attributeName=\"r\" from=\"3\" to=\"10\" dur=\"0.6s\" begin=\"0.2s\" repeatCount=\"indefinite\" />\n            <animate attributeName=\"opacity\" from=\"0.6\" to=\"0\" dur=\"0.6s\" begin=\"0.2s\" repeatCount=\"indefinite\" />\n          </circle>\n        </g>\n      )}\n\n      {/* Alert glow for eating/foreign */}\n      {isEating && (\n        <circle cx=\"60\" cy=\"70\" r=\"35\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#EF4444\" strokeWidth=\"2\" opacity=\"0.3\">\n          <animate attributeName=\"r\" from=\"35\" to=\"45\" dur=\"1.5s\" repeatCount=\"indefinite\" />\n          <animate attributeName=\"opacity\" from=\"0.3\" to=\"0\" dur=\"1.5s\" repeatCount=\"indefinite\" />\n        </circle>\n      )}\n    </svg>\n  );\n}\n\ninterface PetAvatarProps {\n  className?: string;\n}\n\nexport default function PetAvatar({ className = \"\" }: PetAvatarProps) {\n  const { bleConnected, events, digitalTwinMood, currentActivity } = useStore();\n  const [bubbleText, setBubbleText] = useState(\"\");\n\n  const latestEvent = events[0];\n  const pose: PetPose = latestEvent && bleConnected\n    ? mapEventToPose(latestEvent.behavior_type)\n    : derivePose(currentActivity, bleConnected);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const pickBubble = () => {\n      const mood: DigitalTwinMood = bleConnected ? digitalTwinMood : \"bored\";\n      const pool = MOOD_BUBBLES[mood];\n      setBubbleText(pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)]);\n    };\n    pickBubble();\n    const timer = setInterval(pickBubble, 8000);\n    return () => clearInterval(timer);\n  }, [bleConnected, digitalTwinMood]);\n\n  const bgGradient = bleConnected\n    ? \"from-blue-50 via-indigo-50 to-purple-50\"\n    : \"from-gray-100 via-gray-50 to-gray-100\";\n\n  return (\n    <div className={`relative rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br ${bgGradient} p-6 ${className}`}>\n      <div className={`pet-stage pose-${pose}`}>\n        {/* Mood bubble */}\n        <div className=\"mood-bubble\">{bubbleText}</div>\n\n        {/* Pet body */}\n        <div className={`pet-body ${!bleConnected ? \"disconnected\" : \"\"}`}>\n          <DogSVG pose={pose} />\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Shadow */}\n        <div className=\"pet-shadow\" />\n\n        {/* Sleep ZZZ */}\n        {pose === \"sleeping\" && <div className=\"zzz-float\">💤</div>}\n\n        {/* Disconnected indicator */}\n        {!bleConnected && (\n          <div className=\"absolute bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 text-xs text-gray-400 bg-white/80 px-3 py-1 rounded-full shadow-sm\">\n            📡 信号未连接\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "interface ScoreRingProps {\n  score: number;\n  max?: number;\n  size?: number;\n  strokeWidth?: number;\n  color?: string;\n  label: string;\n}\n\nexport default function ScoreRing({\n  score,\n  max = 100,\n  size = 56,\n  strokeWidth = 5,\n  color = \"#6366f1\",\n  label,\n}: ScoreRingProps) {\n  const radius = (size - strokeWidth) / 2;\n  const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;\n  const pct = Math.min(score / max, 1);\n  const offset = circumference * (1 - pct);\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center gap-1\">\n      <div className=\"relative\" style={{ width: size, height: size }}>\n        <svg width={size} height={size}>\n          <circle\n            cx={size / 2}\n            cy={size / 2}\n            r={radius}\n            fill=\"none\"\n            stroke=\"#e5e7eb\"\n            strokeWidth={strokeWidth}\n          />\n          <circle\n            cx={size / 2}\n            cy={size / 2}\n            r={radius}\n            fill=\"none\"\n            stroke={color}\n            strokeWidth={strokeWidth}\n            strokeLinecap=\"round\"\n            strokeDasharray={circumference}\n            strokeDashoffset={offset}\n            transform={`rotate(-90 ${size / 2} ${size / 2})`}\n            style={{ transition: \"stroke-dashoffset 0.8s ease\" }}\n          />\n        </svg>\n        <span\n          className=\"absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-bold\"\n          style={{ color }}\n        >\n          {Math.round(score)}\n        </span>\n      </div>\n      <span className=\"text-xs text-gray-500\">{label}</span>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "import { useEffect, useState } from \"react\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport { ACTIVITY_LABELS } from \"../types\";\n\nexport default function ActivityBar() {\n  const { currentActivity, events } = useStore();\n  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);\n\n  const latestEvent = events[0];\n  const activityStart = latestEvent ? new Date(latestEvent.timestamp).getTime() : Date.now();\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const tick = () => setElapsed(Math.floor((Date.now() - activityStart) / 1000));\n    tick();\n    const timer = setInterval(tick, 1000);\n    return () => clearInterval(timer);\n  }, [activityStart]);\n\n  const formatDuration = (s: number) => {\n    if (s < 60) return `${s} 秒`;\n    if (s < 3600) return `${Math.floor(s / 60)} 分钟`;\n    return `${Math.floor(s / 3600)} 小时 ${Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60)} 分`;\n  };\n\n  const info = ACTIVITY_LABELS[currentActivity] ?? ACTIVITY_LABELS.unknown;\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between bg-white rounded-xl px-4 py-3 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n        <span className=\"text-lg\">{info.icon}</span>\n        <span className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700\">{info.label}</span>\n      </div>\n      <span className=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">已持续 {formatDuration(elapsed)}</span>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\frontend\\src\\components\\ActivityTimeline.tsx",
 "contents": "import type { PetEvent } from \"../types\";\n\ninterface Props {\n  events: PetEvent[];\n}\n\ntype RiskLevel = \"rest\" | \"normal\" | \"attention\" | \"danger\";\n\nfunction riskLevel(behaviorType: string): RiskLevel {\n  if ([\"prolonged_still\"].includes(behaviorType)) return \"rest\";\n  if ([\"normal\"].includes(behaviorType)) return \"normal\";\n  if ([\"scratching\", \"head_shaking\", \"pacing\", \"barking\"].includes(behaviorType)) return \"attention\";\n  if ([\"foreign_eating\", \"panting\"].includes(behaviorType)) return \"danger\";\n  return \"normal\";\n}\n\nconst RISK_COLORS: Record<RiskLevel, string> = {\n  rest: \"#93C5FD\",\n  normal: \"#86EFAC\",\n  attention: \"#FDE047\",\n  danger: \"#FCA5A5\",\n};\n\nexport default function ActivityTimeline({ events }: Props) {\n  const now = new Date();\n  const todayStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()).getTime();\n  const totalMs = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;\n\n  const todayEvents = events\n    .filter((e) => new Date(e.timestamp).getTime() >= todayStart)\n    .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(b.timestamp).getTime());\n\n  const segments = todayEvents.map((e) => {\n    const t = new Date(e.timestamp).getTime();\n    const startPct = ((t - todayStart) / totalMs) * 100;\n    const widthPct = Math.max((e.duration_ms / totalMs) * 100, 0.5);\n    return { startPct, widthPct, risk: riskLevel(e.behavior_type) };\n  });\n\n  const hours = [0, 6, 12, 18, 24];\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n      <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500 mb-3\">今日活动轨迹</p>\n      <div className=\"relative h-6 bg-gray-100 rounded-full overflow-hidden\">\n        {segments.map((seg, i) => (\n          <div\n            key={i}\n            className=\"absolute top-0 h-full rounded-full\"\n            style={{\n              left: `${seg.startPct}%`,\n              width: `${seg.widthPct}%`,\n              backgroundColor: RISK_COLORS[seg.risk],\n              minWidth: 3,\n            }}\n          />\n        ))}\n        {/* Current time indicator */}\n        <div\n          className=\"absolute top-0 h-full w-0.5 bg-indigo-500\"\n          style={{ left: `${((now.getTime() - todayStart) / totalMs) * 100}%` }}\n        />\n      </div>\n      <div className=\"flex justify-between mt-1.5 text-[10px] text-gray-400\">\n        {hours.map((h) => (\n          <span key={h}>{h}:00</span>\n        ))}\n      </div>\n      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3 mt-2 text-[10px] text-gray-400\">\n        <span className=\"flex items-center gap-1\">\n          <span className=\"w-2 h-2 rounded-full\" style={{ backgroundColor: RISK_COLORS.rest }} />\n          休息\n        </span>\n        <span className=\"flex items-center gap-1\">\n          <span className=\"w-2 h-2 rounded-full\" style={{ backgroundColor: RISK_COLORS.normal }} />\n          正常\n        </span>\n        <span className=\"flex items-center gap-1\">\n          <span className=\"w-2 h-2 rounded-full\" style={{ backgroundColor: RISK_COLORS.attention }} />\n          关注\n        </span>\n        <span className=\"flex items-center gap-1\">\n          <span className=\"w-2 h-2 rounded-full\" style={{ backgroundColor: RISK_COLORS.danger }} />\n          异常\n        </span>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "import { useEffect, useState, useMemo } from \"react\";\nimport { useNavigate } from \"react-router-dom\";\nimport { BarChart, Bar, XAxis, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer } from \"recharts\";\nimport StatusBadge from \"../components/StatusBadge\";\nimport PetAvatar from \"../components/PetAvatar\";\nimport ActivityBar from \"../components/ActivityBar\";\nimport QuickActions from \"../components/QuickActions\";\nimport ActivityTimeline from \"../components/ActivityTimeline\";\nimport ScoreRing from \"../components/ScoreRing\";\nimport PetChatPreview from \"../components/PetChatPreview\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport { api } from \"../services/api\";\nimport { BEHAVIOR_LABELS } from \"../types\";\nimport type { PetEvent, EventStats } from \"../types\";\n\nfunction computeActivityScore(events: PetEvent[]): number {\n  const todayEvents = events.filter(\n    (e) => new Date(e.timestamp).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString(),\n  );\n  if (todayEvents.length === 0) return 0;\n  const base = Math.min(todayEvents.length * 8, 60);\n  const variety = new Set(todayEvents.map((e) => e.behavior_type)).size;\n  return Math.min(base + variety * 10, 100);\n}\n\nfunction computeHealthScore(events: PetEvent[]): number {\n  const recent = events.slice(0, 20);\n  if (recent.length === 0) return 95;\n  const riskEvents = recent.filter(\n    (e) => [\"foreign_eating\", \"panting\"].includes(e.behavior_type) && e.confidence > 60,\n  );\n  const attentionEvents = recent.filter(\n    (e) => [\"scratching\", \"head_shaking\"].includes(e.behavior_type) && e.confidence > 50,\n  );\n  return Math.max(100 - riskEvents.length * 15 - attentionEvents.length * 5, 10);\n}\n\nfunction formatAwayDuration(seconds: number): string {\n  if (seconds < 60) return \"--\";\n  if (seconds < 3600) return `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}分`;\n  const h = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);\n  const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);\n  return m > 0 ? `${h}时${m}分` : `${h}时`;\n}\n\nexport default function Dashboard() {\n  const {\n    activePetId, batteryLevel, bleConnected, events, setEvents,\n    awayDuration, setAwayDuration, pets,\n    setDigitalTwinMood, setCurrentActivity,\n  } = useStore();\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState<EventStats[]>([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n\n  const activePet = pets.find((p) => p.id === activePetId);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!activePetId) return;\n    setLoading(true);\n    Promise.all([\n      api.listEvents(activePetId) as Promise<PetEvent[]>,\n      api.eventStats(activePetId) as Promise<EventStats[]>,\n    ])\n      .then(([evts, st]) => {\n        setEvents(evts);\n        setStats(st);\n      })\n      .catch(() => {})\n      .finally(() => setLoading(false));\n  }, [activePetId, setEvents]);\n\n  // Derive digital twin mood from events\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (events.length === 0) {\n      setDigitalTwinMood(\"calm\");\n      setCurrentActivity(\"resting\");\n      return;\n    }\n    const latest = events[0];\n    const riskTypes = [\"foreign_eating\", \"panting\"];\n    const anxiousTypes = [\"pacing\", \"barking\"];\n    const sleepTypes = [\"prolonged_still\"];\n\n    if (riskTypes.includes(latest.behavior_type)) {\n      setDigitalTwinMood(\"anxious\");\n      setCurrentActivity(\"alert\");\n    } else if (anxiousTypes.includes(latest.behavior_type)) {\n      setDigitalTwinMood(\"anxious\");\n      setCurrentActivity(\"walking\");\n    } else if (sleepTypes.includes(latest.behavior_type)) {\n      setDigitalTwinMood(\"sleepy\");\n      setCurrentActivity(\"sleeping\");\n    } else if (latest.behavior_type === \"scratching\" || latest.behavior_type === \"head_shaking\") {\n      setDigitalTwinMood(\"bored\");\n      setCurrentActivity(\"scratching\");\n    } else {\n      setDigitalTwinMood(\"happy\");\n      setCurrentActivity(\"resting\");\n    }\n  }, [events, setDigitalTwinMood, setCurrentActivity]);\n\n  // Track away duration when BLE disconnected\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (bleConnected) {\n      setAwayDuration(0);\n      return;\n    }\n    const timer = setInterval(() => {\n      setAwayDuration((prev: number) => prev + 1);\n    }, 1000);\n    return () => clearInterval(timer);\n    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps\n  }, [bleConnected]);\n\n  const deriveStatus = (): \"calm\" | \"attention\" | \"high_risk\" => {\n    const recentHighRisk = events\n      .slice(0, 10)\n      .filter((e) => [\"foreign_eating\", \"panting\"].includes(e.behavior_type) && e.confidence > 70);\n    if (recentHighRisk.length >= 2) return \"high_risk\";\n    if (recentHighRisk.length >= 1 || events.slice(0, 10).length > 5) return \"attention\";\n    return \"calm\";\n  };\n\n  const totalToday = events.filter(\n    (e) => new Date(e.timestamp).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString(),\n  ).length;\n\n  const activityScore = useMemo(() => computeActivityScore(events), [events]);\n  const healthScore = useMemo(() => computeHealthScore(events), [events]);\n\n  const chartData = useMemo(\n    () =>\n      stats.map((s) => ({\n        name: BEHAVIOR_LABELS[s.behavior_type] ?? s.behavior_type,\n        count: s.count,\n      })),\n    [stats],\n  );\n\n  const latestEvent = events[0];\n\n  if (!activePetId) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"flex-1 flex items-center justify-center p-6 text-gray-500\">\n        请先在设置中添加宠物\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex-1 pb-24 space-y-4 bg-gray-50\">\n      {/* Header */}\n      <div className=\"bg-white px-4 pt-4 pb-2\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <h1 className=\"text-xl font-bold\">{activePet?.name ?? \"宠物状态\"}</h1>\n            <StatusBadge status={deriveStatus()} />\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-500\">\n            <span\n              className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${bleConnected ? \"bg-green-500\" : \"bg-gray-400\"}`}\n            />\n            {bleConnected ? \"已连接\" : \"未连接\"}\n            <span className=\"ml-1\">🔋 MVP uses template\nmatching; can be swapped with an LLM backend later.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport random\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n\nfrom sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession\n\nfrom app.models.pet import Pet\nfrom app.services import event_service\n\nBEHAVIOR_ZH = {\n    \"scratching\": \"抓挠\",\n    \"head_shaking\": \"甩头\",\n    \"panting\": \"喘息\",\n    \"foreign_eating\": \"啃东西\",\n    \"prolonged_still\": \"趴着不动\",\n    \"pacing\": \"踱来踱去\",\n    \"barking\": \"叫了几声\",\n    \"normal\": \"玩耍\",\n}\n\n# ---- mood derivation ----\n\ndef _derive_mood(events: list) -> str:\n    if not events:\n        return \"calm\"\n    latest = events[0]\n    bt = latest.behavior_type\n    if bt in (\"foreign_eating\", \"panting\"):\n        return \"anxious\"\n    if bt in (\"pacing\", \"barking\"):\n        return \"anxious\"\n    if bt == \"prolonged_still\":\n        return \"sleepy\"\n    if bt in (\"scratching\", \"head_shaking\"):\n        return \"bored\"\n    return \"happy\"\n\n\ndef _time_period() -> str:\n    hour = datetime.now(timezone.utc).hour + 8  # rough CST\n    if hour < 6:\n        return ----\n\n_TEMPLATES: dict[str, list[str]] = {\n    \"greeting:happy\": [\n        \"汪汪！{name}超开心看到你来找我！\",\n        \"嘿嘿，今天心情很好哦～有主人陪真好！\",\n    ],\n    \"greeting:calm\": [\n        \"你来啦～{name}正在安静地休息呢。\",\n        \"主人好！{name}今天很乖哦。\",\n    ],\n    \"greeting:bored\": [\n        \"终于来找我了！{name}等你好久了呀...\",\n        \"无聊死了...快来陪{name}玩吧！\",\n    ],\n    \"greeting:anxious\": [\n        \"主人...{name}有点不舒服呢...\",\n        \"你能来看{name}太好了，有点紧张...\",\n    ],\n    \"greeting:sleepy\": [\n        \"嗯...{name}刚睡醒...打个哈欠～\",\n        \"zzZ...哦你来了呀...{name}再眯一会儿好不好...\",\n    ],\n    \"today:has_events\": [\n        \"今天{name}{summary}，一共发生了 {count} 件事！\",\n        \"嗯让{name}想想～今天{summary}，还算充实吧！\",\n    ],\n    \"today:no_events\": [\n        \"今天好平静呀，{name}乖乖的什么都没发生～\",\n        \"好无聊呀，今天一件事都没有...\",\n    ],\n    \"mood:happy\": [\n        \"超级开心的！在享受阳光呢～☀️\",\n        \"心情好到想转圈圈！🐾\",\n        \"有主人关心{name}，当然开心啦！\",\n    ],\n    \"mood:calm\": [\n        \"很平静呢，一切都好。\",\n        \"岁月静好，{name}很安心～\",\n    ],\n    \"mood:bored\": [\n        \"有一丢丢无聊...想出去玩...\",\n        \"好想出去散步呀～🌿\",\n    ],\n    \"mood:anxious\": [\n        \"有点不安...可能需要主人抱抱...\",\n        \"刚才{name}有点紧张...你在就好了。\",\n    ],\n    \"mood:sleepy\": [\n        \"好困...让{name}再睡会儿吧...💤\",\n        \"今天有点累呢...想窝着不动。\",\n    ],\n    \"miss\": [\n        \"当然想你啦！{name}每天都在等你回来！\",\n        \"超级想你的！你不在{name}都不开心...\",\n        \"你不在的时候{name}一直看门口...\",\n    ],\n    \"health\": [\n        \"{name}觉得身体{health_desc}！最近{risk_desc}。\",\n    ],\n    \"fallback\": [\n        \"汪？{name}不太明白...但是很喜欢你和{name}说话！\",\n        \"嗯...{name}歪头想了想，还是不太懂，再说一次？\",\n        \"摇尾巴～{name}虽然听不太懂，但很开心你找{name}聊天！\",\n    ],\n}\n\n\ndef _pick(key: str, **kwargs: str) -> str:\n    pool = _TEMPLATES.get(key, _TEMPLATES[\"fallback\"])\n    return random.choice(pool).format(**kwargs)\n\n\ndef _classify_intent(message: str) -> str:\n    msg = message.lower().strip()\n    greet_kw = [\"你好\", \"嗨\", \"hi\", \"hello\", \"在吗\", \"早\", \"晚上好\"]\n    today_kw = [\"今天\", \"做了什么\", \"干了什么\", \"干嘛\", \"做什么\"]\n    mood_kw = [\"开心\", \"心情\", \"快乐\", \"难过\", \"怎么样\", \"还好吗\", \"状态\"]\n    miss_kw = [\"想我\", \"想你\", \"思念\", \"孤单\", \"寂寞\", \"等我\"]\n    health_kw = [\"健康\", \"身体\", \"生病\", \"不舒服\", \"检查\"]\n\n    for kw in greet_kw:\n        if kw in msg:\n            return \"greeting\"\n    for kw in today_kw:\n        if kw in msg:\n            return \"today\"\n    for kw in mood_kw:\n        if kw in msg:\n            return \"mood\"\n    for kw in miss_kw:\n        if kw in msg:\n            return \"miss\"\n    for kw in health_kw:\n        if kw in msg:\n            return \"health\"\n    return \"fallback\"\n\n\nasync def generate_reply(\n    db: AsyncSession,\n    pet: Pet,\n    message: str,\n) -> str:\n    events = await event_service.get_events(db, pet.id, limit=20)\n    mood = _derive_mood(events)\n    name = pet.name\n    intent = _classify_intent(message)\n\n    if intent == \"greeting\":\n        return _pick(f\"greeting:{mood}\", name=name)\n\n    if intent == \"today\":\n        today_evts = [\n            e for e in events\n            if e.timestamp.date() == datetime.now(timezone.utc).date()\n        ]\n        if today_evts:\n            types = set(e.behavior_type for e in today_evts)\n            summary = \"、\".join(BEHAVIOR_ZH.get(t, t) for t in types)\n            return _pick(\"today:has_events\", name=name, summary=summary, count=str(len(today_evts)))\n        return _pick(\"today:no_events\", name=name)\n\n    if intent == \"mood\":\n        return _pick(f\"mood:{mood}\", name=name)\n\n    if intent == \"miss\":\n        return _pick(\"miss\", name=name)\n\n    if intent == \"health\":\n        risk = [e for e in events if e.behavior_type in (\"foreign_eating\", \"panting\") and e.confidence > 60]\n        if risk:\n            health_desc = \"有点不舒服\"\n            risk_desc = f\"有 {len(risk)} 次高风险行为需要注意\"\n        else:\n            health_desc = \"很不错\"\n            risk_desc = \"没什么异常\"\n        return _pick(\"health\", name=name, health_desc=health_desc, risk_desc=risk_desc)\n\n    return _pick(\"fallback\", name=name)\n"

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\backend\\app\\api\\pet_chat.py",
 "contents": "from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel\nfrom sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession\n\nfrom app.core.database import get_db\nfrom app.core.security import get_current_user\nfrom app.models.user import User\nfrom app.services import pet_service\nfrom app.services.pet_chat_service import generate_reply\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\nclass ChatRequest(BaseModel):\n    pet_id: int\n    message: str\n\n\nclass ChatResponse(BaseModel):\n    reply: str\n\n\n@router.post(\"/chat\", response_model=ChatResponse)\nasync def pet_chat(\n    body: ChatRequest,\n    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),\n    user: User = Depends(get_current_user),\n):\n    pet = await pet_service.get_pet(db, body.pet_id)\n    if not pet or pet.user_id != user.id:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"宠物不存在\")\n    reply = await generate_reply(db, pet, body.message)\n    return ChatResponse(reply=reply)\n"
}

 "plan": "# 用户和宠物头像上传功能\n\n## 现状分析\n\n- **Pet 模型**已有 `avatar_url` 字段（`String(500)`, 默认 `\"\"`），但从未使用\n- **User 模型**没有 `avatar_url` 字段\n- **后端无文件上传接口**，`python-multipart` 已在依赖中但未使用\n- **前端 Pet 类型**已有 `avatar_url: string`，User 类型没有\n- 前端 `api.ts` 的 `request()` 固定 `Content-Type: application/json`，不支持文件上传\n\n## 改动范围\n\n``​`mermaid\nflowchart LR\n  subgraph frontend [Frontend]\n    SettingsPage[\"Settings.tsx\"]\n    ApiService[\"api.ts\"]\n    Types[\"types/index.ts\"]\n    AvatarComp[\"AvatarUpload 组件\"]\n  end\n  subgraph backend [Backend]\n    UserModel[\"User 模型\"]\n    AuthSchema[\"auth schema\"]\n    AuthAPI[\"auth.py 路由\"]\n    UploadAPI[\"upload.py 路由\"]\n    MainApp[\"main.py\"]\n  end\n  AvatarComp -->|\"POST /api/upload\"| UploadAPI\n  AvatarComp -->|\"PATCH /api/auth/me\"| AuthAPI\n  AvatarComp -->|\"PATCH /api/pets/:id\"| SettingsPage\n  UploadAPI -->|\"保存到 uploads/\"| MainApp\n``​`\n\n## 后端改动\n\n### 1. User 模型添加 avatar_url 字段\n\n[`backend/app/models/user.py`](backend/app/models/user.py) - 添加 `avatar_url: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(500), default=\"\")`\n\n### 2. Auth Schema 添加 avatar_url\n\n[`backend/app/schemas/auth.py`](backend/app/schemas/auth.py):\n- `UserResponse` 添加 `avatar_url: str`\n- 新增 `UserUpdate` schema：`nickname: str | None = None`, `avatar_url: str | None = None`\n\n### 3. 新建文件上传路由\n\n新建 [`backend/app/api/upload.py`](backend/app/api/upload.py):\n- `POST /upload` - 接收 `UploadFile`，校验图片类型和大小（限 2MB），生成唯一文件名保存到 `uploads/avatars/`，返回 `{\"url\": \"/uploads/avatars/xxx.jpg\"}`\n\n### 4. Auth 路由添加用户更新接口\n\n[`backend/app/api/auth.py`](backend/app/api/auth.py) - 新增 `PATCH /me`，接收 `UserUpdate`，更新当前用户的 nickname/avatar_url\n\n### 5. 注册路由和静态文件服务\n\n- [`backend/app/api/__init__.py`](backend/app/api/__init__.py) - 注册 upload 路由\n- [`backend/app/main.py`](backend/app/main.py) - 挂载 `StaticFiles` 服务 `uploads/` 目录，路径 `/uploads`；在 lifespan 中确保 `uploads/avatars/` 目录存在\n\n## 前端改动\n\n### 6. 类型和 API 更新\n\n[`frontend/src/types/index.ts`](frontend/src/types/index.ts) - User 接口添加 `avatar_url: string`\n\n[`frontend/src/services/api.ts`](frontend/src/services/api.ts):\n- 新增 `uploadImage(file: File)` 方法，使用 `FormData` 发送（不设 Content-Type，让浏览器自动处理 boundary）\n- 新增 `updateProfile(data)` 方法调用 `PATCH /auth/me`\n\n### 7. 创建 AvatarUpload 组件\n\n新建 [`frontend/src/components/AvatarUpload.tsx`](frontend/src/components/AvatarUpload.tsx):\n- 圆形头像展示，点击触发隐藏的 `<input type=\"file\" accept=\"image/*\">`\n- 无头像时显示默认占位符（用户显示首字母，宠物显示物种 emoji）\n- 选择图片后调用 `api.uploadImage`，上传成功后触发 `onChange(url)` 回调\n- 上传中显示 loading 状态\n\n### 8. 更新 Settings 页面\n\n[`frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx`](frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx):\n- **账号区块**：在昵称左侧添加 `AvatarUpload`，上传后调用 `api.updateProfile({ avatar_url })`，更新 store 中的 user\n- **宠物列表**：每个宠物按钮内左侧添加 `AvatarUpload`（小尺寸），上传后调用 `api.updatePet(pet.id, { avatar_url })`，更新 store 中的 pets\n\n## 设计要点\n\n- 上传的图片文件名使用 UUID 避免冲突\n- 图片限制类型为 jpeg/png/gif/webp，大小限制 2MB\n- 头像组件尺寸可配（用户头像大，宠物头像小）\n- 数据库使用 `create_all` 自动建表，添加字段后重启即可，无需 Alembic 迁移\n",

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\backend\\app\\api\\upload.py",
 "contents": "import uuid\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, UploadFile, File\nfrom app.core.security import get_current_user\nfrom app.models.user import User\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nUPLOAD_DIR = Path(\"uploads/avatars\")\nALLOWED_TYPES = {\"image/jpeg\", \"image/png\", \"image/gif\", \"image/webp\"}\nMAX_SIZE = 2 * 1024 * 1024  # 2MB\n\n\n@router.post(\"\")\nasync def upload_image(\n    file: UploadFile = File(...),\n    _user: User = Depends(get_current_user),\n):\n    if file.content_type not in ALLOWED_TYPES:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"仅支持 jpeg/png/gif/webp 格式\")\n\n    contents = await file.read()\n    if len(contents) > MAX_SIZE:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=\"文件大小不能超过 2MB\")\n\n    ext = file.filename.rsplit(\".\", 1)[-1] if file.filename and \".\" in file.filename else \"jpg\"\n    filename = f\"{uuid.uuid4().hex}.{ext}\"\n    dest = UPLOAD_DIR / filename\n    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    dest.write_bytes(contents)\n\n    return {\"url\": f\"/uploads/avatars/{filename}\"}\n"
}

 "contents": "import { useRef, useState } from \"react\";\nimport { api } from \"../services/api\";\n\ninterface AvatarUploadProps {\n  src?: string;\n  fallback: string;\n  size?: number;\n  onChange: (url: string) => void;\n}\n\nexport default function AvatarUpload({ src, fallback, size = 56, onChange }: AvatarUploadProps) {\n  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);\n  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleFile = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {\n    const file = e.target.files?.[0];\n    if (!file) return;\n    try {\n      setUploading(true);\n      const { url } = await api.uploadImage(file);\n      onChange(url);\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error(\"上传失败\", err);\n    } finally {\n      setUploading(false);\n      if (inputRef.current) inputRef.current.value = \"\";\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <button\n      type=\"button\"\n      onClick={() => inputRef.current?.click()}\n      className=\"relative shrink-0 rounded-full overflow-hidden bg-indigo-100 flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer hover:ring-2 hover:ring-indigo-400 transition-shadow\"\n      style={{ width: size, height: size }}\n    >\n      {src ? (\n        <img src={src} alt=\"avatar\" className=\"w-full h-full object-cover\" />\n      ) : (\n        <span className=\"text-center leading-none select-none\" style={{ fontSize: size * 0.4 }}>\n          {fallback}\n        </span>\n      )}\n\n      {uploading && (\n        <div className=\"absolute inset-0 bg-black/40 flex items-center justify-center\">\n          <div\n            className=\"border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin\"\n            style={{ width: size * 0.35, height: size * 0.35 }}\n          />\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      <div className=\"absolute inset-0 bg-black/0 hover:bg-black/20 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center\">\n        {!uploading && (\n          <svg\n            className=\"w-4 h-4 text-white opacity-0 hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity drop-shadow\"\n            viewBox=\"0 0 20 20\"\n            fill=\"currentColor\"\n          >\n            <path d=\"M4 5a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v6a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V7a2 2 0 0 0-2-2h-1.586a1 1 0 0 1-.707-.293l-1.414-1.414A1 1 0 0 0 11.586 3H8.414a1 1 0 0 0-.707.293L6.293 4.707A1 1 0 0 1 5.586 5H4Zm6 7a2 2 0 1 1 0-4 2 2 0 0 1 0 4Z\" />\n          </svg>\n        )}\n      </div>\n\n      <input\n        ref={inputRef}\n        type=\"file\"\n        accept=\"image/jpeg,image/png,image/gif,image/webp\"\n        className=\"hidden\"\n        onChange={handleFile}\n      />\n    </button>\n  );\n}\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\frontend\\src\\components\\AvatarUpload.tsx",
 "old_string": "import { useRef, useState } from \"react\";\nimport { api } from \"../services/api\";\n\ninterface AvatarUploadProps {\n  src?: string;\n  fallback: string;\n  size?: number;\n  onChange: (url: string) => void;\n}\n\nexport default function AvatarUpload({ src, fallback, size = 56, onChange }: AvatarUploadProps) {\n  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);\n  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleFile = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {\n    const file = e.target.files?.[0];\n    if (!file) return;\n    try {\n      setUploading(true);\n      const { url } = await api.uploadImage(file);\n      onChange(url);\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error(\"上传失败\", err);\n    } finally {\n      setUploading(false);\n      if (inputRef.current) inputRef.current.value = \"\";\n    }\n  };",
 "new_string": "import { useRef, useState } from \"react\";\nimport { api } from \"../services/api\";\n\nconst MAX_DIM = 512;\n\nfunction compressImage(file: File): Promise<File> {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    const img = new Image();\n    img.onload = () => {\n      let { width, height } = img;\n      if (width > MAX_DIM || height > MAX_DIM) {\n        const ratio = Math.min(MAX_DIM / width, MAX_DIM / height);\n        width = Math.round(width * ratio);\n        height = Math.round(height * ratio);\n      }\n      const canvas = document.createElement(\"canvas\");\n      canvas.width = width;\n      canvas.height = height;\n      canvas.getContext(\"2d\")!.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);\n      canvas.toBlob(\n        (blob) => {\n          if (!blob) return reject(new Error(\"压缩失败\"));\n          resolve(new File([blob], file.name.replace(/\\.\\w+$/, \".jpg\"), { type: \"image/jpeg\" }));\n        },\n        \"image/jpeg\",\n        0.85,\n      );\n    };\n    img.onerror = () => reject(new Error(\"图片加载失败\"));\n    img.src = URL.createObjectURL(file);\n  });\n}\n\ninterface AvatarUploadProps {\n  src?: string;\n  fallback: string;\n  size?: number;\n  onChange: (url: string) => void;\n}\n\nexport default function AvatarUpload({ src, fallback, size = 56, onChange }: AvatarUploadProps) {\n  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);\n  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleFile = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {\n    const file = e.target.files?.[0];\n    if (!file) return;\n    try {\n      setUploading(true);\n      const compressed = await compressImage(file);\n      const { url } = await api.uploadImage(compressed);\n      onChange(url);\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error(\"上传失败\", err);\n    } finally {\n      setUploading(false);\n      if (inputRef.current) inputRef.current.value = \"\";\n    }\n  };"

2. **后端 `upload.py`** — 将文件大小上限从 2MB 提高到 5MB 作为兜底保护。

### 🤖 Agent

## 原因说明

浏览器里出现 **500**，是因为后端连的 **SQLite 库是旧表结构**：表里还没有 `avatar_url` 列，但代码里的 `User` / `Pet` 模型已经包含该字段。  

`Base.metadata.create_all()` **只会建不存在的表**，**不会**给已有表加新列，所以一旦本地还留着以前的 `petcollar.db`，查询就会报：

`sqlite3.OperationalError: no such column: users.avatar_url`

登录、注册、`/api/auth/me`、`/api/pets` 等凡是要读 `User` 的接口都会 500。

## 已做修改

在 `app/core/database.py` 里增加了 **`ensure_sqlite_schema`**：在应用启动、执行完 `create_all` 之后，对 **SQLite** 检测并执行 `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN`，补齐 `users.avatar_url` 和 `pets.avatar_url`（仅当列不存在时）。

在 `app/main.py` 的 lifespan 里已调用该函数。

本地已用注册接口验证，返回 **201** 且能拿到 token。

## 你需要做的

1. **重启后端**（若仍在跑旧进程），使新启动逻辑生效。  
2. 若仍异常，可看终端里 uvicorn 的完整报错；也可临时删掉 `backend` 目录下的 `petcollar.db` 让库重建（会丢本地测试数据）。

长期更稳妥的做法是用 **Alembic 迁移** 管理结构变更；当前补丁适合快速对齐已有 SQLite 文件。

 "plan": "# 首页宠物形象替换为小猫 + 立体效果\n\n## 现状分析\n\n当前 [`PetAvatar.tsx`](frontend/src/components/PetAvatar.tsx) 使用一个内联 `DogSVG` 组件绘制小狗，通过 CSS 类 `pose-xxx` 驱动不同行为姿态动画。配套样式在 [`PetAvatar.css`](frontend/src/components/PetAvatar.css)。\n\n## 改造方案\n\n### 1. 将小猫图片放入前端静态资源\n\n- 把 `pet characters/Image-1775291123409.png` 复制到 `frontend/public/pet/cat-idle.png`\n- 后续用户上传新姿态图片时，按 `cat-sleeping.png`、`cat-anxious.png` 等命名\n- 在组件中通过 `PetPose` 映射到不同图片路径，找不到对应姿态则 fallback 到 `cat-idle.png`\n\n### 2. 重写 PetAvatar 组件 -- 多层立体结构\n\n删除 `DogSVG`，替换为如下结构：\n\n``​`\n+---------------------------------------+\n|   .pet-stage                          |\n|                                       |\n|   [mood-bubble]        气泡           |\n|                                       |\n|   .pet-3d-container                   |\n|     ├─ .pet-glow         底部柔光层   |\n|     ├─ .pet-main-image   小猫主图     |\n|     ├─ .pet-highlight    顶部高光层   |\n|     └─ .pet-shadow       椭圆阴影    |\n|                                       |\n+---------------------------------------+\n``​`\n\n各层作用：\n- **底部柔光层 (.pet-glow)**: 使用和图片相同的 src，添加 `blur(20px)` + 半透明度 + 放大 1.1 倍，形成模糊光晕底座，产生发光立体感\n- **主图层 (.pet-main-image)**: 小猫 png 图片，应用轻微的 `breathe` 上下浮动动画（呼吸感）\n- **高光层 (.pet-highlight)**: 一个半透明白色渐变 overlay，`radial-gradient` 从左上角到透明，模拟光照方向，增强立体质感\n- **阴影层 (.pet-shadow)**: 保留现有的椭圆阴影动画，与呼吸动画同步缩放\n\n### 3. CSS 动画（立体呼吸 + 状态变化）\n\n在 [`PetAvatar.css`](frontend/src/components/PetAvatar.css) 中：\n\n- **通用呼吸**: 主图层和阴影层同步 3s 呼吸，主图 `translateY(-4px)` 时阴影 `scaleX(0.9)`；回落时阴影 `scaleX(1.05)`，创造悬浮立体感\n- **disconnected 状态**: 灰度 + 透明度降低 + 浮动幅度加大\n- **sleeping 状态**: 呼吸周期放慢到 5s，轻微缩放 + 倾斜模拟趴卧\n- **anxious/alert 状态**: 叠加快速微抖 + glow 层变为暖红色\n- **barking 状态**: 轻微 scale 弹跳\n- **pacing 状态**: 水平漂移动画\n\n### 4. 图片映射机制\n\n在组件中新增一个映射函数，根据 `PetPose` 返回图片路径：\n\n``​`typescript\nfunction getPoseImage(pose: PetPose): string {\n  const map: Partial<Record<PetPose, string>> = {\n    idle: \"/pet/cat-idle.png\",\n    sleeping: \"/pet/cat-sleeping.png\",\n    // ... 后续按需增加\n  };\n  return map[pose] ?? \"/pet/cat-idle.png\";\n}\n``​`\n\n目前只有一张图，所有状态 fallback 到 `cat-idle.png`，区分状态靠 CSS 动画。后续用户添加新图片时只需更新这个映射。\n\n### 5. 涉及文件\n\n| 操作 | 文件 |\n|------|------|\n| 新增 | `frontend/public/pet/cat-idle.png` |\n| 重写 | [`frontend/src/components/PetAvatar.tsx`](frontend/src/components/PetAvatar.tsx) |\n| 重写 | [`frontend/src/components/PetAvatar.css`](frontend/src/components/PetAvatar.css) |\n\nDashboard 和其他引用 PetAvatar 的地方无需改动，接口不变。\n",

\"idle\";\n}\n\nfunction getPoseImage(pose: PetPose): string {\n  const map: Record<PetPose, string> = {\n    idle: \"/pet/cat-idle.webp\",\n    sleeping: \"/pet/cat-sleeping.webp\",\n    barking: \"/pet/cat-barking.webp\",\n    panting: \"/pet/cat-barking.webp\",\n    eating: \"/pet/cat-barking.webp\",\n    head_shaking: \"/pet/cat-curious.webp\",\n    scratching: \"/pet/cat-stretching.webp\",\n    pacing: \"/pet/cat-stretching.webp\",\n    disconnected: \"/pet/cat-disconnected.webp\",\n  };\n  return map[pose];\n}\n\ninterface PetAvatarProps {\n  className?: string;\n}\n\nexport default function PetAvatar({ className = \"\" }: PetAvatarProps) {\n  const { bleConnected, events, digitalTwinMood, currentActivity } = useStore();\n  const [bubbleText, setBubbleText] = useState(\"\");\n  const [imgLoaded, setImgLoaded] = useState(false);\n\n  const latestEvent = events[0];\n  const pose: PetPose =\n    latestEvent && bleConnected\n      ? \"disconnected\" : \"\"}`}>\n          <div className=\"pet-3d-container\">\n            {/* Glow layer: blurred copy for soft light base */}\n            <img\n              src={imageSrc}\n              alt=\"\"\n              aria-hidden\n              className=\"pet-glow\"\n              draggable={false}\n            />\n\n            {/* Main image */}\n            <img\n              src={imageSrc}\n              alt=\"宠物形象\"\n              className={`pet-main-image ${imgLoaded ? ## 改动内容

**1. 6 张小猫图片** -- `frontend/public/pet/`

原图 5-6MB 压缩为 webp 格式（每张仅 21-26KB），按姿态命名：

| 文件 | 对应姿态 |
|------|----------|
| `cat-idle.webp` | 默认待机 |
| `cat-sleeping.webp` | 睡眠 |
| `cat-barking.webp` | 叫唤/喘息/误食 |
| `cat-curious.webp` | 歪头/好奇 |
| `cat-stretching.webp` | 抓挠/踱步 |
| `cat-disconnected.webp` | 断连/无聊 |

**2. 多层立体效果** -- `PetAvatar.tsx` + `PetAvatar.css`

- **柔光底层 (.pet-glow)**: 同图模糊放大 + 半透明，形成发光光晕底座
- **主图层 (.pet-main-image)**: 小猫图片 + `drop-shadow` 双层阴影增强纵深
- **高光层 (.pet-highlight)**: 左上角白色径向渐变，模拟光照方向
- **椭圆阴影 (.pet-shadow)**: 与呼吸动画同步缩放，上浮时阴影缩小、下落时放大

**3. 各姿态动画**

- **idle**: 3s 柔和上下浮动 + 阴影同步 + 光晕脉冲
- **sleeping**: 5s 慢呼吸，光晕变柔
- **barking**: 弹跳动画
- **pacing**: 水平漂移
- **scratching**: 快速抖动
- **disconnected**: 灰度 + 慢飘浮 + 光晕减淡

 "contents": "import { BEHAVIOR_LABELS } from \"../types\";\nimport type { PetEvent } from \"../types\";\n\nfunction riskColor(type: string, confidence: number): string {\n  if ([\"foreign_eating\"].includes(type) && confidence > 60) return \"border-l-red-500\";\n  if (confidence > 70) return \"border-l-yellow-500\";\n  return \"border-l-gray-300\";\n}\n\ninterface Props {\n  event: PetEvent;\n  onClick: (event: PetEvent) => void;\n}\n\nexport default function EventListItem({ event, onClick }: Props) {\n  return (\n    <button\n      onClick={() => onClick(event)}\n      className={`w-full text-left bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border-l-4 ${riskColor(event.behavior_type, event.confidence)} border border-gray-100`}\n    >\n      <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n        <span className=\"font-medium\">\n          {BEHAVIOR_LABELS[event.behavior_type] || event.behavior_type}\n        </span>\n        <span className=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">\n          {new Date(event.timestamp).toLocaleString(\"zh-CN\")}\n        </span>\n      </div>\n      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3 mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500\">\n        <span>置信度 {event.confidence}%</span>\n        <span>持续 {(event.duration_ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s</span>\n        {event.intervention_done && <span className=\"text-indigo-600\">已干预</span>}\n        {event.user_feedback && <span className=\"text-green-600\">已反馈</span>}\n      </div>\n    </button>\n  );\n}\n"
}

event.intervention_result : \"无\"}</div>\n        </div>\n\n        <div>\n          <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500 mb-2\">您的反馈</p>\n          <div className=\"flex gap-2\">\n            {[\n              { key: \"false_alarm\", label: \"误报\" },\n              { key: \"helpful\", label: \"有帮助\" },\n              { key: \"visited_vet\", label: \"已就医\" },\n            ].map(({ key, label }) => (\n              <button\n                key={key}\n                onClick={() => onFeedback(event.id, key)}\n                className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium border transition-colors ${\n                  event.user_feedback === key\n                    ? \"bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-600\"\n                    : \"bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-100\"\n                }`}\n              >\n                {label}\n              </button>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <button\n          onClick={onClose}\n          className=\"w-full py-3 text-gray-500 text-sm\"\n        >\n          关闭\n        </button>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:/文档/Cursor/pet-collar/frontend/src/pages/Events.tsx",
 "contents": "import { useEffect, useState } from \"react\";\nimport { api } from \"../services/api\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport EventListItem from \"../components/EventListItem\";\nimport EventDetailModal from \"../components/EventDetailModal\";\nimport type { PetEvent } from \"../types\";\n\nexport default function Events() {\n  const { activePetId, events, setEvents } = useStore();\n  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<PetEvent | null>(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!activePetId) return;\n    setLoading(true);\n    (api.listEvents(activePetId) as Promise<PetEvent[]>)\n      .then(setEvents)\n      .catch(() => {})\n      .finally(() => setLoading(false));\n  }, [activePetId, setEvents]);\n\n  const handleFeedback = async (eventId: number, feedback: string) => {\n    await api.feedbackEvent(eventId, feedback);\n    setEvents(events.map((e) => (e.id === eventId ? { ...e, user_feedback: feedback } : e)));\n    setSelected(null);\n  };\n\n  if (!activePetId) {\n    return <div className=\"flex-1 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-500 p-6\">请先添加宠物</div>;\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex-1 p-4 pb-24\">\n      <h1 className=\"text-xl font-bold mb-4\">事件记录</h1>\n\n      {loading ? (\n        <div className=\"text-center text-gray-400 py-12\">加载中...</div>\n      ) : events.length === 0 ? (\n        <div className=\"text-center text-gray-400 py-12\">暂无事件</div>\n      ) : (\n        <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n          {events.map((evt) => (\n            <EventListItem key={evt.id} event={evt} onClick={setSelected} />\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {selected && (\n        <EventDetailModal\n          event={selected}\n          onClose={() => setSelected(null)}\n          onFeedback={handleFeedback}\n        />\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }\n  100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(var(--dx, 0), var(--dy, -40px)) scale(0.3); }\n}\n\n.star-particle {\n  position: absolute;\n  font-size: 14px;\n  pointer-events: none;\n  animation: star-burst 0.8s ease-out forwards;\n}\n\n@keyframes emoji-rain {\n  0% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }\n  100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(80px) scale(0.5); }\n}\n\n.emoji-particle {\n  position: absolute;\n  font-size: 20px;\n  pointer-events: none;\n  animation: emoji-rain 1.5s ease-in forwards;\n}\n\n/* -- Interactive pet stage (larger) -- */\n.interactive-pet-stage {\n  position: relative;\n  width: 260px;\n  height: 260px;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n}\n\n.interactive-pet-stage .pet-body {\n  position: absolute;\n  bottom: 30px;\n  left: 50%;\n  transform: translateX(-50%);\n  transition: opacity 0.5s;\n  cursor: pointer;\n}\n\n.interactive-pet-stage .pet-shadow {\n  position: absolute;\n  bottom: 16px;\n  left: 50%;\n  transform: translateX(-50%);\n  width: 100px;\n  height: 16px;\n  background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) 0%, transparent 70%);\n  border-radius: 50%;\n  animation: shadow-breathe 3s ease-in-out infinite;\n}\n\n.touch-ripple {\n  position: absolute;\n  border-radius: 50%;\n  background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15);\n  pointer-events: none;\n  animation: ripple-expand 0.6s ease-out forwards;\n}\n\n@keyframes ripple-expand {\n  0% { width: 0; height: 0; opacity: 1; }\n  100% { width: 80px; height: 80px; opacity: 0; margin-left: -40px; margin-top: -40px; }\n}"
}

default: return \"idle\";\n  }\n}\n\nfunction DogSVG({ pose, size = 180 }: { pose: PetPose; size?: number }) {\n  const isSleeping = pose === \"sleeping\";\n  const isBarking = pose === \"barking\";\n  const isEating = pose === \"eating\";\n  const isPanting = pose === \"panting\";\n  const isPetted = pose === \"petted\";\n  const isBellyRub = pose === \"belly_rub\";\n\n  return (\n    <svg      />\n      </g>\n\n      {/* Head */}\n      <g className=\"pet-head\" style={{ transformOrigin: \"48px 48px\" }}>\n        <ellipse cx=\"48\" cy=\"50\" rx=\"20\" ry=\"18\" fill=\"#D4A574\" />\n (\n            <>\n              <line x1=\"38\" y1=\"48\" x2=\"46\" y2=\"48\" stroke=\"#5C4033\" strokeWidth=\"2\" strokeLinecap=\"round\" />\n              <line x1=\"50\" y1=\"48\" x2=\"58\" y2=\"48\" stroke=\"#5C4033\" strokeWidth=\"2\" strokeLinecap=\"round\" />\n            </>\n          ) : (\n            <>\n              <circle cx=\"42\" cy=\"48\" r=\"3\" fill=\"#5C4033\" />\n              <circle cx=\"54\" cy=\"48\" r=\"3\" fill=\"#5C4033\" />\n              <circle cx=\"43\" cy=\"47\" r=\"1\" fill=\"white\" />\n              <circle cx=\"55\" cy=\"47\" r=\"1\" fill=\"white\" />\n            </>\n          )}\n        </g>\n\n        {/* Nose */}\n        <ellipse cx=\"48\" cy=\"55\" rx=\"3\" ry=\"2\" fill=\"#5C4033\" />\n\n        {/* Mouth */}\n        <g className=\"pet-mouth\">\n          {isBarking ? ry=\"4\" fill=\"#F87171\" />\n          </g>\n        )}\n\n        {/* Blush when petted */}\n        {(isPetted || isBellyRub) && (\n          <>\n            <circle cx=\"36\" cy=\"52\" r=\"4\" fill=\"#FBBF24\" opacity=\"0.25\" />\n            <circle cx=\"60\" cy=\"52\" r=\"4\" fill=\"#FBBF24\" opacity=\"0.25\" />\n          </>\n        )}\n      </g>\n\n      {/* Barking waves */}\n      {isBarking && (\n        <g>\n          <circle cx=\"75\" cy=\"48\" r=\"4\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#F59E0B\" strokeWidth=\"1.5\" opacity=\"0.6\">\n            <animate attributeName=\"r\" from=\"4\" to=\"12\" dur=\"0.6s\" repeatCount=\"indefinite\" />\n            <animate attributeName=\"opacity\" from=\"0.6\" to=\"0\" dur=\"0.6s\" repeatCount=\"indefinite\" />\n          </circle>\n        </g>\n      )}\n\n      {/* Alert glow */}\n      {isEating && (\n        <circle cx=\"60\" cy=\"70\" r=\"35\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#EF4444\" strokeWidth=\"2\" opacity=\"0.3\">\n          <animate attributeName=\"r\" from=\"35\" to=\"45\" dur=\"1.5s\" repeatCount=\"indefinite\" />\n          <animate attributeName=\"opacity\" from=\"0.3\" to=\"0\" dur=\"1.5s\" repeatCount=\"indefinite\" />\n        </circle>\n      )}\n    </svg>\n  );\n}\n\ninterface Particle {\n  id: number;\n  emoji: string;\n  x: number;\n  y: number;\n  dx: number;\n  dy: number;\n  className: string;\n}\n\nlet particleId = 0;\n\nexport default function InteractivePetAvatar() {\n  const {\n    bleConnected, events, digitalTwinMood, currentActivity,\n    overridePose, setOverridePose, bumpIntimacy, setLastInteraction,\n  } = useStore();\n\n  const [bubbleText, setBubbleText] = useState(\"\");\n  const [particles, setParticles] = useState<Particle[]>([]);\n  const stageRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);\n  const poseTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();\n\n  const latestEvent = events[0];\n  const basePose: PetPose = latestEvent && bleConnected\n    ? (latestEvent.behavior_type as PetPose) || \"idle\"\n    : derivePose(currentActivity, bleConnected);\n\n  const pose = (overridePose as PetPose) || basePose;\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const pickBubble = () => {\n      const mood: DigitalTwinMood = bleConnected ? digitalTwinMood : \"bored\";\n      const pool = MOOD_BUBBLES[mood];\n      setBubbleText(pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)]);\n    };\n    pickBubble();\n    const timer = setInterval(pickBubble, 8000);\n    return () => clearInterval(timer);\n  }, [bleConnected, digitalTwinMood]);\n\n  const spawnParticles = useCallback((emoji: string, x: number, y: number, count: number, cls: string) => {\n    const newParticles: Particle[] = [];\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      newParticles.push({\n        id: ++particleId,\n        emoji,\n        x,\n        y,\n        dx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 60,\n        dy: -(Math.random() * 40 + 20),\n        className: cls,\n      });\n    }\n    setParticles((prev) => [...prev, ...newParticles]);\n    setTimeout(() => {\n      setParticles((prev) => prev.filter((p) => !newParticles.includes(p)));\n    }, 1500);\n  }, []);\n\n  const triggerPose = useCallback((newPose: string, durationMs: number) => {\n    if (poseTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(poseTimerRef.current);\n    setOverridePose(newPose);\n    poseTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setOverridePose(null), durationMs);\n  }, [setOverridePose]);\n\n  const handleTouch = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {\n    const rect = stageRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();\n    if (!rect) return;\n\n    const relY = (e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height;\n    const relX = e.clientX - rect.left;\n\n    if (relY < 0.45) {\n      triggerPose(\"petted\", 2000);\n      spawnParticles(\"\\u2764\\uFE0F\", relX, e.clientY - rect.top, 4, \"heart-particle\");\n      bumpIntimacy(2);\n      setLastInteraction({ type: \"pet_head\", timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });\n      setBubbleText(\"好舒服~再摸摸\");\n    } else if (relY < 0.75) {\n      triggerPose(\"belly_rub\", 2500);\n      spawnParticles(\"\\u2B50\", relX, e.clientY - rect.top, 5, \"star-particle\");\n      bumpIntimacy(3);\n      setLastInteraction({ type: \"belly_rub\", timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });\n      setBubbleText(\"嘿嘿~好痒呀！\");\n    } else {\n      triggerPose(\"idle\", 1000);\n      spawnParticles(\"\\u2728\", relX, e.clientY - rect.top, 3, \"star-particle\");\n      bumpIntimacy(1);\n      setLastInteraction({ type: \"tap\", timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });\n    }\n  }, [triggerPose, spawnParticles, bumpIntimacy, setLastInteraction]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    return () => {\n      if (poseTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(poseTimerRef.current);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  const bgGradient = bleConnected\n    ? \"from-blue-50 via-indigo-50 to-purple-50\"\n    : \"from-gray-100 via-gray-50 to-gray-100\";\n\n  return (\n    <div className={`relative rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br ${bgGradient} p-6`}>\n      <div\n        ref={stageRef}\n        className={`interactive-pet-stage pose-${pose}`}\n        onClick={handleTouch}\n      >\n        {/* Mood bubble */}\n        <div className=\"mood-bubble\">{bubbleText}</div>\n\n        {/* Pet body */}\n        <div className={`pet-body ${!bleConnected ? \"disconnected\" : \"\"}`}>\n          <DogSVG pose={pose} size={180} />\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Shadow */}\n        <div className=\"pet-shadow\" />\n\n        {/* Sleep ZZZ */}\n        {pose === \"sleeping\" && <div className=\"zzz-float\">💤</div>}\n\n        {/* Particles */}\n        {particles.map((p) => (\n          <span\n            key={p.id}\n            className={p.className}\n            style={{\n              left: p.x,\n              top: p.y,\n              \"--dx\": `${p.dx}px`,\n              \"--dy\": `${p.dy}px`,\n            } as React.CSSProperties}\n          >\n            {p.emoji}\n          </span>\n        ))}\n\n        {/* Disconnected indicator */}\n        {!bleConnected && (\n          <div className=\"absolute bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 text-xs text-gray-400 bg-white/80 px-3 py-1 rounded-full shadow-sm\">\n            📡 信号未连接\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n\n      <p className=\"text-center text-xs text-gray-400 mt-2\">点击宠物可以互动哦~</p>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport { MOOD_LABELS } from \"../types\";\nimport type { DigitalTwinMood } from \"../types\";\n\nconst MOOD_NUMERIC: Record<DigitalTwinMood, number> = {\n  anxious: 1,\n  bored: 2,\n  calm: 3,\n  sleepy: 3,\n  happy: 5,\n};\n\nexport default function MoodPanel() {\n  const { digitalTwinMood, intimacyScore, moodHistory } = useStore();\n  const moodInfo = MOOD_LABELS[digitalTwinMood];\n\n  const chartData = useMemo(() => {\n    if (moodHistory.length === 0) return [];\n    return moodHistory.map((r) => ({\n      time: new Date(r.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString(\"zh-CN\", { hour: \"2-digit\", minute: \"2-digit\" }),\n      value: MOOD_NUMERIC[r.mood] ?? 3,\n      label: MOOD_LABELS[r.mood]?.text ?? r.mood,\n    }));\n  }, [moodHistory]);\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n      <p className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-3\">心情状态</p>\n\n      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-4\">\n        {/* Current mood */}\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 flex-1\">\n          <span className=\"text-3xl\">{moodInfo.emoji}</span>\n          <div>\n            <p className=\"text-base font-semibold text-gray-800\">{moodInfo.text}</p>\n            <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">当前心情</p>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Intimacy ring */}\n        <ScoreRing\n          score={intimacyScore}\n          color=\"#ec4899\"\n          label=\"亲密度\"\n          size={56}\n          strokeWidth={5}\n        />\n      </div>\n\n      {/* 24h mood chart */}\n      {chartData.length >= 2 && (\n        <div className=\"mt-4\">\n          <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-400 mb-2\">心情变化</p>\n          <ResponsiveContainer width=\"100%\" height={80}>\n            <LineChart data={chartData}>\n              <XAxis\n                dataKey=\"time\"\n                tick={{ fontSize: 10 }}\n                axisLine={false}\n                tickLine={false}\n                interval=\"preserveStartEnd\"\n              />\n              <YAxis domain={[0, 5]} hide />\n              <Tooltip\n                contentStyle={{ fontSize: 12, borderRadius: 8, border: \"1px solid #e5e7eb\" }}\n                formatter={(value: number, _: string, entry: { payload: { label: string } }) => [entry.payload.label, \"心情\"]}\n                labelFormatter={(label: string) => label}\n              />\n              <Line\n                type=\"monotone\"\n                dataKey=\"value\"\n                stroke=\"#a78bfa\"\n                strokeWidth={2}\n                dot={{ r: 2 }}\n                activeDot={{ r: 4 }}\n              />\n            </LineChart>\n          </ResponsiveContainer>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"

 "contents": "import { useState, useCallback, useRef } from \"react\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\n\ninterface ActionDef {\n  key: string;\n  icon: string;\n  label: string;\n  color: string;\n  pose: string;\n  moodEffect: \"happy\" | \"calm\";\n  cooldownMs: number;\n  particleEmoji: string;\n}\n\nconst ACTIONS: ActionDef[] = [\n  { key: \"feed\", icon: \"🍖\", label: \"喂食\", color: \"bg-orange-50 text-orange-500\", pose: \"eating\", moodEffect: \"happy\", cooldownMs: 10000, particleEmoji: \"🍖\" },\n  { key: \"play\", icon: \"🎾\", label: \"玩耍\", color: \"bg-green-50 text-green-500\", pose: \"playing_ball\", moodEffect: \"happy\", cooldownMs: 8000, particleEmoji: \"🎾\" },\n  { key: \"groom\", icon: \"✨\", label: \"梳毛\", color: \"bg-purple-50 text-purple-500\", pose: \"grooming\", moodEffect: \"calm\", cooldownMs: 12000, particleEmoji: \"✨\" },\n  { key: \"bath\", icon: \"🛁\", label: \"洗澡\", color: \"bg-blue-50 text-blue-500\", pose: \"bathing\", moodEffect: \"calm\", cooldownMs: 15000, particleEmoji: \"💧\" },\n];\n\nexport default function VirtualActions() {\n  const { setOverridePose, setDigitalTwinMood, bumpIntimacy, setLastInteraction } = useStore();\n  const [cooldowns, setCooldowns] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});\n  const [activeEmojis, setActiveEmojis] = useState<{ id: number; emoji: string; x: number }[]>([]);\n  const emojiId = useRef(0);\n\n  const isOnCooldown = (key: string) => {\n    const until = cooldowns[key];\n    return until ? Date.now() < until : false;\n  };\n\n  const handleAction = useCallback((action: ActionDef) => {\n    if (isOnCooldown(action.key)) return;\n\n    setCooldowns((prev) => ({ ...prev, [action.key]: Date.now() + action.cooldownMs }));\n\n    setOverridePose(action.pose);\n    setTimeout(() => setOverridePose(null), 2500);\n\n    setDigitalTwinMood(action.moodEffect);\n    bumpIntimacy(3);\n    setLastInteraction({ type: action.key, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });\n\n    const newEmojis = Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, i) => ({\n      id: ++emojiId.current,\n      emoji: action.particleEmoji,\n      x: 20 + Math.random() * 60,\n    }));\n    setActiveEmojis((prev) => [...prev, ...newEmojis]);\n    setTimeout(() => {\n      setActiveEmojis((prev) => prev.filter((e) => !newEmojis.includes(e)));\n    }, 1500);\n  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps\n  }, [cooldowns, setOverridePose, setDigitalTwinMood, bumpIntimacy, setLastInteraction]);\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100 relative overflow-hidden\">\n      <p className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-3\">虚拟互动</p>\n      <div className=\"grid grid-cols-4 gap-3\">\n        {ACTIONS.map((action) => {\n          const onCd = isOnCooldown(action.key);\n          return (\n            <button\n              key={action.key}\n              onClick={() => handleAction(action)}\n              disabled={onCd}\n              className={`flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 py-3 rounded-xl transition-all active:scale-95 ${\n                onCd ? \"opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed\" : \"\"\n              }`}\n            >\n              <span className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xl ${action.color}`}>\n                {action.icon}\n              </span>\n              <span className=\"text-xs text-gray-600\">{action.label}</span>\n            </button>\n          );\n        })}\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Emoji particles */}\n      {activeEmojis.map((e) => (\n        <span\n          key={e.id}\n          className=\"emoji-particle\"\n          style={{ left: `${e.x}%`, top: \"10px\" }}\n        >\n          {e.emoji}\n        </span>\n      ))}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "path": "d:/文档/Cursor/pet-collar/frontend/src/components/SensorPanel.tsx",
 "contents": "import { useMemo } from \"react\";\nimport ScoreRing from \"./ScoreRing\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport { ACTIVITY_LABELS } from \"../types\";\nimport type { PetEvent } from \"../types\";\n\nfunction computeActivityScore(events: PetEvent[]): number {\n  const todayEvents = events.filter(\n    (e) => new Date(e.timestamp).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString(),\n  );\n  if (todayEvents.length === 0) return 0;\n  const base = Math.min(todayEvents.length * 8, 60);\n  const variety = new Set(todayEvents.map((e) => e.behavior_type)).size;\n  return Math.min(base + variety * 10, 100);\n}\n\nfunction formatAwayDuration(seconds: number): string {\n  if (seconds < 60) return \"--\";\n  if (seconds < 3600) return `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}分`;\n  const h = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);\n  const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);\n  return m > 0 ? `${h}时${m}分` : `${h}时`;\n}\n\nexport default function SensorPanel() {\n  const { events, currentActivity, bleConnected, awayDuration } = useStore();\n\n  const activityScore = useMemo(() => computeActivityScore(events), [events]);\n  const activityInfo = ACTIVITY_LABELS[currentActivity] ?? ACTIVITY_LABELS.unknown;\n  const todayCount = events.filter(\n    (e) => new Date(e.timestamp).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString(),\n  ).length;\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n      <p className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-3\">实时状态</p>\n      <div className=\"grid grid-cols-4 gap-2\">\n        {/* Activity score */}\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center\">\n          <ScoreRing score={activityScore} color=\"#6366f1\" label=\"活动量\" size={48} strokeWidth={4} />\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Current behavior */}\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center\">\n          <span className=\"text-xl\">{activityInfo.icon}</span>\n          <span className=\"text-[10px] text-gray-500 mt-1\">{activityInfo.label}</span>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* BLE / away */}\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center\">\n          <span className=\"text-xl\">{bleConnected ? \"📶\" : \"📡\"}</span>\n          <span className=\"text-[10px] text-gray-500 mt-1\">\n            {bleConnected ? \"已连接\" : formatAwayDuration(awayDuration) || \"离线\"}\n          </span>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Today events */}\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center\">\n          <span className=\"text-xl font-bold text-gray-800\">{todayCount}</span>\n          <span className=\"text-[10px] text-gray-500 mt-1\">今日事件</span>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

<div\n                className={`max-w-[80%] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs leading-relaxed ${\n                  msg.role === \"user\"\n                    ? \"bg-indigo-500 text-white     ))\n        )}\n        {sending && (\n          <div className=\"flex justify-start\">\n            <span className=\"w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-amber-100 flex items-center justify-center text-xs mr-1.5\">\n              🐶\n            </span>\n            <div className=\"bg-gray-100 text-gray-400 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl rounded-bl-sm text-xs\">\n              <span className=\"inline-flex gap-0.5\">\n                <span className=\"animate-bounce\">·</span>\n                <span className=\"animate-bounce\" style={{ animationDelay: \"0.1s\" }}>·</span>\n                <span className=\"animate-bounce\" style={{ animationDelay: \"0.2s\" }}>·</span>\n              </span>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Quick questions */}\n      <div className=\"px-4 pb-2 flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto\">\n        {QUICK_QUESTIONS.map((q) => (\n          <button\n            key={q}\n            onClick={() => sendMessage(q)}\n            disabled={sending}\n            className=\"whitespace-nowrap px-2.5 py-1 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-full text-[10px] text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-100 active:scale-95 transition-transform flex-shrink-0 disabled:opacity-40\"\n          >\n            {q}\n          </button>\n        ))}\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Input */}\n      <form\n        onSubmit={handleSubmit}\n        className=\"px-4 py-3 flex gap-2 border-t border-gray-50\"\n      >\n        <input\n          type=\"text\"\n          value={input}\n          onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}\n          placeholder={`对${petName}说点什么...`}\n          className=\"flex-1 bg-gray-100 rounded-full px-3 py-2 text-xs outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-200\"\n          disabled={sending}\n        />\n        <button\n          type=\"submit\"\n          disabled={!input.trim() || sending}\n          className=\"w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-indigo-500 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-xs disabled:opacity-40 active:scale-95 transition-transform\"\n        >\n          ↑\n        </button>\n      </form>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"

 "contents": "import { useMemo } from \"react\";\nimport { LineChart, Line, XAxis, YAxis, ResponsiveContainer, Tooltip } from \"recharts\";\nimport ScoreRing from \"./ScoreRing\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport { MOOD_LABELS } from \"../types\";\nimport type { DigitalTwinMood } from \"../types\";\n\nconst MOOD_SCORE: Record<DigitalTwinMood, number> = {\n  happy: 5,\n  calm: 4,\n  bored: 3,\n  anxious: 2,\n  sleepy: 3,\n};\n\nexport default function MoodPanel() {\n  const { digitalTwinMood, intimacyScore, moodHistory } = useStore();\n  const moodInfo = MOOD_LABELS[digitalTwinMood];\n\n  const chartData = useMemo(() => {\n    if (moodHistory.length === 0) {\n      const now = Date.now();\n      return Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => ({\n        time: new Date(now - (5 - i) * 4 * 3600000).toLocaleTimeString(\"zh-CN\", { hour: \"2-digit\", minute: \"2-digit\" }),\n        score: MOOD_SCORE[digitalTwinMood],\n      }));\n    }\n    const last24h = moodHistory.filter(\n      (r) => Date.now() - new Date(r.timestamp).getTime() < 24 * 3600000,\n    );\n    const buckets: Record<string, number[]> = {};\n    for (const r of last24h) {\n      const hour = new Date(r.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString(\"zh-CN\", { hour: \"2-digit\", minute: \"2-digit\" });\n      if (!buckets[hour]) buckets[hour] = [];\n      buckets[hour].push(MOOD_SCORE[r.mood] ?? 3);\n    }\n    return Object.entries(buckets).map(([time, scores]) => ({\n      time,\n      score: Math.round(scores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / scores.length),\n    }));\n  }, [moodHistory, digitalTwinMood]);\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n      <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500 mb-3\">心情仪表盘</p>\n\n      <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between mb-4\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n          <span className=\"text-4xl\">{moodInfo.emoji}</span>\n          <div>\n            <p className=\"font-semibold text-gray-800\">当前心情: {moodInfo.text}</p>\n            <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">基于实时传感器数据推断</p>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        <ScoreRing score={intimacyScore} color=\"#ec4899\" label=\"亲密度\" size={56} strokeWidth={5} />\n      </div>\n\n      <div>\n        <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-400 mb-2\">24小时心情变化</p>\n        <ResponsiveContainer width=\"100%\" height={80}>\n          <LineChart data={chartData}>\n            <XAxis dataKey=\"time\" tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} />\n            <YAxis domain={[1, 5]} hide />\n            <Tooltip\n              contentStyle={{ fontSize: 11, borderRadius: 8, border: \"1px solid #e5e7eb\" }}\n              formatter={(v: number) => {\n                const labels = [\"\", \"焦虑\", \"不安\", \"一般\", \"平静\", \"开心\"];\n                return [labels[v] || v, \"心情\"];\n              }}\n            />\n            <Line\n              type=\"monotone\"\n              dataKey=\"score\"\n              stroke=\"#a855f7\"\n              strokeWidth={2}\n              dot={false}\n            />\n          </LineChart>\n        </ResponsiveContainer>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "import { useState, useCallback } from \"react\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\n\ninterface ActionDef {\n  key: string;\n  icon: string;\n  label: string;\n  cooldown: number;\n  moodEffect: \"happy\" | \"calm\";\n  particles: string[];\n}\n\nconst ACTIONS: ActionDef[] = [\n  { key: \"feed\", icon: \"🍖\", label: \"喂食\", cooldown: 15000, moodEffect: \"happy\", particles: [\"🍖\", \"🦴\", \"😋\"] },\n  { key: \"play\", icon: \"🎾\", label: \"玩耍\", cooldown: 20000, moodEffect: \"happy\", particles: [\"🎾\", \"🐾\", \"🎉\"] },\n  { key: \"groom\", icon: \"✨\", label: \"梳毛\", cooldown: 15000, moodEffect: \"calm\", particles: [\"✨\", \"💫\", \"🪮\"] },\n  { key: \"bath\", icon: \"🫧\", label: \"洗澡\", cooldown: 30000, moodEffect: \"calm\", particles: [\"🫧\", \"💧\", \"🧼\"] },\n];\n\nexport default function VirtualActions() {\n  const { setDigitalTwinMood, intimacyScore, setIntimacyScore, setLastInteraction, addMoodRecord } = useStore();\n  const [cooldowns, setCooldowns] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});\n  const [activeParticles, setActiveParticles] = useState<{ id: number; emoji: string; x: number; y: number }[]>([]);\n\n  const handleAction = useCallback((action: ActionDef) => {\n    if (cooldowns[action.key] && Date.now() < cooldowns[action.key]) return;\n\n    setCooldowns((prev) => ({ ...prev, [action.key]: Date.now() + action.cooldown }));\n\n    setDigitalTwinMood(action.moodEffect);\n    setIntimacyScore(Math.min(intimacyScore + 2, 100));\n    setLastInteraction({ type: action.key, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });\n    addMoodRecord({ mood: action.moodEffect, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });\n\n    const newParticles = action.particles.map((emoji, i) => ({\n      id: Date.now() + i,\n      emoji,\n      x: 30 + Math.random() * 40,\n      y: 20 + Math.random() * 30,\n    }));\n    setActiveParticles(newParticles);\n    setTimeout(() => setActiveParticles([]), 1500);\n\n    setTimeout(() => {\n      setCooldowns((prev) => {\n        const next = { ...prev };\n        delete next[action.key];\n        return next;\n      });\n    }, action.cooldown);\n  }, [cooldowns, setDigitalTwinMood, intimacyScore, setIntimacyScore, setLastInteraction, addMoodRecord]);\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100 relative overflow-hidden\">\n      <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500 mb-3\">虚拟互动</p>\n      <div className=\"flex justify-around\">\n        {ACTIONS.map((action) => {\n          const onCooldown = cooldowns[action.key] && Date.now() < cooldowns[action.key];\n          return (\n            <button\n              key={action.key}\n              onClick={() => handleAction(action)}\n              disabled={!!onCooldown}\n              className={`flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 transition-all active:scale-90 ${\n                onCooldown ? \"opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed\" : \"cursor-pointer\"\n              }`}\n            >\n              <div className={`w-14 h-14 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-2xl transition-all ${\n                onCooldown ? \"bg-gray-100\" : \"bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-50 to-purple-50 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md\"\n              }`}>\n                {action.icon}\n              </div>\n              <span className=\"text-xs text-gray-600\">{action.label}</span>\n            </button>\n          );\n        })}\n      </div>\n\n      {activeParticles.map((p) => (\n        <span\n          key={p.id}\n          className=\"particle-float\"\n          style={{ position: \"absolute\", left: `${p.x}%`, top: `${p.y}%`, fontSize: 20, zIndex: 10 }}\n        >\n          {p.emoji}\n        </span>\n      ))}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}
