 "contents": "import { useMemo } from \"react\";\nimport ScoreRing from \"./ScoreRing\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport { ACTIVITY_LABELS } from \"../types\";\nimport type { PetEvent } from \"../types\";\n\nfunction computeActivityScore(events: PetEvent[]): number {\n  const todayEvents = events.filter(\n    (e) => new Date(e.timestamp).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString(),\n  );\n  if (todayEvents.length === 0) return 0;\n  const base = Math.min(todayEvents.length * 8, 60);\n  const variety = new Set(todayEvents.map((e) => e.behavior_type)).size;\n  return Math.min(base + variety * 10, 100);\n}\n\nfunction formatAwayDuration(seconds: number): string {\n  if (seconds < 60) return \"--\";\n  if (seconds < 3600) return `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}分`;\n  const h = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);\n  const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);\n  return m > 0 ? `${h}时${m}分` : `${h}时`;\n}\n\nexport default function SensorPanel() {\n  const { events, currentActivity, bleConnected, awayDuration } = useStore();\n\n  const activityScore = useMemo(() => computeActivityScore(events), [events]);\n\n  const activityInfo = ACTIVITY_LABELS[currentActivity] ?? ACTIVITY_LABELS.unknown;\n\n  const todayEventCount = useMemo(\n    () => events.filter((e) => new Date(e.timestamp).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString()).length,\n    [events],\n  );\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n      <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500 mb-3\">实时状态</p>\n      <div className=\"grid grid-cols-4 gap-2\">\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center\">\n          <ScoreRing score={activityScore} color=\"#6366f1\" label=\"活动量\" size={48} strokeWidth={4} />\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center gap-1\">\n          <div className=\"w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-amber-50 flex items-center justify-center text-xl\">\n            {activityInfo.icon}\n          </div>\n          <span className=\"text-xs text-gray-500\">{activityInfo.label}</span>\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center gap-1\">\n          <div className=\"w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-blue-50 flex items-center justify-center\">\n            <span className={`w-3 h-3 rounded-full ${bleConnected ? \"bg-green-500\" : \"bg-gray-400\"}`} />\n          </div>\n          <span className=\"text-xs text-gray-500\">\n            {bleConnected ? \"在家\" : formatAwayDuration(awayDuration)}\n          </span>\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center gap-1\">\n          <div className=\"w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-rose-50 flex items-center justify-center text-lg font-bold text-rose-500\">\n            {todayEventCount}\n          </div>\n          <span className=\"text-xs text-gray-500\">今日事件</span>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "import { useState } from \"react\";\nimport { useNavigate } from \"react-router-dom\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport { api } from \"../services/api\";\nimport type { ChatMessage } from \"../types\";\n\nconst QUICK_QUESTIONS = [\n  \"你现在开心吗？\",\n  \"今天做了什么？\",\n  \"想我了吗？\",\n];\n\nexport default function MiniChat() {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const { chatMessages, addChatMessage, activePetId, pets } = useStore();\n  const [input, setInput] = useState(\"\");\n  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);\n\n  const pet = pets.find((p) => p.id === activePetId);\n  const petName = pet?.name ?? \"宠物\";\n\n  const recentMessages = chatMessages.slice(-3);\n\n  const sendMessage = async (text: string) => {\n    if (!text.trim() || !activePetId || sending) return;\n\n    const userMsg: ChatMessage = {\n      id: `u-${Date.now()}`,\n      role: \"user\",\n      content: text.trim(),\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n    addChatMessage(userMsg);\n    setInput(\"\");\n    setSending(true);\n\n    try {\n      const res = await api.petChat(activePetId, text.trim());\n      const petMsg: ChatMessage = {\n        id: `p-${Date.now()}`,\n        role: \"pet\",\n        content: res.reply,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      };\n      addChatMessage(petMsg);\n    } catch {\n      const errMsg: ChatMessage = {\n        id: `e-${Date.now()}`,\n        role: \"pet\",\n        content: `汪...${petName}暂时无法回复～`,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      };\n      addChatMessage(errMsg);\n    } finally {\n      setSending(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    sendMessage(input);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden\">\n      <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between px-4 pt-3 pb-2\">\n        <p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500\">和{petName}聊天</p>\n        <button\n          onClick={() => navigate(\"/pet-chat\")}\n          className=\"text-xs text-indigo-500 hover:text-indigo-600\"\n        >\n          展开全屏 →\n        </button>\n      </div>\n\n      <div className=\"px-4 space-y-2 max-h-36 overflow-y-auto\">\n        {recentMessages.length === 0 ? (\n          <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-400 text-center py-3\">开始和{petName}聊天吧~</p>\n        ) : (\n          recentMessages.map((msg) => (\n            <div\n              key={msg.id}\n              className={`flex ${msg.role === \"user\" ? \"justify-end\" : \"justify-start\"}`}\n            >\n              {msg.role === \"pet\" && (\n                <div className=\"w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-amber-100 flex items-center justify-center text-xs mr-1.5 flex-shrink-0 self-end\">\n                  🐶\n                </div>\n              )}\n              <div\n                className={`max-w-[75%] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs leading-relaxed ${\n                  msg.role === \"user\"\n                    ? \"bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-br-sm\"\n                    : \"bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 rounded-bl-sm\"\n                }`}\n              >\n                {msg.content}\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          ))\n        )}\n        {sending && (\n          <div className=\"flex justify-start\">\n            <div className=\"w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-amber-100 flex items-center justify-center text-xs mr-1.5\">\n              🐶\n            </div>\n            <div className=\"bg-gray-100 text-gray-400 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl rounded-bl-sm text-xs\">\n              <span className=\"inline-flex gap-0.5\">\n                <span className=\"animate-bounce\">·</span>\n                <span className=\"animate-bounce\" style={{ animationDelay: \"0.1s\" }}>·</span>\n                <span className=\"animate-bounce\" style={{ animationDelay: \"0.2s\" }}>·</span>\n              </span>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n\n      {chatMessages.length < 3 && (\n        <div className=\"px-4 py-2 flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto\">\n          {QUICK_QUESTIONS.map((q) => (\n            <button\n              key={q}\n              onClick={() => sendMessage(q)}\n              className=\"whitespace-nowrap px-2.5 py-1 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-full text-[10px] text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 active:scale-95 transition-transform flex-shrink-0\"\n            >\n              {q}\n            </button>\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className=\"flex gap-2 px-4 py-3 border-t border-gray-100\">\n        <input\n          type=\"text\"\n          value={input}\n          onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}\n          placeholder={`对${petName}说点什么...`}\n          className=\"flex-1 bg-gray-100 rounded-full px-3 py-2 text-xs outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-200\"\n          disabled={sending}\n        />\n        <button\n          type=\"submit\"\n          disabled={!input.trim() || sending}\n          className=\"w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-indigo-500 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-sm disabled:opacity-40 active:scale-95 transition-transform\"\n        >\n          ↑\n        </button>\n      </form>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\frontend\\src\\pages\\Events.tsx",
 "contents": "import { useEffect, useState } from \"react\";\nimport { api } from \"../services/api\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport EventListItem from \"../components/EventListItem\";\nimport EventDetailModal from \"../components/EventDetailModal\";\nimport type { PetEvent } from \"../types\";\n\nexport default function Events() {\n  const { activePetId, events, setEvents } = useStore();\n  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<PetEvent | null>(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!activePetId) return;\n    setLoading(true);\n    (api.listEvents(activePetId) as Promise<PetEvent[]>)\n      .then(setEvents)\n      .catch(() => {})\n      .finally(() => setLoading(false));\n  }, [activePetId, setEvents]);\n\n  const handleFeedback = async (eventId: number, feedback: string) => {\n    await api.feedbackEvent(eventId, feedback);\n    setEvents(events.map((e) => (e.id === eventId ? { ...e, user_feedback: feedback } : e)));\n    setSelected(null);\n  };\n\n  if (!activePetId) {\n    return <div className=\"flex-1 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-500 p-6\">请先添加宠物</div>;\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex-1 p-4 pb-24\">\n      <h1 className=\"text-xl font-bold mb-4\">事件记录</h1>\n\n      {loading ? (\n        <div className=\"text-center text-gray-400 py-12\">加载中...</div>\n      ) : events.length === 0 ? (\n        <div className=\"text-center text-gray-400 py-12\">暂无事件</div>\n      ) : (\n        <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n          {events.map((evt) => (\n            <EventListItem key={evt.id} event={evt} onClick={setSelected} />\n          ))}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {selected && (\n        <EventDetailModal\n          event={selected}\n          onClose={() => setSelected(null)}\n          onFeedback={handleFeedback}\n        />\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

mapEventToPose(latestEvent.behavior_type)\n    : derivePose(currentActivity, bleConnected);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const pickBubble = () => {\n      const mood: DigitalTwinMood = bleConnected ? digitalTwinMood : \"bored\";\n      const pool = MOOD_BUBBLES[mood];\n      setBubbleText(pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)]);\n    };\n    pickBubble();\n    const timer = setInterval(pickBubble, 8000);\n    return () => clearInterval(timer);\n  }, [bleConnected, digitalTwinMood]);\n\n  const spawnParticles = useCallback((x: number, y: number, emoji: string, count = 3) => {\n    const newParticles: Particle[] = [];\n    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n      newParticles.push({\n        id: particleId.current++,\n        x: x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 60,\n        y: y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40,\n        emoji,\n      });\n    }\n    setParticles((prev) => [...prev, ...newParticles]);\n    setTimeout(() => {\n      setParticles((prev) => prev.filter((p) => !newParticles.includes(p)));\n    }, 1200);\n  }, []);\n\n  const handleTouch = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent) => {\n    if (!stageRef.current) return;\n    const rect = stageRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();\n    const clientX = \"touches\" in e ? e.touches[0].clientX : e.clientX;\n    const clientY = \"touches\" in e ? e.touches[0].clientY : e.clientY;\n    const relX = clientX - rect.left;\n    const relY = clientY - rect.top;\n    const normY = relY / rect.height;\n\n    if (normY < 0.45) {\n      setInteractionPose(\"petted\");\n      spawnParticles(relX, relY, \"\\u2764\\uFE0F\", 4);\n      setIntimacyScore(intimacyScore + 1);\n      setLastInteraction({ type: \"pet_head\", timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });\n    } else if (normY < 0.75) {\n      setInteractionPose(\"belly-rub\");\n      spawnParticles(relX, relY, \"\\u2B50\", 3);\n      setIntimacyScore(intimacyScore + 1);\n      setLastInteraction({ type: \"belly_rub\", timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });\n    } else {\n      spawnParticles(relX, relY, \"\\u2728\", 2);\n    }\n\n    setTimeout(() => setInteractionPose(null), 1500);\n  }, [intimacyScore, setIntimacyScore, setLastInteraction, spawnParticles]);\n\n  const bgGradient = bleConnected\n    ? \"from-blue-50 via-indigo-50 to-purple-50\"\n    : \"from-gray-100 via-gray-50 to-gray-100\";\n\n  const poseClass = interactionPose\n    ? `pose-${interactionPose}`\n    : `pose-${pose}`;\n\n  return (\n    <div className={`relative rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br ${bgGradient} p-6`}>\n      <div\n        ref={stageRef}\n        className={`pet-stage pet-stage-large ${poseClass}`}\n        onClick={handleTouch}\n        onTouchStart={handleTouch}\n      >\n        <div className=\"mood-bubble\">{bubbleText}</div>\n\n        <div className={`pet-body ${!bleConnected ? \"disconnected\" : \"\"}`}>\n          <InteractiveDogSVG pose={pose} interactionPose={interactionPose} />\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"pet-shadow\" />\n\n        {pose === \"sleeping\" && !interactionPose && <div className=\"zzz-float\">💤</div>}\n\n        {!bleConnected && (\n          <div className=\"absolute bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 text-xs text-gray-400 bg-white/80 px-3 py-1 rounded-full shadow-sm\">\n            📡 信号未连接\n          </div>\n        )}\n\n        {particles.map((p) => (\n          <span\n            key={p.id}\n            className=\"particle-float\"\n            style={{ left: p.x, top: p.y, position: \"absolute\" }}\n          >\n            {p.emoji}\n          </span>\n        ))}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

3,\n      label: MOOD_LABELS[r.mood]?.text ?? r.mood,\n    }));\n  }, [moodHistory]);\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n      <p className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-3\">心情仪表盘</p>\n\n      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-4 mb-4\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n          <span className=\"text-3xl\">{moodInfo.emoji}</span>\n          <div>\n            <p className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-800\">{moodInfo.text}</p>\n            <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">当前心情</p>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"ml-auto\">\n          <ScoreRing\n            score={intimacyScore}\n            color=\"#ec4899\"\n            label=\"亲密度\"\n            size={56}\n            strokeWidth={5}\n          />\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {chartData.length > 1 && (\n        <div>\n          <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-400 mb-2\">心情变化</p>\n          <ResponsiveContainer width=\"100%\" height={80}>\n            <LineChart data={chartData}>\n              <XAxis dataKey=\"time\" tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} axisLine={false} tickLine={false} />\n              <YAxis domain={[0, 6]} hide />\n              <Tooltip\n                contentStyle={{ fontSize: 12, borderRadius: 8, border: \"1px solid #e5e7eb\" }}\n                formatter={(value: number, _name: string, props: { payload: { label: string } }) => [props.payload.label, \"心情\"]}\n              />\n              <Line\n                type=\"monotone\"\n                dataKey=\"score\"\n                stroke=\"#8b5cf6\"\n                strokeWidth={2}\n                dot={false}\n              />\n            </LineChart>\n          </ResponsiveContainer>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"

cooldown: number;\n}\n\nconst ACTIONS: VirtualAction[] = [\n  { key: \"feed\", label: \"喂食\", icon: \"🍖\", cooldown: 10000 },\n  { key: \"play\", label: \"玩耍\", icon: \"🎾\", cooldown: 15000 },\n  { key: \"groom\", label: \"梳毛\", icon: \"✨\", cooldown: 12000 },\n  { key: \"bath\", label: \"洗澡\", icon: \"🛁\", cooldown: 20000 },\n];\n\nexport default function VirtualActions() {\n  const { setDigitalTwinMood, intimacyScore, setIntimacyScore, setLastInteraction } = useStore();\n  const [cooldowns, setCooldowns] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});\n  const [activeEmoji, setActiveEmoji] = useState<string | null>(null);\n\n  const handleAction = useCallback((action: VirtualAction) => {\n    if (cooldowns[action.key]) return;\n\n    setCooldowns((prev) => ({ ...prev, [action.key]: true }));\n    setActiveEmoji(action.icon);\n    setDigitalTwinMood(\"happy\");\n    setIntimacyScore(intimacyScore + 2);\n    setLastInteraction({ type: action.key, timestamp: new [cooldowns, intimacyScore, setDigitalTwinMood, setIntimacyScore, setLastInteraction]);\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n      <p     <div className=\"fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none z-50 flex items-center justify-center\">\n          <span className=\"text-6xl animate-bounce opacity-80\">{activeEmoji}</span>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"

 "contents": "import { useMemo } from \"react\";\nimport ScoreRing from \"./ScoreRing\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport { ACTIVITY_LABELS } from \"../types\";\nimport type { PetEvent } from \"../types\";\n\nfunction computeActivityScore(events: PetEvent[]): number {\n  const todayEvents = events.filter(\n    (e) => new Date(e.timestamp).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString(),\n  );\n  if (todayEvents.length === 0) return 0;\n  const base = Math.min(todayEvents.length * 8, 60);\n  const variety = new Set(todayEvents.map((e) => e.behavior_type)).size;\n  return Math.min(base + variety * 10, 100);\n}\n\nfunction formatAwayDuration(seconds: number): string {\n  if (seconds < 60) return \"--\";\n  if (seconds < 3600) return `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}分`;\n  const h = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);\n  const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);\n  return m > 0 ? `${h}时${m}分` : `${h}时`;\n}\n\nexport default function SensorPanel() {\n  const { events, currentActivity, bleConnected, awayDuration } = useStore();\n\n  const activityScore = useMemo(() => computeActivityScore(events), [events]);\n  const activityInfo = ACTIVITY_LABELS[currentActivity] ?? ACTIVITY_LABELS.unknown;\n\n  const todayEventCount = useMemo(\n    () => events.filter((e) => new Date(e.timestamp).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString()).length,\n    [events],\n  );\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n      <p className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-3\">实时状态</p>\n      <div className=\"grid grid-cols-4 gap-2\">\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center\">\n          <ScoreRing score={activityScore} color=\"#6366f1\" label=\"活动\" size={48} strokeWidth={4} />\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center\">\n          <span className=\"text-xl mb-1\">{activityInfo.icon}</span>\n          <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-500\">{activityInfo.label}</p>\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center\">\n          <span className={`text-xl mb-1 ${bleConnected ? \"\" : \"opacity-40\"}`}>📡</span>\n          <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-500\">\n            {bleConnected ? \"在家\" : formatAwayDuration(awayDuration)}\n          </p>\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center\">\n          <p className=\"text-xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-1\">{todayEventCount}</p>\n          <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-500\">今日事件</p>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

\"宠物\";\n  const recentMessages = chatMessages.slice(-3);\n\n  const sendMessage = async (text: string) => {\n    if (!text.trim() || !activePetId || sending) return;\n\n    const userMsg: ChatMessage = {\n      id: `u-${Date.now()}`,\n      role: \"user\",\n      content: text.trim(),\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n    addChatMessage(userMsg);\n    setInput(\"\");\n    setSending(true);\n\n    try {\n      const res = await api.petChat(activePetId, text.trim());\n      const petMsg: ChatMessage = {\n        id: `p-${Date.now()}`,\n        role: \"pet\",\n        content: res.reply,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      };\n      addChatMessage(petMsg);\n    } catch {\n      const errMsg: ChatMessage = {\n        id: `e-${Date.now()}`,\n        role: \"pet\",\n        content: `汪...${petName}暂时无法回复～`,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      };\n      addChatMessage(errMsg);\n    } finally {\n      setSending(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    sendMessage(input);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden\">\n      <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b border-gray-50\">\n        <span className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700\">和{petName}聊天</span>\n        <button\n          onClick={() => navigate(\"/pet-chat\")}\n          className=\"text-xs text-indigo-500\"\n        >\n          展开全屏\n        </button>\n      </div>\n\n      <div className=\"px-4 py-2 space-y-2 max-h-36 overflow-y-auto\">\n        {recentMessages.length === 0 ? (\n          <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-400 py-3 text-center\">\n            和{petName}的数字分身聊聊天吧 🐾\n          </p>\n        ) : (\n          recentMessages.map((msg) => (\n            <div\n              key={msg.id}\n              className={`flex ${msg.role === \"user\" ? \"justify-end\" : \"justify-start\"}`}\n            >\n              {msg.role === \"pet\" && (\n                <span className=\"w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-amber-100 flex items-center justify-center text-xs mr-1.5 flex-shrink-0 self-end\">\n                  🐶\n                </span>\n              )}\n              <div\n                className={`max-w-[80%] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs leading-relaxed ${\n                  msg.role === \"user\"\n                    ? \"bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-br-sm\"\n                    : \"bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-bl-sm\"\n                }`}\n              >\n                {msg.content}\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          ))\n        )}\n        {sending && (\n          <div className=\"flex justify-start\">\n            <span className=\"w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-amber-100 flex items-center justify-center text-xs mr-1.5\">\n              🐶\n            </span>\n            <div className=\"bg-gray-100 text-gray-400 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl rounded-bl-sm text-xs\">\n              <span className=\"inline-flex gap-0.5\">\n                <span className=\"animate-bounce\">·</span>\n                <span className=\"animate-bounce\" style={{ animationDelay: \"0.1s\" }}>·</span>\n                <span className=\"animate-bounce\" style={{ animationDelay: \"0.2s\" }}>·</span>\n              </span>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n\n      <div className=\"px-3 py-2 flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto border-t border-gray-50\">\n        {QUICK_QUESTIONS.map((q) => (\n          <button\n            key={q}\n            onClick={() => sendMessage(q)}\n            className=\"whitespace-nowrap px-2.5 py-1 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-full text-xs text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 active:scale-95 transition-transform flex-shrink-0\"\n          >\n            {q}\n          </button>\n        ))}\n      </div>\n\n      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className=\"px-3 py-2 flex gap-2 border-t border-gray-50\">\n        <input\n          type=\"text\"\n          value={input}\n          onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}\n          placeholder={`对${petName}说点什么...`}\n          className=\"flex-1 bg-gray-50 rounded-full px-3 py-2 text-xs outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-200\"\n          disabled={sending}\n        />\n        <button\n          type=\"submit\"\n          disabled={!input.trim() || sending}\n          className=\"w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-indigo-500 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-sm disabled:opacity-40 active:scale-95 transition-transform\"\n        >\n          ↑\n        </button>\n      </form>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

3,\n      label: MOOD_LABELS[r.mood]?.text ?? r.mood,\n    }));\n  }, [moodHistory]);\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100 space-y-3\">\n      <p className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700\">心情仪表盘</p>\n\n      <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-3\">\n          <span className=\"text-4xl\">{moodInfo.emoji}</span>\n          <div>\n            <p className=\"font-semibold text-gray-800\">{moodInfo.text}</p>\n            <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-400\">当前心情</p>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        <ScoreRing\n          score={intimacyScore}\n          color=\"#ec4899\"\n          label=\"亲密度\"\n          size={56}\n          strokeWidth={5}\n        />\n      </div>\n\n      {chartData.length > 2 && (\n        <div>\n          <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-400 mb-1\">心情变化</p>\n          <ResponsiveContainer width=\"100%\" height={80}>\n            <LineChart data={chartData}>\n              <XAxis\n                dataKey=\"time\"\n                tick={{ fontSize: 10 }}\n                axisLine={false}\n                tickLine={false}\n                interval=\"preserveStartEnd\"\n              />\n              <YAxis domain={[0, 6]} hide />\n              <Tooltip\n                contentStyle={{ fontSize: 11, borderRadius: 8, border: \"1px solid #e5e7eb\" }}\n                formatter={(value: number, _name: string, props: { payload?: { label?: string } }) =>\n                  [props.payload?.label ?? value, \"心情\"]\n                }\n              />\n              <Line\n                type=\"monotone\"\n                dataKey=\"score\"\n                stroke=\"#a78bfa\"\n                strokeWidth={2}\n                dot={false}\n              />\n            </LineChart>\n          </ResponsiveContainer>\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"

 "contents": "import { useState, useCallback } from \"react\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport type { PetPose } from \"../types\";\n\ninterface VAction {\n  icon: string;\n  label: string;\n  color: string;\n  pose: PetPose;\n  particles: string[];\n  cooldownMs: number;\n}\n\nconst ACTIONS: VAction[] = [\n  { icon: \"🍖\", label: \"喂食\", color: \"bg-orange-50 text-orange-600\", pose: \"eating\", particles: [\"🍖\", \"🦴\", \"🥩\"], cooldownMs: 8000 },\n  { icon: \"🎾\", label: \"玩耍\", color: \"bg-green-50 text-green-600\", pose: \"playing_ball\", particles: [\"🎾\", \"⚽\", \"🏀\"], cooldownMs: 10000 },\n  { icon: \"✨\", label: \"梳毛\", color: \"bg-purple-50 text-purple-600\", pose: \"grooming\", particles: [\"✨\", \"💫\", \"🪮\"], cooldownMs: 8000 },\n  { icon: \"🛁\", label: \"洗澡\", color: \"bg-blue-50 text-blue-600\", pose: \"bathing\", particles: [\"🛁\", \"🫧\", \"💦\"], cooldownMs: 12000 },\n];\n\nexport default function VirtualActions() {\n  const { setOverridePose, bumpIntimacy, setLastInteraction, addMoodRecord } = useStore();\n  const [cooldowns, setCooldowns] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});\n  const [activeParticles, setActiveParticles] = useState<{ id: number; emoji: string }[]>([]);\n\n  const now = Date.now();\n\n  const handleAction = useCallback((action: VAction) => {\n    const remaining = (cooldowns[action.label] ?? 0) - Date.now();\n    if (remaining > 0) return;\n\n    setOverridePose(action.pose);\n    bumpIntimacy(3);\n    setLastInteraction({ type: action.label, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });\n    addMoodRecord({ mood: \"happy\", timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });\n\n    setCooldowns((prev) => ({ ...prev, [action.label]: Date.now() + action.cooldownMs }));\n\n    const particles = action.particles.flatMap((emoji, i) =>\n      Array.from({ length: 2 }, (_, j) => ({ id: Date.now() + i * 10 + j, emoji }))\n    );\n    setActiveParticles(particles);\n    setTimeout(() => setActiveParticles([]), 1500);\n\n    setTimeout(() => setOverridePose(null), 3000);\n  }, [cooldowns, setOverridePose, bumpIntimacy, setLastInteraction, addMoodRecord]);\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n      <p className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-3\">虚拟互动</p>\n\n      <div className=\"relative\">\n        <div className=\"grid grid-cols-4 gap-3\">\n          {ACTIONS.map((action) => {\n            const cdEnd = cooldowns[action.label] ?? 0;\n            const onCooldown = now < cdEnd;\n\n            return (\n              <button\n                key={action.label}\n                onClick={() => handleAction(action)}\n                disabled={onCooldown}\n                className={`flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 py-3 rounded-xl active:scale-95 transition-all ${\n                  onCooldown ? \"opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed\" : \"\"\n                }`}\n              >\n                <span className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xl ${action.color}`}>\n                  {action.icon}\n                </span>\n                <span className=\"text-xs text-gray-600\">{action.label}</span>\n              </button>\n            );\n          })}\n        </div>\n\n        {activeParticles.length > 0 && (\n          <div className=\"absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none overflow-hidden\">\n            {activeParticles.map((p) => (\n              <span\n                key={p.id}\n                className=\"particle-float absolute text-xl\"\n                style={{\n                  left: `${30 + Math.random() * 40}%`,\n                  top: `${Math.random() * 60}%`,\n                }}\n              >\n                {p.emoji}\n              </span>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "import { useMemo } from \"react\";\nimport { useStore } from \"../stores/useStore\";\nimport { ACTIVITY_LABELS } from \"../types\";\nimport ScoreRing from \"./ScoreRing\";\nimport type { PetEvent } from \"../types\";\n\nfunction computeActivityScore(events: PetEvent[]): number {\n  const todayEvents = events.filter(\n    (e) => new Date(e.timestamp).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString(),\n  );\n  if (todayEvents.length === 0) return 0;\n  const base = Math.min(todayEvents.length * 8, 60);\n  const variety = new Set(todayEvents.map((e) => e.behavior_type)).size;\n  return Math.min(base + variety * 10, 100);\n}\n\nfunction formatAwayDuration(seconds: number): string {\n  if (seconds < 60) return \"--\";\n  if (seconds < 3600) return `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}分`;\n  const h = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);\n  const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);\n  return m > 0 ? `${h}时${m}分` : `${h}时`;\n}\n\nexport default function SensorPanel() {\n  const { events, currentActivity, bleConnected, awayDuration } = useStore();\n\n  const activityScore = useMemo(() => computeActivityScore(events), [events]);\n  const activityInfo = ACTIVITY_LABELS[currentActivity] ?? ACTIVITY_LABELS.unknown;\n  const todayCount = events.filter(\n    (e) => new Date(e.timestamp).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString(),\n  ).length;\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100\">\n      <p className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-3\">实时状态</p>\n      <div className=\"grid grid-cols-4 gap-2\">\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center\">\n          <ScoreRing score={activityScore} color=\"#6366f1\" label=\"活动\" size={48} strokeWidth={4} />\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center\">\n          <span className=\"text-2xl\">{activityInfo.icon}</span>\n          <p className=\"text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1\">{activityInfo.label}</p>\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center\">\n          <span className={`w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full mb-1 ${bleConnected ? \"bg-green-500\" : \"bg-gray-400\"}`} />\n          <p className=\"text-sm font-bold text-gray-800\">\n            {bleConnected ? \"在家\" : formatAwayDuration(awayDuration)}\n          </p>\n          <p className=\"text-[10px] text-gray-400\">离家</p>\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center\">\n          <p className=\"text-xl font-bold text-gray-800\">{todayCount}</p>\n          <p className=\"text-[10px] text-gray-400\">今日事件</p>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

\"宠物\";\n  const recentMessages = chatMessages.slice(-3);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({ top: scrollRef.current.scrollHeight, behavior: \"smooth\" });\n  }, [chatMessages]);\n\n  const sendMessage = async (text: string) => {\n    if (!text.trim() || !activePetId || sending) return;\n\n    const userMsg: ChatMessage = {\n      id: `u-${Date.now()}`,\n      role: \"user\",\n      content: text.trim(),\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n    };\n    addChatMessage(userMsg);\n    setInput(\"\");\n    setSending(true);\n\n    try {\n      const res = await api.petChat(activePetId, text.trim());\n      const petMsg: ChatMessage = {\n        id: `p-${Date.now()}`,\n        role: \"pet\",\n        content: res.reply,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      };\n      addChatMessage(petMsg);\n    } catch {\n      const errMsg: ChatMessage = {\n        id: `e-${Date.now()}`,\n        role: \"pet\",\n        content: `汪...${petName}暂时无法回复，请稍后再试～`,\n        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      };\n      addChatMessage(errMsg);\n    } finally {\n      setSending(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    sendMessage(input);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden\">\n      <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-gray-100\">\n        <span className=\"text-sm font-medium text-gray-700\">和{petName}聊天</span>\n        <button\n          onClick={() => navigate(\"/pet-chat\")}\n          className=\"text-xs text-indigo-500 active:text-indigo-700\"\n        >\n          展开全屏 &gt;\n        </button>\n      </div>\n\n      <div ref={scrollRef} className=\"max-h-36 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-2 space-y-2\">\n        {recentMessages.length === 0 ?         key={msg.id}\n              className={`flex ${msg.role === \"user\" ? \"justify-end\" : \"justify-start\"}`}\n            >\n              {msg.role === \"pet\" && (\n                <div className=\"w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-amber-100 flex items-center justify-center text-xs mr-1.5 flex-shrink-0 self-end\">\n                  🐶\n                </div>\n              )}\n              <div\n                className={`max-w-[75%] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs leading-relaxed ${\n                  msg.role === \"user\"\n                    ? \"bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-br-sm\"\n                    : \"bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-bl-sm\"\n                }`}\n              >\n                {msg.content}\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          ))\n        )}\n        {sending && (\n          <div className=\"flex justify-start\">\n            <div className=\"w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-amber-100 flex items-center justify-center text-xs mr-1.5\">\n              🐶\n            </div>\n            <div className=\"bg-gray-100 text-gray-400 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl rounded-bl-sm text-xs\">\n              <span className=\"inline-flex gap-0.5\">\n                <span className=\"animate-bounce\">·</span>\n                <span className=\"animate-bounce\" style={{ animationDelay: \"0.1s\" }}>·</span>\n                <span className=\"animate-bounce\" style={{ animationDelay: \"0.2s\" }}>·</span>\n              </span>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Quick questions */}\n      <div className=\"px-3 py-1.5 flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto border-t border-gray-50\">\n        {QUICK_QUESTIONS.map((q) => (\n          <button\n            key={q}\n            onClick={() => sendMessage(q)}\n            className=\"whitespace-nowrap px-2.5 py-1 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-full text-[11px] text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100 active:scale-95 transition-transform flex-shrink-0\"\n          >\n            {q}\n          </button>\n        ))}\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Input */}\n      <form\n        onSubmit={handleSubmit}\n        className=\"flex gap-2 px-3 py-2 border-t border-gray-100\"\n      >\n        <input\n          type=\"text\"\n          value={input}\n          onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}\n          placeholder={`对${petName}说...`}\n          className=\"flex-1 bg-gray-50 rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-200\"\n          disabled={sending}\n        />\n        <button\n          type=\"submit\"\n          disabled={!input.trim() || sending}\n          className=\"w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-indigo-500 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-xs disabled:opacity-40 active:scale-95 transition-transform\"\n        >\n          ↑\n        </button>\n      </form>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"

        \"role\": \"user\",\n                \"content\": content,\n            }\n        ],\n    }\n\n    headers = {\n        \"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {settings.ARK_API_KEY}\",\n        \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\n    }\n\n    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=httpx.Timeout(60.0)) as client:\n        r = await client.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)\n\n ### 🤖 Agent

已为项目接好**火山方舟 Responses API**（与你提供的 `curl` 一致：`POST {ARK_API_BASE}/responses`，Bearer + `model` + `input` 多模态结构）。说明如下。

## 配置方式

1. 在 `backend` 目录复制并编辑环境变量（勿把密钥提交到 Git）：

```env
ARK_API_KEY=你的密钥
ARK_API_BASE=https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3
ARK_MODEL=doubao-seed-2-0-mini-260215
```

`backend/.env.example` 里已加上上述变量的注释说明。本地开发时让 FastAPI 能读到 `backend/.env` 即可（项目里 `Settings` 已配置 `env_file`）。

2. **安全提醒**：你在对话里贴出的密钥已相当于公开，建议在[火山控制台](https://console.volces.com/)**轮换/作废**后改用新 Key，只放在本机 `.env` 或密钥管理里。

## 行为说明

- 设置 `ARK_API_KEY` 后，`POST /api/pet-chat/chat` 会调用豆包：把**宠物档案 + 最近行为事件 + 心情**写成系统上下文，再拼上主人的话；若请求里带 **`image_url`**，会按官方格式加入 `input_image`（与示例里图片+文字一致）。
- 未配置密钥或调用失败时，会**自动回退**到原来的规则模板回复，并在服务端打一条 `Ark 调用失败` 的 warning 日志。
- `docker-compose.yml` 里已为 backend 增加 `ARK_*` 环境变量占位，可在仓库根目录用 `.env` 提供 `ARK_API_KEY` 等。

## 代码位置

- 调用实现：`backend/app/services/ark_responses.py`
- 与规则引擎的衔接：`backend/app/services/pet_chat_service.py` 中的 `generate_reply`
- 接口可选字段：`ChatRequest.image_url`（前端 `api.petChat` 已支持第三个可选参数，便于以后传图）

若你希望**未配置 API 时直接报错**而不是静默回退规则引擎，可以再说一下，我可以改成可配置开关。

## 原因说明

界面上的 **「离线模式」不是指火山 API**，而是指 **蓝牙智能项圈是否连上手机/前端**。

代码里用的是全局状态 `bleConnected`（在「设置」里连接项圈 BLE 时才会变成已连接）：

```91:92:d:\文档\Cursor\pet-collar\frontend\src\pages\PetChat.tsx
            {bleConnected ? "项圈已连接" : "项圈未连接"} · 心情:{" "}
            {moodEmoji[digitalTwinMood] ?? "😊"}
```

因此：

- **配置了 Ark API**：只影响 **后端** 用豆包生成回复还是走规则模板；**不会改变** 这里的在线/离线文案。
- **仍显示未连接**：说明当前 **没有通过蓝牙连上项圈**（或未在 App 里点「连接项圈」）。

你截图里那种「岁月静好」「听不太懂」等回复，是 **未走 Ark 时规则引擎** 的典型话术；若已正确配置 `ARK_API_KEY` 且后端能访问 `ark.cn-beijing.volces.com`，回复风格会明显更自然。可在后端日志里看是否有 `Ark 调用失败` 来确认是否真的调到了模型。

若要这里显示 **「项圈已连接」**：请到 **设置 → 连接项圈**（BLE），并保持手机蓝牙与项圈配对成功。

## 原因说明

1. **响应解析不对**  
   火山方舟 Responses API 返回的正文一般在 **`output` → `content` → `text`**（见[实战示例](https://www.cnblogs.com/jzssuanfa/p/19608891)），内层不一定带 `type: "output_text"`。  
   原先只识别 `type == "output_text"` 的节点，解析不到文本就会抛错，然后 **`generate_reply` 里会静默退回规则模板**，所以你会一直看到「岁月静好」「听不太懂」这类固定话术。

2. **环境变量可能没加载到**  
   若从仓库根目录启动 uvicorn，而 `.env` 只在 `backend/.env`，以前可能读不到 `ARK_API_KEY`，等价于没配密钥，同样只会走规则。

## 已做修改

| 文件 | 改动 |
|------|------|
| `backend/app/services/ark_responses.py` | 按官方常见结构解析 `output[].content[].text`，并保留 `output_text` / `choices` 兼容 |
| `backend/app/core/config.py` | 固定读取 **`backend/.env`**（同时兼容当前目录下的 `.env`）；对 `ARK_API_KEY` 做 trim |
| `backend/app/main.py` | `GET /health` 增加 **`llm_configured`**（是否读到密钥，不包含密钥内容） |

## 原因说明

之前聊天仍像「规则回复」，主要有两点：

1. **只走了 Responses API**（`/responses`），在你这边的账号/模型组合下可能经常失败或解析不到正文，代码又 **静默退回规则模板**，所以界面上一片「听不太懂」话术。  
2. **`ARK_FALLBACK_TO_RULES` 默认可视为「失败就当规则」**，失败时你感觉不到是 AI 挂了。

顶栏的 **「项圈未连接」** 仍然是 **蓝牙项圈**，和豆包 API 无关。

## 已做的改动

1. **优先调用 OpenAI 兼容接口** `POST /api/v3/chat/completions`（火山文档里推荐、和官方 SDK 一致），**失败再试**原来的 `/responses`。  
2. 配置里增加 **`ARK_FALLBACK_TO_RULES`**，默认 **`false`**：只要配了 `ARK_API_KEY`，两种调用都失败时 **不再偷偷用规则**，而是返回 **503**，前端会显示 **`（AI 服务）…`** 的具体错误（例如模型名、鉴权、网络）。  
3. 若你 **宁可要规则也不要报错**，可在 `backend/.env` 里写：  
   `ARK_FALLBACK_TO_RULES=true`

## 请你本地操作

1. **重启后端**，确认 `http://localhost:8000/health` 里 **`llm_configured`: true**。  
2. 再试聊天：正常时应是模型口吻；若失败，会看到 **带具体原因的 AI 错误**，便于排查。  
3. 若错误里提示 **模型无效**，在火山控制台看是否需要使用 **推理接入点 ID**（形如 `ep-xxxx`）填到 **`ARK_MODEL`**，而不是 `doubao-seed-…` 这种名称（以控制台为准）。

这样要么是真模型回复，要么是明确报错，而不会再被规则话术「假装成 AI」。

## 原因说明

你看到的「好无聊呀」「听不太懂」等，是 **`ARK_API_KEY` 未被后端进程读到** 时的表现：代码会 **直接走内置规则**，不会报错，所以看起来像「没调模型」。

「项圈未连接」只表示 **蓝牙**，和豆包是否调用无关。

## 已做的改动

1. **环境变量**：除 `backend/.env` 外，也会加载 **仓库根目录的 `.env`**（后者同名变量会覆盖前者），避免密钥只写在项目根却读不到。  
2. **启动日志**：未配置 `ARK_API_KEY` 时，uvicorn 控制台会打出 **WARNING**，提示将使用规则回复。  
3. **接口**：新增 **`GET /api/health`**，返回 `llm_configured`（是否读到密钥）。  
4. **聊天页**：若 `llm_configured === false`，顶部会出现 **黄色提示条**，说明当前是规则模板、不是豆包。

刷新聊天页即可看到提示；若仍无提示，多半是前端代理不到后端，请先确认 `http://localhost:8000/api/health` 能访问。

## 请你本地检查

1. 在 **`backend/.env`** 或 **仓库根目录 `.env`** 中写一行（不要加引号，不要多空格）：  
   `ARK_API_KEY=你的火山方舟密钥`  
2. **保存后重启** uvicorn（改 `.env` 不会自动重载进进程）。  
3. 浏览器打开：  
   `http://localhost:8000/api/health`  
   应看到：`"llm_configured": true`。  
4. 若仍为 `false`，说明进程里仍没有该变量：检查是否改错文件、是否有多余字符，或用 **系统环境变量** 设置 `ARK_API_KEY` 再启动后端。

5. **Docker**：若在 `docker-compose` 里跑，需在 **项目根** 的 `.env` 或 compose 环境里设置 `ARK_API_KEY=`，否则容器内同样是未配置。

配置成功并重启后，聊天应走 **chat/completions** 调用豆包；若接口失败且未设置 `ARK_FALLBACK_TO_RULES=true`，会返回 **503** 并在界面显示「（AI 服务）…」错误信息，而不会再悄悄用规则冒充模型。

## 原因说明

1. **空的 `ARK_API_KEY=`**  
   模板里曾有一行「只有等号、没有密钥」的 `ARK_API_KEY=`。在 pydantic 里这会被当成**空字符串**，再经校验变成「未配置」，所以一直走规则模板。

2. **`.env` 加载顺序**  
   之前是**先读仓库根 `.env`，再读 `backend/.env`**。若根目录配了密钥，但 `backend/.env` 里又有**空的** `ARK_API_KEY=`，**后面的文件会覆盖前面的**，根目录的密钥会被冲掉。

## 已做修改

- **加载顺序**改为：`backend/.env` → 仓库根 `.env` → 当前目录 `.env`（**后加载的覆盖先加载的**）。这样密钥写在仓库根时，不会被 backend 里的空行盖掉。  
- **`backend/.env`** 已去掉「空等号」行，只保留说明；需要时请你**自己新增一行**：`ARK_API_KEY=你的密钥`（整串密钥贴在 `=` 后面）。

## 请你现在操作

1. 打开 **`backend/.env`**，在文件**末尾**新增一行（把下面示例里的密钥换成你在火山控制台复制的真实 Key）：

```env
ARK_API_KEY=你的火山方舟API密钥整串
```

## 已改行为

1. **默认只走豆包**  
   配置了 `ARK_API_KEY` 时，聊天**只**通过 `chat/completions` → `responses`，不再在未失败时走规则。

2. **未配置密钥时不再用规则冒充**  
   没有 `ARK_API_KEY` 时，**不再**自动用内置模板，而是抛出 **`ArkLLMError`**，接口返回 **503**，前端会显示「（AI 服务）未配置 ARK_API_KEY：…」。

3. **可选：无密钥时仍用规则（仅本地调试）**  
   在 `.env` 中设置：  
   `PET_CHAT_ALLOW_RULES_WITHOUT_LLM=true`  
   未配置密钥时会和以前一样走规则模板。

4. **Ark 调用失败时**  
   仍由 **`ARK_FALLBACK_TO_RULES`** 控制：为 `true` 时回退规则；默认 `false` 则返回错误。

## 配置项（`backend/app/core/config.py`）

| 变量 | 默认 | 含义 |
|------|------|------|
| `PET_CHAT_ALLOW_RULES_WITHOUT_LLM` | `false` | 无密钥时是否允许规则回复 |
| `ARK_FALLBACK_TO_RULES` | `false` | 有密钥但 Ark 失败时是否回退规则 |

## 你需要做的

在 **`backend/.env` 或仓库根 `.env`** 里配置有效的 **`ARK_API_KEY=`**，保存并**重启 uvicorn**，聊天才会正常走豆包；否则会直接报错，而不会再静默用规则模板。

## 原因

在 **Windows** 上，如果「系统环境变量」或 **启动 uvicorn 的终端** 里存在 **`ARK_API_KEY=` 空值**，会优先于 `backend/.env`，结果后端一直认为没配密钥。

## 已改代码

在 `backend/app/core/config.py` 的 `Settings` 里增加了 **`env_ignore_empty=True`**：空字符串的环境变量会被忽略，**会继续使用 `.env` 里的 `ARK_API_KEY`**。

## 请你操作

1. **保存代码后重启** uvicorn（必须重启才能加载新配置）。  
2. 若仍异常，打开 **系统属性 → 环境变量**，在「用户变量」和「系统变量」里搜 **`ARK_API_KEY`**：若存在且为空，**删掉该变量**或改成正确密钥。  
3. 再访问：`http://localhost:8000/api/health`，确认 **`llm_configured` 为 `true`**。

改完后聊天不应再出现「未配置 ARK_API_KEY」那条 503 文案（在密钥本身有效的前提下）。

`sneeze`：头部后仰 -> 前冲 -> 恢复\n   - `dizzy`：身体左右摇晃 + 眼睛转圈\n   - `angry`：微微膨胀 + 尾巴炸毛抖动\n   - `purring`：身体微微起伏 + 眼睛半闭\n   - `yawning`：嘴巴大张 -> 闭合 -> 眨眼\n   - `pounce`：蹲伏 -> 弹跳冲刺\n   - `licking`：爪子抬起 + 头部转向\n3. **添加新的粒子动画**：`heart-particle`、`star-particle`、`anger-particle`、`note-particle`、`question-particle`\n4. **丰富 idle 动画链**：idle 不再单一浮动，而是随机切换微动画（耳朵抖、尾巴甩、偏头、眨眼）\n\n## 七、首页统一\n\n修改 [frontend/src/components/PetAvatar.tsx](frontend/src/components/PetAvatar.tsx)：\n- 将 WebP 图片方案改为使用同一个 `CatSVG` 组件（消除对缺失图片资源的依赖）\n- 首页保持展示为主（无点击交互），但共享相同的可爱外观\n\n## 八、文件变更清单\n\n| 操作 | 文件 |\n|------|------|\n| 新建 | `frontend/src/components/CatSVG.tsx` -- 全新猫咪 SVG 组件 |\n| 重写 | `frontend/src/components/InteractivePetAvatar.tsx` -- 新手势系统+区域点击+多种反馈 |\n| 重写 | `frontend/src/components/PetAvatar.tsx` -- 改用 CatSVG 替代 WebP |\n| 大改 | `frontend/src/components/PetAvatar.css` -- 新增所有猫咪动画+修复粒子动画 |\n| 修改 | `frontend/src/components/VirtualActions.tsx` -- 新增 4 个互动按钮 |\n| 修改 | `frontend/src/types/index.ts` -- 扩展 PetPose 和 MOOD_BUBBLES |\n",

**已完成的 6 项改动：**

### 1. 全新猫咪 SVG 组件 (`CatSVG.tsx`)
参照你提供的奶油色小猫照片，设计了一只圆脸大眼、奶油橘白配色的可爱猫咪。SVG 拆分为独立可动画的部件：头（`.cat-head`）、耳朵（`.cat-ears`）、眼睛（8 种状态：正常/眯眼/闭眼/爱心/晕/警觉/睁大/眨眼）、W 形猫嘴、舌头、6 根胡须、尾巴、四只带肉垫的爪子、腮红等。

### 2. 动画系统重构 (`PetAvatar.css`)
- 修复了之前 `heart-particle`、`star-particle` 缺失 CSS 的 bug
- 为 26 种 pose 各自定义了独立的动画组合（耳朵抖动、尾巴摇摆、呼噜震动、打喷嚏后仰、晕眩摇晃等）
- 新增 6 种粒子动画类型：heart/star/anger/note/question/sparkle
- idle 状态加入微动画：耳朵抖动、尾巴摆动、自动眨眼

### 3. 汤姆猫级交互 (`InteractivePetAvatar.tsx`)
- **精确区域点击**：头顶、耳朵、脸颊、鼻子、肚子、爪子、尾巴，每个区域有独特反馈
- **长按**：长按头部触发呼噜状态（音符粒子+闭眼+身体微振）
- **滑动**：在肚子区域左右滑动触发挠痒痒
- **快速连点检测**：1.5 秒内连点 4 次，猫咪变晕（X 眼+摇晃+减少亲密度）
- **闲置自动序列**：15 秒无操作后，猫咪自动 打哈欠 -> 舔爪子 -> 趴下 -> 睡觉
- 触摸涟漪视觉反馈

### 4. 扩展虚拟动作按钮 (`VirtualActions.tsx`)
原有 4 个 + 新增 4 个，共 8 个互动按钮：喂食、玩耍、梳毛、洗澡、**逗猫棒**、**喂零食**、**激光笔**、**拍照**，每个按钮触发独特动画和气泡文案。

### 5. 类型扩展 (`types/index.ts`)
新增 12 种 PetPose：sneeze/dizzy/angry/purring/yawning/licking/pounce/waving/teasing/treating/laser/photo。MOOD_BUBBLES 每种心情增加更多猫咪风格文案。

### 6. 首页统一 (`PetAvatar.tsx`)
首页从缺失的 WebP 图片方案改为直接使用 CatSVG 组件，首页与数字孪生页共享同一套可爱猫咪外观。

\"idle\";\n}\n\nfunction getPoseImage(pose: PetPose): string {\n  const map: Record<PetPose, string> = {\n    idle: \"/pet/cat-idle.webp\",\n    sleeping: \"/pet/cat-sleeping.webp\",\n    barking: \"/pet/cat-barking.webp\",\n    panting: \"/pet/cat-barking.webp\",\n    eating: \"/pet/cat-barking.webp\",\n    head_shaking: \"/pet/cat-curious.webp\",\n    scratching: \"/pet/cat-stretching.webp\",\n    pacing: \"/pet/cat-stretching.webp\",\n    disconnected: \"/pet/cat-disconnected.webp\",\n    petted: \"/pet/cat-idle.webp\",\n    belly_rub: \"/pet/cat-sleeping.webp\",\n    playing_ball: \"/pet/cat-stretching.webp\",\n    grooming: \"/pet/cat-idle.webp\",\n    bathing: \"/pet/cat-idle.webp\",\n    sneeze: \"/pet/cat-curious.webp\",\n    dizzy: \"/pet/cat-curious.webp\",\n    angry: \"/pet/cat-barking.webp\",\n    purring: \"/pet/cat-sleeping.webp\",\n    yawning: \"/pet/cat-sleeping.webp\",\n    licking: \"/pet/cat-idle.webp\",\n    pounce: \"/pet/cat-stretching.webp\",\n    waving: \"/pet/cat-idle.webp\",\n    teasing: \"/pet/cat-stretching.webp\",\n    treating: \"/pet/cat-idle.webp\",\n    laser: \"/pet/cat-stretching.webp\",\n    photo: \"/pet/cat-idle.webp\",\n  };\n  return map[pose];\n}\n\ninterface PetAvatarProps {\n  className?: string;\n}\n\nexport default function PetAvatar({ className = \"\" }: PetAvatarProps) {\n  const { bleConnected, events, digitalTwinMood, currentActivity } = useStore();\n  const [bubbleText, setBubbleText] = useState(\"\");\n  const [imgLoaded, setImgLoaded] = useState(false);\n\n  const latestEvent = events[0];\n  const pose: PetPose =\n    latestEvent && bleConnected\n      ? mapEventToPose(latestEvent.behavior_type)\n      : derivePose(currentActivity, bleConnected);\n\n  const imageSrc = getPoseImage(pose);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    setImgLoaded(false);\n  }, [imageSrc]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const pickBubble = () => {\n      const mood: DigitalTwinMood = bleConnected ? digitalTwinMood : \"bored\";\n      const pool = MOOD_BUBBLES[mood];\n      setBubbleText(pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)]);\n    };\n    pickBubble();\n    const timer = setInterval(pickBubble, 8000);\n    return () => clearInterval(timer);\n  }, [bleConnected, digitalTwinMood]);\n\n  const bgGradient = bleConnected\n    ? \"from-blue-50 via-indigo-50 to-purple-50\"\n    : \"from-gray-100 via-gray-50 to-gray-100\";\n\n  return (\n    <div\n      className={`relative rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br ${bgGradient} overflow-hidden ${className}`}\n    >\n      <div className={`pet-stage pose-${pose}`}>\n        <div className=\"mood-bubble\">{bubbleText}</div>\n\n        <div className={`pet-body ${!bleConnected ? \"disconnected\" : \"\"}`}>\n          <div className=\"pet-3d-container\">\n            <img\n              src={imageSrc}\n              alt=\"\"\n              aria-hidden\n              className=\"pet-glow\"\n              draggable={false}\n            />\n            <img\n              src={imageSrc}\n              alt=\"宠物形象\"\n              className={`pet-main-image ${imgLoaded ? \"loaded\" : \"\"}`}\n              draggable={false}\n              onLoad={() => setImgLoaded(true)}\n            />\n            <div className=\"pet-highlight\" />\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {pose === \"sleeping\" && <div className=\"zzz-float\">💤</div>}\n\n        {!bleConnected && (\n          <div className=\"absolute bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 text-xs text-gray-400 bg-white/80 px-3 py-1 rounded-full shadow-sm z-20\">\n            📡 信号未连接\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

WebSocket 推送\n        await sms_service.send_fence_alert(_user, breached, body)  # 短信\n    return loc\n``​`\n\n### 5. 告警防重复（冷却机制）\n\n用内存字典记录 `{pet_id}_{fence_id}` 的最后告警时间，同一围栏 5 分钟内不重复发送短信（WebSocket 仍推送）。\n\n## 二、前端改动\n\n### 1. 接入 WebSocket 接收后端告警\n\n在 [frontend/src/pages/Location.tsx](frontend/src/pages/Location.tsx) 中：\n\n- 利用已有的 [frontend/src/services/websocket.ts](frontend/src/services/websocket.ts) 的 `RealtimeSocket`\n- `useEffect` 中连接 WebSocket，监听 `fence_breach` 类型消息\n- 收到越界告警时触发抖动和震动\n\n### 2. 窗口抖动动画\n\n在 [frontend/src/index.css](frontend/src/index.css) 添加 CSS `@keyframes shake` 动画：\n\n``​`css\n@keyframes shake {\n  0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }\n  10%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90% { transform: translateX(-4px); }\n  20%, 40%, 60%, 80% { transform: translateX(4px); }\n}\n.fence-alarm {\n  animation: shake 0.6s ease-in-out;\n}\n``​`\n\n收到告警时，给页面根容器添加 `fence-alarm` class，动画结束后移除。同时显示一个更醒目的全屏半透明红色叠加层 + 告警信息。\n\n### 3. 浏览器震动\n\n利用 Web Vibration API：\n\n``​`typescript\nif (navigator.vibrate) {\n  navigator.vibrate([200, 100, 200, 100, 200]);\n}\n``​`\n\n与抖动动画同时触发，在移动端有物理震动反馈。\n\n### 4. 增强告警 UI\n\n将现有的小 toast 升级为更醒目的告警弹窗：红色背景叠加层 + 大号警告图标 + 围栏名称 + 发生时间 + 关闭按钮。\n\n### 5. 设置页添加手机号配置\n\n在设置页（如果有）或用户资料编辑中增加手机号输入框，调用 `PATCH /api/auth/me` 保存。\n\n## 三、不涉及的部分\n\n- 不改动固件代码（固件目前无 GPS 实现）\n- 不改动 Python 模拟器（它独立运行，用自己的围栏逻辑）\n- 不引入新的外部依赖（SMS console 模式无需第三方库）\n",

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\backend\\app\\services\\fence_checker.py",
 "contents": "\"\"\"Geofence breach detection using Haversine distance (circle) and ray-casting (polygon).\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport math\n\nfrom sqlalchemy import select\nfrom sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession\n\nfrom app.models.geofence import Geofence\n\nEARTH_RADIUS_M = 6_371_000\n\n\ndef _haversine(lat1: float, lng1: float, lat2: float, lng2: float) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Return distance in metres between two WGS-84 points.\"\"\"\n    rlat1, rlng1, rlat2, rlng2 = (math.radians(v) for v in (lat1, lng1, lat2, lng2))\n    dlat = rlat2 - rlat1\n    dlng = rlng2 - rlng1\n    a = math.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + math.cos(rlat1) * math.cos(rlat2) * math.sin(dlng / 2) ** 2\n    return 2 * EARTH_RADIUS_M * math.asin(math.sqrt(a))\n\n\ndef _point_in_polygon(lat: float, lng: float, vertices: list[dict]) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Ray-casting algorithm for point-in-polygon test.\"\"\"\n    n = len(vertices)\n    inside = False\n    j = n - 1\n    for i in range(n):\n        yi, xi = vertices[i][\"lat\"], vertices[i][\"lng\"]\n        yj, xj = vertices[j][\"lat\"], vertices[j][\"lng\"]\n        if ((yi > lat) != (yj > lat)) and (lng < (xj - xi) * (lat - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi):\n            inside = not inside\n        j = i\n    return inside\n\n\ndef is_inside_fence(lat: float, lng: float, fence: Geofence) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Return True if (lat, lng) is inside the given fence.\"\"\"\n    if fence.fence_type == \"circle\":\n        if fence.center_lat is None or fence.center_lng is None or fence.radius_meters is None:\n            return True\n        dist = _haversine(lat, lng, fence.center_lat, fence.center_lng)\n        return dist <= fence.radius_meters\n    elif fence.fence_type == \"polygon\":\n        if not fence.vertices_json:\n            return True\n        vertices = json.loads(fence.vertices_json)\n        return _point_in_polygon(lat, lng, vertices)\n    return True\n\n\nasync def check_fence_breach(\n    db: AsyncSession, pet_id: int, lat: float, lng: float\n) -> list[Geofence]:\n    \"\"\"Return list of active fences that the point is OUTSIDE of.\"\"\"\n    result = await db.execute(\n        select(Geofence).where(Geofence.pet_id == pet_id, Geofence.is_active == True)\n    )\n    fences = list(result.scalars().all())\n    breached: list[Geofence] = []\n    for fence in fences:\n        if not is_inside_fence(lat, lng, fence):\n            breached.append(fence)\n    return breached\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\backend\\app\\services\\sms_service.py",
 "contents": "\"\"\"SMS alert service with pluggable providers.\n\nDefault provider is ``console`` which just logs the message.\nSet SMS_PROVIDER=aliyun and configure credentials in .env to use Alibaba Cloud SMS.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport logging\nimport time\nfrom abc import ABC, abstractmethod\n\nfrom app.core.config import settings\n\nlogger = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n# ── cooldown cache: \"{pet_id}_{fence_id}\" -> last_alert_epoch ────────────────\n_cooldown: dict[str, float] = {}\n\n\ndef _should_send(pet_id: int, fence_id: int) -> bool:\n    key = f\"{pet_id}_{fence_id}\"\n    now = time.time()\n    last = _cooldown.get(key, 0.0)\n    if now - last < settings.FENCE_ALERT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS:\n        return False\n    _cooldown[key] = now\n    return True\n\n\n# ── provider interface ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nclass SMSProvider(ABC):\n    @abstractmethod\n    async def send(self, phone: str, params: dict) -> bool:\n        ...\n\n\nclass ConsoleSMSProvider(SMSProvider):\n    async def send(self, phone: str, params: dict) -> bool:\n        logger.warning(\"[SMS-Console] -> %s | %s\", phone, params)\n        return True\n\n\nclass AliyunSMSProvider(SMSProvider):\n    \"\"\"Placeholder for Alibaba Cloud SMS integration.\n\n    To activate, install ``alibabacloud-dysmsapi20170525`` and set\n    SMS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / SMS_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET / SMS_TEMPLATE_CODE in .env.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    async def send(self, phone: str, params: dict) -> bool:\n        logger.info(\"[SMS-Aliyun] would send to %s with params %s (not implemented)\", phone, params)\n        return False\n\n\ndef _get_provider() -> SMSProvider:\n    if settings.SMS_PROVIDER == \"aliyun\":\n        return AliyunSMSProvider()\n    return ConsoleSMSProvider()\n\n\n_provider = _get_provider()\n\n\nasync def send_fence_alert(\n    phone: str,\n    pet_id: int,\n    fence_id: int,\n    fence_name: str,\n    lat: float,\n    lng: float,\n) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Send an SMS fence-breach alert if cooldown has elapsed.\n\n    Returns True if the message was dispatched (or logged).\n    \"\"\"\n    if not phone:\n        logger.debug(\"No phone number configured – skipping SMS for pet %d\", pet_id)\n        return False\n\n    if not _should_send(pet_id, fence_id):\n        logger.debug(\"Cooldown active for pet %d fence %d – skipping SMS\", pet_id, fence_id)\n        return False\n\n    params = {\n        \"fence_name\": fence_name,\n        \"latitude\": f\"{lat:.6f}\",\n        \"longitude\": f\"{lng:.6f}\",\n    }\n    return await _provider.send(phone, params)\n"
}

## 原因

后端使用 **SQLite** 时，本地已有 `petcollar.db` 是在模型里还没有 `users.phone` 字段时建的。`Base.metadata.create_all` **不会**给已有表加新列，所以 ORM 查询 `User` 时会执行 `SELECT ... users.phone ...`，SQLite 报错 **`no such column: users.phone`**，在接口里就变成 **500**。

`login`、`/me`、以及依赖 `get_current_user` 的 **`/api/geofence`** 都会查 `User`，因此会一起 500。

## 已做修改

在 `ensure_sqlite_schema` 里增加对 `users.phone` 的 `ALTER TABLE` 补丁（与现有 `avatar_url` 补丁同一套机制）：

```17:21:d:/文档/Cursor/pet-collar/backend/app/core/database.py
    patches: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = [
        ("users", "avatar_url", "ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN avatar_url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "phone", "ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN phone VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT ''"),
        ("pets", "avatar_url", "ALTER TABLE pets ADD COLUMN avatar_url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT ''"),
    ]
```

应用启动时会执行该补丁，旧库会自动补上 `phone` 列。

## 你需要做的

1. **重启后端**（让新代码和 startup 里的 schema 补丁跑一遍）。

 "contents": "import type { PetEvent } from \"../types\";\n\n// ---- Behavior Trend (7-day) ----\n\nexport interface DailyBehaviorAgg {\n  date: string;\n  scratching: number;\n  head_shaking: number;\n  panting: number;\n  pacing: number;\n  foreign_eating: number;\n}\n\nfunction seededRandom(seed: number): () => number {\n  let s = seed;\n  return () => {\n    s = (s * 16807 + 0) % 2147483647;\n    return (s - 1) / 2147483646;\n  };\n}\n\nexport function generateMockBehaviorTrend(): DailyBehaviorAgg[] {\n  const rand = seededRandom(42);\n  const days: DailyBehaviorAgg[] = [];\n  const now = new Date();\n  for (let i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {\n    const d = new Date(now);\n    d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);\n    days.push({\n      date: d.toLocaleDateString(\"zh-CN\", { month: \"numeric\", day: \"numeric\" }),\n      scratching: Math.floor(rand() * 5) + 1,\n      head_shaking: Math.floor(rand() * 3),\n      panting: Math.floor(rand() * 2),\n      pacing: Math.floor(rand() * 4),\n      foreign_eating: rand() > 0.7 ? 1 : 0,\n    });\n  }\n  return days;\n}\n\n// ---- Heart Rate (24h curve) ----\n\nexport interface HeartRatePoint {\n  time: string;\n  bpm: number;\n}\n\nexport interface HeartRateData {\n  current: number;\n  min: number;\n  max: number;\n  avg: number;\n  lastTime: string;\n  curve: HeartRatePoint[];\n}\n\nexport function generateMockHeartRate(): HeartRateData {\n  const rand = seededRandom(101);\n  const curve: HeartRatePoint[] = [];\n  let min = 200, max = 0, sum = 0;\n\n  for (let h = 0; h < 24; h++) {\n    const baseHr = h >= 22 || h < 6 ? 70 : h >= 6 && h < 9 ? 95 : 85;\n    const bpm = Math.round(baseHr + (rand() - 0.5) * 30);\n    const clamped = Math.max(55, Math.min(140, bpm));\n    curve.push({\n      time: `${String(h).padStart(2, \"0\")}:00`,\n      bpm: clamped,\n    });\n    min = Math.min(min, clamped);\n    max = Math.max(max, clamped);\n    sum += clamped;\n  }\n\n  const now = new Date();\n  const current = curve[now.getHours()]?.bpm ?? 78;\n\n  return {\n    current,\n    min,\n    max,\n    avg: Math.round(sum / 24),\n    lastTime: `${now.getHours()}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, \"0\")}`,\n    curve,\n  };\n}\n\n// ---- Body Temperature ----\n\nexport interface TemperatureData {\n  current: number;\n  status: \"正常\" | \"偏低\" | \"偏高\";\n  lastTime: string;\n  history: { date: string; temp: number }[];\n}\n\nexport function generateMockTemperature(): TemperatureData {\n  const rand = seededRandom(202);\n  const current = +(38.3 + (rand() - 0.5) * 0.8).toFixed(1);\n  const status = current < 37.5 ? \"偏低\" : current > 39.5 ? \"偏高\" : \"正常\";\n  const now = new Date();\n\n  const history: { date: string; temp: number }[] = [];\n  for (let i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {\n    const d = new Date(now);\n    d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);\n    history.push({\n      date: d.toLocaleDateString(\"zh-CN\", { month: \"numeric\", day: \"numeric\" }),\n      temp: +(38.2 + (rand() - 0.4) * 0.6).toFixed(1),\n    });\n  }\n\n  return {\n    current,\n    status,\n    lastTime: `${now.getHours()}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, \"0\")}`,\n    history,\n  };\n}\n\n// ---- Sleep ----\n\nexport interface SleepData {\n  totalHours: number;\n  deepHours: number;\n  lightHours: number;\n  qualityScore: number;\n  qualityLabel: string;\n  segments: { type: \"deep\" | \"light\" | \"awake\"; minutes: number }[];\n}\n\nexport function generateMockSleep(): SleepData {\n  const totalHours = 12.5;\n  const deepHours = 5.2;\n  const lightHours = totalHours - deepHours;\n  const qualityScore = 76;\n\n  return {\n    totalHours,\n    deepHours,\n    lightHours,\n    qualityScore,\n    qualityLabel: \"良好\",\n    segments: [\n      { type: \"light\", minutes: 40 },\n      { type: \"deep\", minutes: 120 },\n      { type: \"light\", minutes: 30 },\n      { type: \"awake\", minutes: 15 },\n      { type: \"deep\", minutes: 90 },\n      { type: \"light\", minutes: 60 },\n      { type: \"deep\", minutes: 100 },\n      { type: \"light\", minutes: 50 },\n      { type: \"awake\", minutes: 10 },\n      { type: \"deep\", minutes: 80 },\n      { type: \"light\", minutes: 55 },\n    ],\n  };\n}\n\n// ---- Activity ----\n\nexport interface ActivityData {\n  activeMinutes: number;\n  targetMinutes: number;\n  calories: number;\n  steps: number;\n  lastTime: string;\n  hourly: { hour: string; minutes: number }[];\n}\n\nexport function generateMockActivity(): ActivityData {\n  const rand = seededRandom(303);\n  const hourly: { hour: string; minutes: number }[] = [];\n  let totalMin = 0;\n\n  for (let h = 0; h < 24; h++) {\n    const isActive = (h >= 7 && h <= 10) || (h >= 16 && h <= 19);\n    const minutes = isActive\n      ? Math.floor(rand() * 15) + 5\n      : Math.floor(rand() * 4);\n    hourly.push({ hour: `${String(h).padStart(2, \"0\")}:00`, minutes });\n    totalMin += minutes;\n  }\n\n  return {\n    activeMinutes: totalMin,\n    targetMinutes: 120,\n    calories: Math.round(totalMin * 3.5),\n    steps: Math.round(totalMin * 85),\n    lastTime: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(\"zh-CN\", { hour: \"2-digit\", minute: \"2-digit\" }),\n    hourly,\n  };\n}\n\n// ---- Respiratory Rate ----\n\nexport interface RespiratoryData {\n  current: number;\n  status: \"正常\" | \"偏快\" | \"偏慢\";\n  avg: number;\n  lastTime: string;\n  curve: { time: string; rate: number }[];\n}\n\nexport function generateMockRespiratory(): RespiratoryData {\n  const rand = seededRandom(404);\n  const curve: { time: string; rate: number }[] = [];\n  let sum = 0;\n\n  for (let h = 0; h < 24; h++) {\n    const base = h >= 22 || h < 6 ? 16 : 22;\n    const rate = Math.round(base + (rand() - 0.5) * 8);\n    const clamped = Math.max(12, Math.min(35, rate));\n    curve.push({ time: `${String(h).padStart(2, \"0\")}:00`, rate: clamped });\n    sum += clamped;\n  }\n\n  const current = curve[new Date().getHours()]?.rate ?? 20;\n  const status = current < 14 ? \"偏慢\" : current > 28 ? \"偏快\" : \"正常\";\n\n  return {\n    current,\n    status,\n    avg: Math.round(sum / 24),\n    lastTime: `${new Date().getHours()}:${String(new Date().getMinutes()).padStart(2, \"0\")}`,\n    curve,\n  };\n}\n\n// ---- Weight ----\n\nexport interface WeightData {\n  current: number;\n  unit: string;\n  lastDate: string;\n  trend: { date: string; weight: number }[];\n}\n\nexport function generateMockWeight(): WeightData {\n  const rand = seededRandom(505);\n  const trend: { date: string; weight: number }[] = [];\n  const now = new Date();\n\n  for (let i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {\n    const d = new Date(now);\n    d.setDate(d.getDate() - i * 7);\n    trend.push({\n      date: d.toLocaleDateString(\"zh-CN\", { month: \"numeric\", day: \"numeric\" }),\n      weight: +(4.8 + (rand() - 0.5) * 0.4).toFixed(1),\n    });\n  }\n\n  return {\n    current: trend[trend.length - 1].weight,\n    unit: \"kg\",\n    lastDate: now.toLocaleDateString(\"zh-CN\", { month: \"numeric\", day: \"numeric\" }),\n    trend,\n  };\n}\n\n// ---- Mock PetEvents for behavior trend fallback ----\n\nexport function generateMockEvents(): PetEvent[] {\n  const rand = seededRandom(999);\n  const types = [\"scratching\", \"head_shaking\", \"panting\", \"pacing\", \"foreign_eating\"];\n  const events: PetEvent[] = [];\n  const now = Date.now();\n\n  for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {\n    const ts = now - Math.floor(rand() * 7 * 24 * 3600 * 1000);\n    events.push({\n      id: i + 1,\n      device_id: 1,\n      pet_id: 1,\n      timestamp: new Date(ts).toISOString(),\n      behavior_type: types[Math.floor(rand() * types.length)],\n      confidence: Math.round(50 + rand() * 45),\n      duration_ms: Math.round(1000 + rand() * 5000),\n      intervention_done: rand() > 0.6,\n      intervention_result: \"none\",\n      user_feedback: null,\n    });\n  }\n\n  return events.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime());\n}\n"
}

### 🤖 Agent

现在我已经全面了解了代码库的现状。让我整理分析结果，制定误食预警的实现计划。

Now I have a comprehensive understanding of the current codebase. Let me synthesize everything and create a detailed plan for implementing the "误食预警" (foreign object ingestion alert) feature.

Key findings:
1. **Protocol layer**: `FOREIGN_EATING = 0x04` is defined, constants `FOREIGN_EAT_LEVEL1_MS`, `LEVEL2_MS`, `LEVEL3_MS` exist but are unused
2. **Firmware rule_engine**: Only checks `chewing_score >= 60` from audio. The IMU-based pitch detection (head-down) is NOT implemented despite being designed


3. **Firmware decision_engine**: Has 3-level intervention logic for foreign_eating based on `duration_ms`, but rule_engine always sends `duration_ms=1000`, so Level 2 and 3 never trigger
4. **Firmware intervention**: All hardware actions are TODO stubs
5. **Simulator**: Has `foreign_eating_alert` scenario but uses hardcoded ranges instead of protocol constants
6. **Backend**: Stores events, broadcasts via WebSocket, but no special handling for foreign_eating
7. **Frontend**: Shows events with risk coloring, has `QuickActions` stub for BLE intervention, Dashboard derives status but no dedicated alert UI for foreign eating

The MVP方案 

Looking at the PDF requirements, I need to implement the full foreign eating detection pipeline: firmware needs to fuse multiple sensor conditions (head pitch, chewing vibration, audio, geofence) with proper 2-of-4 logic and fix the duration tracking so all three intervention levels actually trigger, the protocol needs consistent constant usage, the simulator should reflect real multi-condition scenarios, the backend needs to prioritize foreign eating events with proper notification urgency, and the frontend needs a dedicated alert UI with real-time push and intervention controls.

> 订阅专栏
> 本文详细介绍了MPU6050的工作原理及其在STM32上的应用。MPU6050是一款集成了陀螺仪和加速度计的9轴运动处理传感器，文章深入解析了陀螺仪和加速度计的工作原理，并提供了STM32控制MPU6050的具体步骤，包括硬件连接方式、重要寄存器的功能及配置方法。
> 该文章已生成可运行项目，
> 预览并下载项目源码
> 一·简介:
> 1.要想知道MPU6050工作原理，得先了解下面俩个传感器：
> 
> ①陀螺仪传感器：
> 
>        陀螺仪的原理就是，一个旋转物体的旋转轴所指的方向在不受外力影响时，是不会改变的。人们根据这个道理，用它来保持方向。然后用多种方法读取轴所指示的方向，并自动将数据信号传给控制系统。我们骑自行车其实也是利用了这个原理。轮子转得越快越不容易倒，因为车轴有一股保持水平的力量。现代陀螺仪可以精确地确定运动物体的方位的仪器，它在现代航空，航海，航天和国防工业中广泛使用的一种惯性导航仪器。传统的惯性陀螺仪主要部分有机械式的陀螺仪，而机械式的陀螺仪对工艺结构的要求很高。70年代提出了现代光纤陀螺仪的基本设想，到八十年代以后，光纤陀螺仪就得到了非常迅速的发展，激光谐振陀螺仪也有了很大的发展。光纤陀螺仪具有结构紧凑，灵敏度高，工作可靠。光纤陀螺仪在很多的领域已经完全取代了机械式的传统的陀螺仪，成为现代导航仪器中的关键部件。光纤陀螺仪同时发展的除了环式激光陀螺仪外。
> 
> ②加速度传感器：
> 
>       加速度传感器是一种能够测量加速度的传感器。通常由质量块、阻尼器、弹性元件、敏感元件和适调电路等部分组成。传感器在加速过程中，通过对质量块所受惯性力的测量，利用牛顿第二定律获得加速度值。根据传感器敏感元件的不同，常见的加速度传感器包括电容式、电感式、应变式、压阻式、压电式等。
> 
> 其实说简单点，在mpu6050中我们用陀螺仪传感器测角度，用加速度传感器测加速度
> 
> MPU-60X0 :
> 
>       MPU-60X0是全球首例9轴运动处理传感器。它集成了3轴MEMS陀螺仪， 3轴MEMS 加速度计，以及一个可扩展的数字运动处理器 DMP（DigitalMotion Processor），可用 I2C 接口连接一个第三方的数字传感器，比如磁力计。扩展之后就可以通过其 I2C 或 SPI 接口 输出一个 9 轴的信号（SPI 接口仅在 MPU-6000 可用）。MPU-60X0 也可以通过其 I2C 接口 连接非惯性的数字传感器，比如压力传感器。 MPU-60X0 对陀螺仪和加速度计分别用了三个 16 位的 ADC，将其测量的模拟量转化 为可输出的数字量。为了精确跟踪快速和慢速的运动，传感器的测量范围都是用户可控的， 陀螺仪可测范围为±250，±500，±1000，±2000°/秒（dps），加速度计可测范围为±2，±4， ±8，±16g。 一个片上 1024 字节的 FIFO，有助于降低系统功耗。 和所有设备寄存器之间的通信采用 400kHz 的 I2C 接口或 1MHz 的 SPI 接口（SPI 仅 MPU-6000 可用）。对于需要高速传输的应用，对寄存器的读取和中断可用 20MHz 的 SPI。 另外，片上还内嵌了一个温度传感器和在工作环境下仅有±1%变动的振荡器。 芯片尺寸 4×4×0.9mm，采用 QFN 封装（无引线方形封装），可承受最大 10000g 的冲 击，并有可编程的低通滤波器。 关于电源，MPU-60X0 可支持 VDD 范围 2.5V±5%，3.0V±5%，或 3.3V±5%。另外 MPU-6050 还有一个 VLOGIC 引脚，用来为 I2C 输出提供逻辑电平。VLOGIC 电压可取 1.8±5%或者 VDD。
> 
>          数字运动处理器（DMP）:
> 
>  DMP 从陀螺仪、加速度计以及外接的传感器接收并处理数据，处理结果可以从 DMP 寄存器读出，或通过 FIFO 缓冲。DMP 有权使用 MPU 的一个外部引脚产生中断。
> 
> 二·数据传输:
>     1.I2C原理在上一篇博客里有详细讲解，在这里不再赘述。
> 
> 如果要写 MPU-60X0 寄存器，主设备除了发出开始标志（S）和地址位，还要加一个 R/W 位，0 为写，1 为读。在第 9 个时钟周期（高电平时），MPU-60X0 产生应答信号。然 后主设备开始传送寄存器地址（RA），接到应答后，开始传送寄存器数据，然后仍然要有应 答信号，依次类推。
> 
> 单字节写时序：
> 
> 多字节写时序：
> 
> 如果要读取 MPU-60X0 寄存器的值，首先由主设备产生开始信号（S），然后发送从设 备地址位和一个写数据位，然后发送寄存器地址，才能开始读寄存器。紧接着，收到应答信 号后，主设备再发一个开始信号，然后发送从设备地址位和一个读数据位。然后，作为从设 备的 MPU-60X0 产生应答信号并开始发送寄存器数据。通信以主设备产生的拒绝应答信号 （NACK）和结束标志（P）结束。拒绝应答信号（NACK）产生定义为 SDA 数据在第 9 个 时钟周期一直为高。 
> 
>     
> 
> 三·STM32控制MPU6050
> 1.硬件连接
> 实验采用正点原子公司的 AN1507 ATK-MPU6050 六轴传感器模块
> 
> MPU6050             STM32
> VCC         <--->   VCC
> GND         <--->   GND
> SDA         <--->   PB9
> SCL         <--->   PB8
> INT         <--->   不接
> AD0         <--->   不接
> 运行项目并下载源码
> 
> 2. 重要寄存器
> 2.1 电源管理寄存器 1
> 
> DEVICE_RESET 位用来控制复位，设置为 1，复位 MPU6050，复位结束后， MPU 
> 硬件自动清零该位
> 
> SLEEEP 位用于控制 MPU6050 的工作模式，复位后，该位为 1，即进 
> 入了睡眠模式（低功耗），所以我们要清零该位，以进入正常工作模式
> 
> TEMP_DIS 用于设置是否使能温度传感器，设置为 0，则使能
> 
> CLKSEL[2:0]用于选择系统时钟源，选择关系如表
> 
> CLKSEL[2:0]	时钟源
> 000	内部 8M RC 晶振
> 001	PLL，使用 X 轴陀螺作为参考
> 010	PLL，使用 Y 轴陀螺作为参考
> 011	PLL，使用 Z 轴陀螺作为参考
> 100	PLL，使用外部 32.768Khz 作为参考
> 101	PLL，使用外部 19.2Mhz 作为参考
> 110	保留
> 111	关闭时钟，保持时序产生电路复位状态
> **默认是使用内部 8M RC 晶振的，精度不高，所以我们一般选择 X/Y/Z 轴陀螺作为参考 
> 的 PLL 作为时钟源，一般设置 CLKSEL=001 即可**
> 
> 2.2 陀螺仪配置寄存器
>  
> FS_SEL[1:0]这两个位，用于设置陀螺仪的满量程范围： 0，±250° 
> /S； 1，±500° /S； 2，±1000° /S； 3，±2000° /S；我们一般设置为 3，即±2000° /S，因 
> 为陀螺仪的 ADC 为 16 位分辨率，所以得到灵敏度为： 65536/4000=16.4LSB/(° /S)
> 
> 2.3 加速度传感器配置寄存器
>  
> AFS_SEL[1:0]这两个位，用于设置加速度传感器的满量程范围： 0， 
> ±2g； 1，±4g； 2，±8g； 3，±16g；我们一般设置为 0，即±2g，因为加速度传感器的 
> ADC 也是 16 位，所以得到灵敏度为： 65536/4=16384LSB/g
> 
> 2.4 FIFO使能寄存器
>  
> 该寄存器用于控制 FIFO 使能，在简单读取传感器数据的时候，可以不用 FIFO，设置 
> 对应位为 0 即可禁止 FIFO，设置为 1，则使能 FIFO
> 
> 加速度传感器的 3 个轴，全由 1 
> 个位（ ACCEL_FIFO_EN）控制，只要该位置 1，则加速度传感器的三个通道都开启 FIFO
> 
> 2.5 陀螺仪采样率分频寄存器
>  
> 该寄存器用于设置 MPU6050 的陀螺仪采样频率，计算公式为：
> 
> 采样频率 = 陀螺仪输出频率 / (1+SMPLRT_DIV)
> 
> 这里陀螺仪的输出频率，是 1Khz 或者 8Khz，与数字低通滤波器（ DLPF）的设置有关， 
> 当 DLPF_CFG=0/7 的时候，频率为 8Khz，其他情况是 1Khz。而且 DLPF 滤波频率一般设置 
> 为采样率的一半。采样率，我们假定设置为 50Hz，那么 SMPLRT_DIV=1000/50-1=19
> 
> 2.6 配置寄存器
>  
> 数字低通滤波器（ DLPF）的设置位，即： DLPF_CFG[2:0]，加速 
> 度计和陀螺仪，都是根据这三个位的配置进行过滤的。 DLPF_CFG 不同配置对应的过滤情 
> 况如表: 
>  
> 这里的加速度传感器，输出速率（ Fs）固定是 1Khz，而角速度传感器的输出速率（ Fs）， 
> 则根据 DLPF_CFG 的配置有所不同。一般我们设置角速度传感器的带宽为其采样率的一半， 
> 如前面所说的，如果设置采样率为 50Hz，那么带宽就应该设置为 25Hz，取近似值 20Hz， 
> 就应该设置 DLPF_CFG=100
> 
> 2.7 电源管理寄存器 2
>  
> LP_WAKE_CTRL 用于控制低功耗时的唤醒频率
> 
> 剩下的 6 位，分别控制加速度和陀螺仪的x/y/z轴是否进入待机模式，这里我们全部都不进入待机模式，所以全部设置为 0 即可
> 
> 2.8 陀螺仪数据输出寄存器
>  
> 通过读取这6个寄存器，就可以读到陀螺仪 x/y/z 轴的值，比如 x 轴的数据，可以通过读取 
> 0X43（高 8 位）和 0X44（低 8 位）寄存器得到，其他轴以此类推
> 
> 2.9 加速度传感器数据输出寄存器
>  
> 通过读取这6个寄存器，就可以读到加速度传感器 x/y/z 轴的值，比如读 x 轴的数据，可以通过读取 0X3B（高 8 位）和0X3C（低8位）寄存器得到，其他轴以此类推
> 
> 2.10 温度传感器数据输出寄存器
> 温度传感器的值，可以通过读取 0X41（高 8 位）和 0X42（低 8 位）寄存器得到， 
> 温度换算公式为：
> 
> Temperature = 36.53 + regval/340
> 
> 其中， Temperature 为计算得到的温度值，单位为℃， regval 为从 0X41 和 0X42 读到的 
> 温度传感器值
> 
> 2.11 中断使能寄存器
>  
> OT_EN 该位置 1，该位使能运动检测（Motiondetection）产生中断。
> 
> FIFO_OFLOW_EN该位置1，该位使能FIFO缓冲区溢出产生中断。
> 
> I2C_MST_INT_EN该位置1，该位使能I2C主机所有中断源产生中断。
> 
> DATA_RDY_EN 该位置 1，该位使能数据就绪中断（ Data Ready interrupt），所有的传感器寄存器写操作完成时都会产生
> 
> 关闭所有中断则给此寄存器赋值0X00
> 
> 3. 软件驱动
> 3.1 通过IIC对MPU6050寄存器进行读写
> //IIC写一个字节 
> //reg:      寄存器地址
> //data:     数据
> //返回值:  0,正常
> //          其他,错误代码
> u8 IIC_Write_Byte(u8 reg,u8 data)
> {
>     IIC_Start();
>     IIC_Send_Byte((MPU_ADDR<<1)|0);//发送器件地址+写命令 
>     if(IIC_Wait_Ack())  //等待应答
>     {
>         IIC_Stop(); 
>         return 1;       
>     }
>     IIC_Send_Byte(reg); //写寄存器地址
>     IIC_Wait_Ack();     //等待应答 
>         IIC_Send_Byte(data);//发送数据
>     if(IIC_Wait_Ack())  //等待ACK
>     {
>         IIC_Stop();  
>         return 1;        
>     }        
>     IIC_Stop();  
>     return 0;
> }
>  
> //IIC读一个字节 
> //reg:寄存器地址 
> //返回值:读到的数据
>  
> u8 IIC_Read_Byte(u8 reg)
> {
>     u8 res;
>     IIC_Start();
>     IIC_Send_Byte((MPU_ADDR<<1)|0);//发送器件地址+写命令 
>     IIC_Wait_Ack();//等待应答
>     IIC_Send_Byte(reg);//写寄存器地址
>     IIC_Wait_Ack();//等待应答
>     IIC_Start();
>     IIC_Send_Byte((MPU_ADDR<<1)|1);//发送期间地址+读命令
>     IIC_Wait_Ack();//等待应答
>     res=IIC_Read_Byte(0);//读取数据，发送nACK
>     IIC_Stop();//产生一个停止条件
>     return res;
> }
>  
> //IIC连续写
> //addr:器件地址
> //reg: 寄存器地址
> //len: 写入长度
> //buf: 数据区
> //返回值: 0,正常
> //              其他，错误代码
> u8 IIC_Write_Len(u8 addr,u8 reg,u8 len,u8 *buf)
> {
>     u8 i;
>     IIC_Start();
>     IIC_Send_Byte((addr<<1)|0);//发送器件地址+写命令
>     if(IIC_Wait_Ack())//等待应答
>     {
>         IIC_Stop();
>         return 1;
>     }
>     IIC_Send_Byte(reg);//写寄存器地址
>     IIC_Wait_Ack();//等待应答
>     for(i=0;i<len;i++)
>     {
>         IIC_Send_Byte(buf[i]);//发送数据
>         if(IIC_Wait_Ack())//等待ACK
>         {
>             IIC_Stop();
>             return 1;
>         }
>     }
>     IIC_Stop();
>     return 0;
> }
> //IIC连续读
> //addr:器件地址
> //reg:要读取的寄存器地址
> //len:要读取得长度
> //buf:读取到的数据存储区
> //返回值: 0,正常
> //              其他，错误代码
> u8 IIC_Read_Len(u8 addr,u8 reg,u8 len,u8 *buf)
> {
>     IIC_Start();
>     IIC_Send_Byte((addr<<1)|0);//发送器件地址+写命令
>     if(IIC_Wait_Ack())//等待应答
>     {
>         IIC_Stop();
>         return 1;
>     }
>     IIC_Send_Byte(reg);//写寄存器地址
>     IIC_Wait_Ack();//等待应答
>     IIC_Start();
>     IIC_Send_Byte((addr<<1)|1);//发送器件地址+读命令
>     IIC_Wait_Ack();//等待应答
>     while(len)
>     {
>         if(len==1) *buf=IIC_Read_Byte(0);//读数据，发送nACK
>         else *buf=IIC_Read_Byte(1);//读数据，发送ACK
>         len--;
>         buf++;
>     }
>     IIC_Stop();//产生一个停止条件
>     return 0;
> }
> 运行项目并下载源码
> 
> 3.2 MPU6050初始化
> //初始化MPU6050
> //返回值: 0,成功
> //        其他,错误代码
> u8 MPU_Init(void)
> {
>     u8 res;
>     IIC_Init();//初始化IIC总线
>     IIC_Write_Byte(MPU_PWR_MGMT1_REG,0X80);//复位MPU6050
>     delay_ms(100);
>     IIC_Write_Byte(MPU_PWR_MGMT1_REG,0X00);//唤醒MPU6050
>     MPU_Set_Gyro_Fsr(3); //陀螺仪传感器,±2000dps
>     MPU_Set_Accel_Fsr(0); //加速度传感器 ±2g
>     MPU_Set_Rate(50); //设置采样率50HZ
>     IIC_Write_Byte(MPU_INT_EN_REG,0X00); //关闭所有中断
>     IIC_Write_Byte(MPU_USER_CTRL_REG,0X00);//I2C主模式关闭
>     IIC_Write_Byte(MPU_FIFO_EN_REG,0X00);//关闭FIFO
>     IIC_Write_Byte(MPU_INTBP_CFG_REG,0X80);//INT引脚低电平有效
>     res=IIC_Read_Byte(MPU_DEVICE_ID_REG);
>     if(res==MPU_ADDR)//器件ID正确
>     {
>         IIC_Write_Byte(MPU_PWR_MGMT1_REG,0X01);//设置CLKSEL,PLL X 轴为参考
>         IIC_Write_Byte(MPU_PWR_MGMT2_REG,0X00);//加速度陀螺仪都工作
>         MPU_Set_Rate(50); //设置采样率为50HZ
>     }else return 1;
>     return 0;
> }
>  
> //设置MPU6050陀螺仪传感器满量程范围
> //fsr:0,±250dps;1,±500dps;2,±1000dps;3,±2000dps
> //返回值:0,设置成功
> //    其他,设置失败 
> u8 MPU_Set_Gyro_Fsr(u8 fsr)
> {
>     return IIC_Write_Byte(MPU_GYRO_CFG_REG,fsr<<3);//设置陀螺仪满量程范围
> }
>  
> //设置MPU6050加速度传感器满量程范围
> //fsr:0,±2g;1,±4g;2,±8g;3,±16g
> //返回值:0,设置成功
> //    其他,设置失败 
> u8 MPU_Set_Accel_Fsr(u8 fsr)
> {
>     return IIC_Write_Byte(MPU_ACCEL_CFG_REG,fsr<<3);//设置加速度传感器满量程范围
> }
>  
> //设置MPU6050的数字低通滤波器
> //lpf:数字低通滤波频率(Hz)
> //返回值:0,设置成功
> //    其他,设置失败 
> u8 MPU_Set_LPF(u16 lpf)
> {
>     u8 data=0;
>     if(lpf>=188) data=1;
>     else if(lpf>=98) data=2;
>     else if(lpf>=42) data=2;
>     else if(lpf>=42) data=3;
>     else if(lpf>=20) data=4;
>     else if(lpf>=10) data=5;
>     else data=6; 
>     return IIC_Write_Byte(MPU_CFG_REG,data);//设置数字低通滤波器  
> }
>  
> //设置MPU6050的采样率(假定Fs=1KHz)
> //rate:4~1000(Hz)
> //返回值:0,设置成功
> //    其他,设置失败 
> u8 MPU_Set_Rate(u16 rate)
> {
>     u8 data;
>     if(rate>1000)rate=1000;
>     if(rate<4)rate=4;
>     data=1000/rate-1;
>     data=IIC_Write_Byte(MPU_SAMPLE_RATE_REG,data);  //设置数字低通滤波器
>     return MPU_Set_LPF(rate/2); //自动设置LPF为采样率的一半
> }
> 运行项目并下载源码
> 
> 3.3 读取MPU6050相关测得原始数据
> //得到温度值
> //返回值:温度值(扩大了100倍)
> short MPU_Get_Temperature(void)
> {
>     u8 buf[2]; 
>     short raw;
>         float temp;
>         IIC_Read_Len(MPU_ADDR,MPU_TEMP_OUTH_REG,2,buf); 
>     raw=((u16)buf[0]<<8)|buf[1];  
>     temp=36.53+((double)raw)/340;  
>     return temp*100;;
> }
> //得到陀螺仪值(原始值)
> //gx,gy,gz:陀螺仪x,y,z轴的原始读数(带符号)
> //返回值:0,成功
> //    其他,错误代码
> u8 MPU_Get_Gyroscope(short *gx,short *gy,short *gz)
> {
>     u8 buf[6],res;
>     res=IIC_Read_Len(MPU_ADDR,MPU_GYRO_XOUTH_REG,6,buf);
>     if(res==0)
>     {
>         *gx=((u16)buf[0]<<8)|buf[1];  
>         *gy=((u16)buf[2]<<8)|buf[3];  
>         *gz=((u16)buf[4]<<8)|buf[5];
>     }   
>     return res;
> }
>  
> //得到加速度值(原始值)
> //ax,ay,az:陀螺仪x,y,z轴的原始读数(带符号)
> //返回值:0,成功
> //    其他,错误代码
> u8 MPU_Get_Accelerometer(short *ax,short *ay,short *az)
> {
>     u8 buf[6],res;  
>     res=IIC_Read_Len(MPU_ADDR,MPU_ACCEL_XOUTH_REG,6,buf);
>     if(res==0)
>     {
>         *ax=((u16)buf[0]<<8)|buf[1];  
>         *ay=((u16)buf[2]<<8)|buf[3];  
>         *az=((u16)buf[4]<<8)|buf[5];
>     }   
>     return res;;
> }

accel 三轴计算: `pitch = atan2f(ax, sqrtf(ay*ay + az*az)) * 57.2958f`\n- 滑动窗口 50 点 (1s @ 50Hz)，判断 pitch 是否持续 < -30 度\n- 单位转换: `ax_g = raw_ax / 16384.0f`\n\n**条件2 - 啃咬震动检测**:\n- 在加速度数据上计算短时方差 (10 点窗 =  "contents": "/**\n * Pet Collar Firmware - TuyaOpen SDK Entry Point\n *\n * Initializes all subsystems on T5AI-CORE DevKit:\n * MPU6050 IMU, audio capture, rule engine, decision engine,\n * intervention executor, event manager, and BLE service.\n */\n\n#include \"tal_api.h\"\n#include \"tkl_output.h\"\n\n#include \"mpu6050_driver.h\"\n#include \"audio_driver.h\"\n#include \"rule_engine.h\"\n#include \"decision_engine.h\"\n#include \"intervention.h\"\n#include \"event_manager.h\"\n#include \"ble_service.h\"\n\nstatic void user_main(void)\n{\n    tal_log_init(TAL_LOG_LEVEL_DEBUG, 1024, (TAL_LOG_OUTPUT_CB)tkl_log_output);\n    PR_DEBUG(\"Pet Collar firmware starting on T5AI-CORE...\");\n\n    event_manager_init();\n    intervention_init();\n    rule_engine_init();\n    decision_engine_init();\n    mpu6050_driver_init();\n    audio_driver_init();\n    ble_service_init();\n\n    PR_DEBUG(\"All subsystems initialized\");\n\n    while (1) {\n        tal_system_sleep(10000);\n    }\n}\n\n#if OPERATING_SYSTEM == SYSTEM_LINUX\nvoid main(int argc, char *argv[])\n{\n    user_main();\n}\n#else\n\nstatic THREAD_HANDLE ty_app_thread = NULL;\n\nstatic void tuya_app_thread(void *arg)\n{\n    user_main();\n    tal_thread_delete(ty_app_thread);\n    ty_app_thread = NULL;\n}\n\nvoid tuya_app_main(void)\n{\n    THREAD_CFG_T thrd_param = {0};\n    thrd_param.stackDepth = 1024 * 8;\n    thrd_param.priority = THREAD_PRIO_1;\n    thrd_param.thrdname = \"pet_collar_main\";\n    tal_thread_create_and_start(&ty_app_thread, NULL, NULL,\n                                 tuya_app_thread, NULL, &thrd_param);\n}\n#endif\n"
}
