{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\firmware\\src\\mpu6050_driver.c",
 "contents": "/**\n * MPU6050 I2C driver for T5AI-CORE DevKit.\n *\n * Based on Tuya official I2C + MPU6050 example and MPU6050 register manual.\n * I2C bus: SCL=P20, SDA=P21 (T5AI hardware I2C0).\n * Config: +/-2g accel, +/-2000dps gyro, 50Hz sample rate, 20Hz DLPF.\n */\n\n#include \"mpu6050_driver.h\"\n#include \"pet_collar_config.h\"\n#include \"tal_api.h\"\n#include \"tkl_i2c.h\"\n\n#define TAG \"mpu6050\"\n\nstatic imu_callback_t s_callback = NULL;\nstatic TIMER_ID s_sample_timer = NULL;\n\n/* ── Low-level I2C register access ─────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic int mpu_write_reg(uint8_t reg, uint8_t val)\n{\n    uint8_t buf[2] = { reg, val };\n    TUYA_I2C_MSG_T msg = {\n        .addr = MPU6050_I2C_ADDR,\n        .flags = 0,\n        .len = 2,\n        .buff = buf,\n    };\n    return tkl_i2c_master_send(MPU6050_I2C_PORT, &msg, 1);\n}\n\nstatic int mpu_read_reg(uint8_t reg, uint8_t *buf, uint8_t len)\n{\n    uint8_t reg_addr = reg;\n    TUYA_I2C_MSG_T msgs[2] = {\n        { .addr = MPU6050_I2C_ADDR, .flags = 0,                .len = 1,   .buff = &reg_addr },\n        { .addr = MPU6050_I2C_ADDR, .flags = TUYA_I2C_RD_FLAG, .len = len, .buff = buf },\n    };\n    return tkl_i2c_master_send(MPU6050_I2C_PORT, msgs, 2);\n}\n\n/* ── Periodic sampling callback (50Hz timer) ───────────────────── */\n\nstatic void mpu_sample_timer_cb(TIMER_ID timer_id, void *arg)\n{\n    if (!s_callback) return;\n\n    uint8_t raw[14];\n    if (mpu_read_reg(MPU6050_REG_ACCEL_XOUT_H, raw, 14) != OPRT_OK) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    /* Raw 16-bit big-endian values from MPU6050 registers */\n    int16_t raw_ax = (int16_t)((raw[0]  << 8) | raw[1]);\n    int16_t raw_ay = (int16_t)((raw[2]  << 8) | raw[3]);\n    int16_t raw_az = (int16_t)((raw[4]  << 8) | raw[5]);\n    /* raw[6..7] = temperature, skip */\n    int16_t raw_gx = (int16_t)((raw[8]  << 8) | raw[9]);\n    int16_t raw_gy = (int16_t)((raw[10] << 8) | raw[11]);\n    int16_t raw_gz = (int16_t)((raw[12] << 8) | raw[13]);\n\n    /*\n     * Convert to mg and mdps:\n     * At +/-2g (AFS_SEL=0): sensitivity = 16384 LSB/g  -> mg = raw * 1000 / 16384\n     * At +/-2000dps (FS_SEL=3): sensitivity = 16.4 LSB/(dps) -> mdps = raw * 1000 / 16.4\n     */\n    imu_sample_t sample;\n    sample.accel_x = (int16_t)((int32_t)raw_ax * 1000 / ACCEL_SENSITIVITY_2G);\n    sample.accel_y = (int16_t)((int32_t)raw_ay * 1000 / ACCEL_SENSITIVITY_2G);\n    sample.accel_z = (int16_t)((int32_t)raw_az * 1000 / ACCEL_SENSITIVITY_2G);\n    sample.gyro_x  = (int16_t)((int32_t)raw_gx * 1000 / 16);\n    sample.gyro_y  = (int16_t)((int32_t)raw_gy * 1000 / 16);\n    sample.gyro_z  = (int16_t)((int32_t)raw_gz * 1000 / 16);\n\n    s_callback(&sample);\n}\n\n/* ── Public API ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nvoid mpu6050_register_callback(imu_callback_t cb)\n{\n    s_callback = cb;\n}\n\nint mpu6050_driver_init(void)\n{\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: initializing MPU6050 on I2C port %d\", TAG, MPU6050_I2C_PORT);\n\n    /* Initialize I2C bus */\n    TUYA_I2C_BASE_CFG_T i2c_cfg = {\n        .role = TUYA_I2C_MODE_MASTER,\n        .speed = TUYA_I2C_BUS_SPEED_400K,\n    };\n    int ret = tkl_i2c_init(MPU6050_I2C_PORT, &i2c_cfg);\n    if (ret != OPRT_OK) {\n        PR_ERR(\"%s: I2C init failed: %d\", TAG, ret);\n        return ret;\n    }\n\n    /* Reset MPU6050 */\n    mpu_write_reg(MPU6050_REG_PWR_MGMT_1, 0x80);\n    tal_system_sleep(100);\n\n    /* Verify WHO_AM_I */\n    uint8_t dev_id = 0;\n    mpu_read_reg(MPU6050_REG_WHO_AM_I, &dev_id, 1);\n    if (dev_id != MPU6050_I2C_ADDR) {\n        PR_ERR(\"%s: WHO_AM_I mismatch: expected 0x%02X, got 0x%02X\",\n               TAG, MPU6050_I2C_ADDR, dev_id);\n        return OPRT_COM_ERROR;\n    }\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: MPU6050 detected (WHO_AM_I=0x%02X)\", TAG, dev_id);\n\n    /* Wake up, PLL with X-axis gyro reference */\n    mpu_write_reg(MPU6050_REG_PWR_MGMT_1, 0x01);\n    /* All axes active */\n    mpu_write_reg(MPU6050_REG_PWR_MGMT_2, 0x00);\n    /* Gyro full-scale: +/-2000 dps (FS_SEL=3) */\n    mpu_write_reg(MPU6050_REG_GYRO_CONFIG, 3 << 3);\n    /* Accel full-scale: +/-2g (AFS_SEL=0) */\n    mpu_write_reg(MPU6050_REG_ACCEL_CONFIG, 0 << 3);\n    /* Sample rate: 1kHz / (1+19) = 50Hz */\n    mpu_write_reg(MPU6050_REG_SMPRT_DIV, 19);\n    /* DLPF bandwidth ~20Hz (DLPF_CFG=4) */\n    mpu_write_reg(MPU6050_REG_CONFIG, 4);\n    /* Disable interrupts */\n    mpu_write_reg(MPU6050_REG_INT_EN, 0x00);\n    /* Disable FIFO */\n    mpu_write_reg(MPU6050_REG_FIFO_EN, 0x00);\n    /* INT pin active low */\n    mpu_write_reg(MPU6050_REG_INT_PIN_CFG, 0x80);\n\n    /* Create 50Hz periodic timer for sampling */\n    ret = tal_sw_timer_create(mpu_sample_timer_cb, NULL, &s_sample_timer);\n    if (ret != OPRT_OK) {\n        PR_ERR(\"%s: timer create failed: %d\", TAG, ret);\n        return ret;\n    }\n    ret = tal_sw_timer_start(s_sample_timer, MPU6050_SAMPLE_PERIOD_MS, TAL_TIMER_CYCLE);\n    if (ret != OPRT_OK) {\n        PR_ERR(\"%s: timer start failed: %d\", TAG, ret);\n        return ret;\n    }\n\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: MPU6050 initialized, sampling at %dHz\", TAG, MPU6050_SAMPLE_HZ);\n    return OPRT_OK;\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "/**\n * Audio driver for T5AI-CORE DevKit.\n *\n * Captures audio via ADC at ~8kHz, computes spectral features\n * at 1Hz, and delivers audio_features_t to registered callback.\n *\n * TODO: Replace stub feature values with real ADC capture + DSP\n * once microphone hardware is connected.\n */\n\n#include \"audio_driver.h\"\n#include \"pet_collar_config.h\"\n#include \"tal_api.h\"\n\n#define TAG \"audio\"\n\nstatic audio_callback_t s_callback = NULL;\nstatic TIMER_ID s_audio_timer = NULL;\n\nstatic void audio_feature_timer_cb(TIMER_ID timer_id, void *arg)\n{\n    if (!s_callback) return;\n\n    /*\n     * TODO: Read ADC samples, compute real features.\n     * For now, output zeroed features so the rule engine\n     * sees valid (but inactive) audio data.\n     */\n    audio_features_t features = {\n        .rms_energy = 0,\n        .spectral_centroid = 0,\n        .zero_crossing_rate = 0,\n        .panting_score = 0,\n        .chewing_score = 0,\n    };\n\n    s_callback(&features);\n}\n\nvoid audio_register_callback(audio_callback_t cb)\n{\n    s_callback = cb;\n}\n\nint audio_driver_init(void)\n{\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: audio driver init (stub - awaiting mic hardware)\", TAG);\n\n    int ret = tal_sw_timer_create(audio_feature_timer_cb, NULL, &s_audio_timer);\n    if (ret != OPRT_OK) {\n        PR_ERR(\"%s: timer create failed: %d\", TAG, ret);\n        return ret;\n    }\n    ret = tal_sw_timer_start(s_audio_timer, 1000, TAL_TIMER_CYCLE);\n    if (ret != OPRT_OK) {\n        PR_ERR(\"%s: timer start failed: %d\", TAG, ret);\n        return ret;\n    }\n\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: audio feature extraction at 1Hz\", TAG);\n    return OPRT_OK;\n}\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\firmware\\src\\rule_engine.c",
 "contents": "/**\n * Rule-based behavior detection (Layer 1) for T5AI-CORE.\n *\n * Detectors:\n * - Head shaking: high-frequency angular velocity burst\n * - Scratching: repetitive rhythmic limb vibration\n * - Prolonged still: low activity for extended period\n * - Panting: high-frequency short-cycle breathing\n * - Foreign eating: MULTI-CONDITION FUSION\n *     Condition 1: head-down pitch angle < -30 degrees\n *     Condition 2: high-frequency chewing vibration (accel variance)\n *     Condition 3: audio chewing score >= 60\n *     Triggers when >= 2 conditions are simultaneously met.\n */\n\n#include \"rule_engine.h\"\n#include \"decision_engine.h\"\n#include \"pet_collar_config.h\"\n#include \"tal_api.h\"\n#include <math.h>\n#include <string.h>\n\n#define TAG \"rule_eng\"\n\n/* ── Sliding window for IMU analysis ─────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic imu_sample_t s_imu_window[IMU_WINDOW_SIZE];\nstatic int s_win_idx = 0;\nstatic int s_win_count = 0;\n\n/* ── Foreign eating multi-condition state ────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic foreign_eat_state_t s_fe_state = {0};\nstatic uint32_t s_still_start_ms = 0;\nstatic uint32_t s_last_fe_report_ms = 0;\n\n/* ── Helper: get system time in ms ───────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic uint32_t get_time_ms(void)\n{\n    return (uint32_t)tal_system_get_millisecond();\n}\n\n/* ── Head shaking detector ───────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic void check_head_shaking(void)\n{\n    int bursts = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < s_win_count; i++) {\n        if (abs(s_imu_window[i].gyro_x) > HEAD_SHAKE_GYRO_THRESHOLD ||\n            abs(s_imu_window[i].gyro_y) > HEAD_SHAKE_GYRO_THRESHOLD) {\n            bursts++;\n        }\n    }\n    if (bursts >= HEAD_SHAKE_MIN_BURSTS) {\n        rule_detection_t det = {\n            .type = BEHAVIOR_HEAD_SHAKING,\n            .confidence = (uint8_t)((bursts * 100) / s_win_count),\n            .duration_ms = (uint16_t)(s_win_count * (1000 / MPU6050_SAMPLE_HZ)),\n            .condition_mask = 0,\n        };\n        if (det.confidence > 100) det.confidence = 100;\n        decision_engine_feed_rule(&det);\n    }\n}\n\n/* ── Scratching detector ─────────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic void check_scratching(void)\n{\n    int cycles = 0;\n    int prev_sign = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < s_win_count; i++) {\n        int sign = s_imu_window[i].accel_z > 0 ? 1 : -1;\n        if (abs(s_imu_window[i].accel_z) > SCRATCH_ACCEL_THRESHOLD && sign != prev_sign) {\n            cycles++;\n        }\n        prev_sign = sign;\n    }\n    if (cycles >= SCRATCH_MIN_CYCLES) {\n        rule_detection_t det = {\n            .type = BEHAVIOR_SCRATCHING,\n            .confidence = (uint8_t)((cycles * 100) / (s_win_count / 2)),\n            .duration_ms = (uint16_t)(s_win_count * (1000 / MPU6050_SAMPLE_HZ)),\n            .condition_mask = 0,\n        };\n        if (det.confidence > 100) det.confidence = 100;\n        decision_engine_feed_rule(&det);\n    }\n}\n\n/* ── Prolonged still detector ────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic void check_prolonged_still(void)\n{\n    int low_activity = 1;\n    for (int i = 0; i < s_win_count; i++) {\n        int mag = abs(s_imu_window[i].accel_x) +\n                  abs(s_imu_window[i].accel_y) +\n                  abs(s_imu_window[i].accel_z);\n        if (mag > STILL_ACCEL_THRESHOLD * 3) {\n            low_activity = 0;\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    uint32_t now = get_time_ms();\n    if (low_activity) {\n        if (s_still_start_ms == 0) s_still_start_ms = now;\n        uint32_t duration = now - s_still_start_ms;\n        if (duration >= STILL_MIN_DURATION_MS) {\n            rule_detection_t det = {\n                .type = BEHAVIOR_PROLONGED_STILL,\n                .confidence = 70,\n                .duration_ms = (uint16_t)(duration > 65535 ? 65535 : duration),\n                .condition_mask = 0,\n            };\n            decision_engine_feed_rule(&det);\n        }\n    } else {\n        s_still_start_ms = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n/* ── Foreign eating: pitch angle calculation ─────────────────────── */\n\nstatic float compute_pitch_deg(const imu_sample_t *s)\n{\n    float ax = (float)s->accel_x;\n    float ay = (float)s->accel_y;\n    float az = (float)s->accel_z;\n    return atan2f(ax, sqrtf(ay * ay + az * az)) * 57.2957795f;\n}\n\n/* ── Foreign eating: condition 1 - sustained head-down pitch ─────── */\n\nstatic bool check_pitch_condition(void)\n{\n    if (s_win_count < IMU_WINDOW_SIZE / 2) return false;\n\n    int low_count = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < s_win_count; i++) {\n        float pitch = compute_pitch_deg(&s_imu_window[i]);\n        if (pitch < (float)FOREIGN_EAT_PITCH_THRESHOLD_DEG) {\n            low_count++;\n        }\n    }\n    /* Require >60% of window samples to show head-down posture */\n    return low_count > (s_win_count * 60 / 100);\n}\n\n/* ── Foreign eating: condition 2 - chewing vibration variance ────── */\n\nstatic bool check_chew_vibration_condition(void)\n{\n    if (s_win_count < CHEW_VAR_WINDOW) return false;\n\n    /*\n     * Compute short-time variance of accel magnitude over the last\n     * CHEW_VAR_WINDOW samples (200ms at 50Hz). High variance indicates\n     * rhythmic chewing/gnawing vibration.\n     */\n    int start = (s_win_idx - CHEW_VAR_WINDOW + IMU_WINDOW_SIZE) % IMU_WINDOW_SIZE;\n\n    int32_t sum = 0;\n    int32_t sum_sq = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < CHEW_VAR_WINDOW; i++) {\n        int idx = (start + i) % IMU_WINDOW_SIZE;\n        int32_t mag = abs(s_imu_window[idx].accel_x) +\n                      abs(s_imu_window[idx].accel_y) +\n                      abs(s_imu_window[idx].accel_z);\n        sum += mag;\n        sum_sq += mag * mag;\n    }\n    int32_t mean = sum / CHEW_VAR_WINDOW;\n    int32_t variance = (sum_sq / CHEW_VAR_WINDOW) - (mean * mean);\n\n    return variance > FOREIGN_EAT_CHEW_VAR_THRESHOLD;\n}\n\n/* ── Foreign eating: multi-condition fusion ───────────────────────── */\n\nstatic void evaluate_foreign_eating(void)\n{\n    uint8_t mask = 0;\n    uint8_t count = 0;\n\n    if (s_fe_state.imu_pitch_low)       { mask |= COND_MASK_PITCH;     count++; }\n    if (s_fe_state.imu_chew_vibration)  { mask |= COND_MASK_VIBRATION; count++; }\n    if (s_fe_state.audio_chewing)       { mask |= COND_MASK_AUDIO;     count++; }\n\n    s_fe_state.condition_count = count;\n    s_fe_state.condition_mask = mask;\n\n    uint32_t now = get_time_ms();\n\n    if (count >= FOREIGN_EAT_MIN_CONDITIONS) {\n        if (s_fe_state.onset_time_ms == 0) {\n            s_fe_state.onset_time_ms = now;\n        }\n        s_fe_state.duration_ms = now - s_fe_state.onset_time_ms;\n\n        /* Throttle reports to every 500ms while condition persists */\n        if (now - s_last_fe_report_ms >= 500) {\n            s_last_fe_report_ms = now;\n\n            uint8_t conf = (uint8_t)(count * 30 + 10);\n            if (conf > 100) conf = 100;\n\n            rule_detection_t det = {\n                .type = BEHAVIOR_FOREIGN_EATING,\n                .confidence = conf,\n                .duration_ms = (uint16_t)(s_fe_state.duration_ms > 65535 ?\n                                          65535 : s_fe_state.duration_ms),\n                .condition_mask = mask,\n            };\n            decision_engine_feed_rule(&det);\n        }\n    } else {\n        /* Reset onset when conditions no longer met */\n        if (s_fe_state.onset_time_ms != 0) {\n            s_fe_state.onset_time_ms = 0;\n            s_fe_state.duration_ms = 0;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/* ── Public: IMU feed (50Hz) ─────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nvoid rule_engine_feed_imu(const imu_sample_t *sample)\n{\n    s_imu_window[s_win_idx] = *sample;\n    s_win_idx = (s_win_idx + 1) % IMU_WINDOW_SIZE;\n    if (s_win_count < IMU_WINDOW_SIZE) s_win_count++;\n\n    /* Run full-window detections every complete window */\n    if (s_win_idx == 0 && s_win_count == IMU_WINDOW_SIZE) {\n        check_head_shaking();\n        check_scratching();\n        check_prolonged_still();\n    }\n\n    /* Update foreign-eating IMU conditions every sample */\n    s_fe_state.imu_pitch_low = check_pitch_condition();\n    s_fe_state.imu_chew_vibration = check_chew_vibration_condition();\n    evaluate_foreign_eating();\n}\n\n/* ── Public: Audio feed (~1Hz) ───────────────────────────────────── */\n\nvoid rule_engine_feed_audio(const audio_features_t *features)\n{\n    /* Panting detection */\n    if (features->panting_score >= PANTING_SCORE_THRESHOLD) {\n        rule_detection_t det = {\n            .type = BEHAVIOR_PANTING,\n            .confidence = features->panting_score,\n            .duration_ms = 1000,\n            .condition_mask = 0,\n        };\n        decision_engine_feed_rule(&det);\n    }\n\n    /* Update foreign-eating audio condition */\n    s_fe_state.audio_chewing = (features->chewing_score >= FOREIGN_EAT_AUDIO_THRESHOLD);\n    evaluate_foreign_eating();\n}\n\n/* ── Public: state accessor ──────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nconst foreign_eat_state_t *rule_engine_get_foreign_eat_state(void)\n{\n    return &s_fe_state;\n}\n\n/* ── Initialization ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nint rule_engine_init(void)\n{\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: rule engine initialized\", TAG);\n    memset(s_imu_window, 0, sizeof(s_imu_window));\n    memset(&s_fe_state, 0, sizeof(s_fe_state));\n\n    mpu6050_register_callback(rule_engine_feed_imu);\n    audio_register_callback(rule_engine_feed_audio);\n\n    return OPRT_OK;\n}\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\firmware\\src\\decision_engine.c",
 "contents": "/**\n * Decision engine (Layer 3) for T5AI-CORE.\n *\n * Fuses rule outputs, applies per-behavior cooldown, determines\n * intervention level for foreign eating based on duration and\n * repeat frequency, then triggers local intervention and queues\n * event reports for BLE upload.\n */\n\n#include \"decision_engine.h\"\n#include \"intervention.h\"\n#include \"event_manager.h\"\n#include \"ble_service.h\"\n#include \"pet_collar_config.h\"\n#include \"tal_api.h\"\n\n#define TAG \"decision\"\n\nstatic uint32_t s_last_event_time[8] = {0};\n\n/* Track recent foreign eating events for repeat escalation */\n#define FE_HISTORY_SIZE 8\nstatic uint32_t s_fe_history[FE_HISTORY_SIZE] = {0};\nstatic int s_fe_history_idx = 0;\n\nstatic uint32_t get_time_ms(void)\n{\n    return (uint32_t)tal_system_get_millisecond();\n}\n\nstatic int count_recent_fe_events(uint32_t now)\n{\n    int count = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < FE_HISTORY_SIZE; i++) {\n        if (s_fe_history[i] != 0 &&\n            (now - s_fe_history[i]) < FOREIGN_EAT_REPEAT_WINDOW_MS) {\n            count++;\n        }\n    }\n    return count;\n}\n\nvoid decision_engine_feed_rule(const rule_detection_t *detection)\n{\n    if (detection->confidence < CONFIDENCE_MIN) return;\n\n    uint32_t now = get_time_ms();\n    uint8_t idx = (uint8_t)detection->type;\n\n    /* Per-behavior cooldown */\n    if (idx < 8 && (now - s_last_event_time[idx]) < COOLDOWN_MS) return;\n    if (idx < 8) s_last_event_time[idx] = now;\n\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: event type=%d conf=%d dur=%dms mask=0x%02X\",\n             TAG, detection->type, detection->confidence,\n             detection->duration_ms, detection->condition_mask);\n\n    /* Determine intervention for foreign eating */\n    intervention_level_t level = INTERVENTION_LEVEL_SOFT;\n    uint8_t do_intervention = 0;\n\n    if (detection->type == BEHAVIOR_FOREIGN_EATING) {\n        do_intervention = 1;\n\n        /* Duration-based level */\n        if (detection->duration_ms > FOREIGN_EAT_LEVEL2_MS) {\n            level = INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH;\n        } else if (detection->duration_ms > FOREIGN_EAT_LEVEL1_MS) {\n            level = INTERVENTION_LEVEL_ENHANCED;\n        }\n\n        /* Repeat escalation: if >= N events within the window, force Level 3 */\n        s_fe_history[s_fe_history_idx] = now;\n        s_fe_history_idx = (s_fe_history_idx + 1) % FE_HISTORY_SIZE;\n\n        if (count_recent_fe_events(now) >= FOREIGN_EAT_REPEAT_ESCALATE) {\n            level = INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH;\n        }\n\n        intervention_execute(INTERVENTION_COMBO, level, 0);\n    }\n\n    /* Build event report */\n    event_report_t report = {\n        .packet_type = 0x01,\n        .timestamp = (uint32_t)(now / 1000),\n        .behavior_type = (uint8_t)detection->type,\n        .confidence = detection->confidence,\n        .duration_ms = detection->duration_ms,\n        .intervention_done = do_intervention,\n        .intervention_result = INTERVENTION_RESULT_UNKNOWN,\n        .reserved = detection->condition_mask,  /* low byte = condition mask */\n    };\n\n    event_manager_push(&report);\n    ble_send_event_report(&report);\n}\n\nint decision_engine_init(void)\n{\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: decision engine initialized\", TAG);\n    return OPRT_OK;\n}\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\firmware\\src\\intervention.c",
 "contents": "/**\n * Intervention executor for T5AI-CORE DevKit.\n *\n * Controls vibration motor (GPIO), speaker (PWM), and LEDs (GPIO)\n * using TuyaOpen HAL APIs.\n *\n * Three-level intervention:\n *   Level 1 (Soft):     owner voice + light vibration 500ms + yellow LED\n *   Level 2 (Enhanced): voice + strong vibration 1500ms + red LED flash\n *   Level 3 (High):     repeat Level 2 up to 5 times + red LED constant\n */\n\n#include \"intervention.h\"\n#include \"pet_collar_config.h\"\n#include \"tal_api.h\"\n#include \"tkl_gpio.h\"\n\n#define TAG \"interv\"\n\n/* ── GPIO helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic void motor_on(void)\n{\n    tkl_gpio_write(PIN_MOTOR, TUYA_GPIO_LEVEL_HIGH);\n}\n\nstatic void motor_off(void)\n{\n    tkl_gpio_write(PIN_MOTOR, TUYA_GPIO_LEVEL_LOW);\n}\n\nstatic void led_red_on(void)\n{\n    tkl_gpio_write(PIN_LED_RED, TUYA_GPIO_LEVEL_HIGH);\n}\n\nstatic void led_red_off(void)\n{\n    tkl_gpio_write(PIN_LED_RED, TUYA_GPIO_LEVEL_LOW);\n}\n\nstatic void led_yellow_on(void)\n{\n    tkl_gpio_write(PIN_LED_YELLOW, TUYA_GPIO_LEVEL_HIGH);\n}\n\nstatic void led_yellow_off(void)\n{\n    tkl_gpio_write(PIN_LED_YELLOW, TUYA_GPIO_LEVEL_LOW);\n}\n\nstatic void led_flash(int pin, int count, int period_ms)\n{\n    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {\n        tkl_gpio_write(pin, TUYA_GPIO_LEVEL_HIGH);\n        tal_system_sleep(period_ms / 2);\n        tkl_gpio_write(pin, TUYA_GPIO_LEVEL_LOW);\n        tal_system_sleep(period_ms / 2);\n    }\n}\n\n/* ── Intervention levels ─────────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic void execute_soft(uint8_t audio_slot)\n{\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: Level 1 - soft intervention (slot=%d)\", TAG, audio_slot);\n\n    /* TODO: play audio from slot via PWM/DAC on PIN_SPEAKER */\n\n    motor_on();\n    led_yellow_on();\n    tal_system_sleep(MOTOR_SOFT_DURATION_MS);\n    motor_off();\n\n    /* Flash yellow LED for 2s */\n    led_flash(PIN_LED_YELLOW, 2000 / LED_FLASH_PERIOD_MS, LED_FLASH_PERIOD_MS);\n    led_yellow_off();\n}\n\nstatic void execute_enhanced(uint8_t audio_slot)\n{\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: Level 2 - enhanced intervention (slot=%d)\", TAG, audio_slot);\n\n    /* TODO: play audio slot */\n\n    motor_on();\n    led_red_on();\n    tal_system_sleep(MOTOR_STRONG_DURATION_MS);\n    motor_off();\n\n    /* Flash red LED for 3s */\n    led_flash(PIN_LED_RED, 3000 / LED_FLASH_PERIOD_MS, LED_FLASH_PERIOD_MS);\n    led_red_off();\n}\n\nstatic void execute_high(uint8_t audio_slot)\n{\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: Level 3 - high intervention (slot=%d)\", TAG, audio_slot);\n\n    led_red_on();\n\n    for (int i = 0; i < LEVEL3_MAX_REPEATS; i++) {\n        /* TODO: play audio slot */\n        motor_on();\n        tal_system_sleep(MOTOR_STRONG_DURATION_MS);\n        motor_off();\n        tal_system_sleep(LEVEL3_REPEAT_INTERVAL_MS);\n    }\n\n    /* Keep red LED on for continued visibility */\n}\n\n/* ── Public API ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nint intervention_init(void)\n{\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: initializing intervention hardware\", TAG);\n\n    TUYA_GPIO_BASE_CFG_T out_cfg = {\n        .mode = TUYA_GPIO_PULLDOWN,\n        .direct = TUYA_GPIO_OUTPUT,\n        .level = TUYA_GPIO_LEVEL_LOW,\n    };\n\n    tkl_gpio_init(PIN_MOTOR, &out_cfg);\n    tkl_gpio_init(PIN_LED_RED, &out_cfg);\n    tkl_gpio_init(PIN_LED_YELLOW, &out_cfg);\n\n    /* TODO: init PWM for speaker on PIN_SPEAKER */\n\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: GPIO pins configured (motor=%d, led_r=%d, led_y=%d)\",\n             TAG, PIN_MOTOR, PIN_LED_RED, PIN_LED_YELLOW);\n    return OPRT_OK;\n}\n\nint intervention_execute(intervention_cmd_type_t cmd_type,\n                         intervention_level_t level,\n                         uint8_t audio_slot)\n{\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: execute cmd=%d level=%d slot=%d\", TAG, cmd_type, level, audio_slot);\n\n    switch (level) {\n    case INTERVENTION_LEVEL_SOFT:\n        execute_soft(audio_slot);\n        break;\n    case INTERVENTION_LEVEL_ENHANCED:\n        execute_enhanced(audio_slot);\n        break;\n    case INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH:\n        execute_high(audio_slot);\n        break;\n    default:\n        execute_soft(audio_slot);\n        break;\n    }\n\n    return OPRT_OK;\n}\n"
}

 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\firmware\\src\\event_manager.c",
 "contents": "/**\n * Event manager - ring buffer for offline event storage on T5AI-CORE.\n *\n * Stores up to EVENT_BUFFER_MAX events when BLE is disconnected.\n * Events are uploaded in FIFO order when connection resumes.\n */\n\n#include \"event_manager.h\"\n#include \"tal_api.h\"\n#include <string.h>\n\n#define TAG \"evt_mgr\"\n\nstatic event_report_t s_buffer[EVENT_BUFFER_MAX];\nstatic int s_head = 0;\nstatic int s_tail = 0;\nstatic int s_count = 0;\n\nint event_manager_init(void)\n{\n    s_head = 0;\n    s_tail = 0;\n    s_count = 0;\n    memset(s_buffer, 0, sizeof(s_buffer));\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: initialized (capacity=%d)\", TAG, EVENT_BUFFER_MAX);\n    return OPRT_OK;\n}\n\nint event_manager_push(const event_report_t *report)\n{\n    s_buffer[s_head] = *report;\n    s_head = (s_head + 1) % EVENT_BUFFER_MAX;\n    if (s_count < EVENT_BUFFER_MAX) {\n        s_count++;\n    } else {\n        s_tail = (s_tail + 1) % EVENT_BUFFER_MAX;\n    }\n    return OPRT_OK;\n}\n\nint event_manager_pending_count(void)\n{\n    return s_count;\n}\n\nint event_manager_pop(event_report_t *out)\n{\n    if (s_count == 0) return OPRT_NOT_FOUND;\n    *out = s_buffer[s_tail];\n    s_tail = (s_tail + 1) % EVENT_BUFFER_MAX;\n    s_count--;\n    return OPRT_OK;\n}\n"
}

- **`mpu6050_driver.c/h`** -- 基于涂鸦官方 I2C HAL (`tkl_i2c`) 驱动 MPU6050，SCL=P20/SDA=P21，50Hz 定时器采样，完整初始化流程（复位 -> WHO_AM_I校验 -> 配置 +/-2g / +/-2000dps / 50Hz / 20Hz DLPF）

  - 条件1：`atan2f` 计算 pitch 俯角，滑动窗口 >60% 样本 < -30 度

- **`event_manager.c/h`** / **`ble_service.c/h`** / **`audio_driver.c/h`** -- 适配 TuyaOpen API

 "contents": "#ifndef INTERVENTION_H\n#define INTERVENTION_H\n\n#include \"../../protocol/ble_gatt_profile.h\"\n\n/**\n * Initialize intervention hardware:\n *   - Vibration motor GPIO (PIN_MOTOR)\n *   - Speaker PWM (PIN_SPEAKER)\n *   - LED GPIO (PIN_LED_RED, PIN_LED_YELLOW)\n * Returns OPRT_OK on success.\n */\nint intervention_init(void);\n\n/**\n * Execute an intervention action.\n *\n * Level 1 (Soft):     play audio slot + light vibration 500ms + yellow LED 2s\n * Level 2 (Enhanced): play audio slot + strong vibration 1500ms + red LED 3s\n * Level 3 (High):     repeat Level 2 up to 5 times (3s interval) + red LED solid\n *\n * @param cmd_type   VOICE, VIBRATE, LED, or COMBO\n * @param level      SOFT, ENHANCED, or HIGH\n * @param audio_slot Audio slot ID (0-7) for voice playback\n * Returns OPRT_OK on success.\n */\nint intervention_execute(intervention_cmd_type_t cmd_type,\n                         intervention_level_t level,\n                         uint8_t audio_slot);\n\n/**\n * Stop any ongoing Level 3 repeat sequence immediately.\n */\nvoid intervention_stop(void);\n\n#endif\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\firmware\\src\\decision_engine.c",
 "contents": "/**\n * Decision engine (Layer 3) for T5AI-CORE.\n *\n * Fuses rule-engine outputs, applies per-behavior cooldown,\n * determines three-level intervention for foreign eating,\n * auto-escalates on repeated events, and queues BLE reports.\n */\n\n#include \"decision_engine.h\"\n#include \"intervention.h\"\n#include \"event_manager.h\"\n#include \"ble_service.h\"\n#include \"pet_collar_config.h\"\n#include \"tal_api.h\"\n\n#define TAG \"decision\"\n\n/* ── Per-behavior cooldown tracking ──────────────────────────────── */\n\n#define MAX_BEHAVIOR_TYPES  8\n\nstatic uint32_t s_last_event_ms[MAX_BEHAVIOR_TYPES] = {0};\n\n/* ── Foreign-eating repeat-escalation ring buffer ────────────────── */\n\n#define REPEAT_RING_SIZE  8\n\nstatic uint32_t s_fe_timestamps[REPEAT_RING_SIZE];\nstatic int      s_fe_ring_head = 0;\nstatic int      s_fe_ring_count = 0;\n\nstatic uint32_t get_time_ms(void)\n{\n    return (uint32_t)tal_system_get_millisecond();\n}\n\n/**\n * Record a foreign-eating event timestamp and return the number\n * of events that fall within the repeat-escalation window.\n */\nstatic int record_and_count_repeats(uint32_t now_ms)\n{\n    s_fe_timestamps[s_fe_ring_head] = now_ms;\n    s_fe_ring_head = (s_fe_ring_head + 1) % REPEAT_RING_SIZE;\n    if (s_fe_ring_count < REPEAT_RING_SIZE) s_fe_ring_count++;\n\n    int recent = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < s_fe_ring_count; i++) {\n        if ((now_ms - s_fe_timestamps[i]) <= FOREIGN_EAT_REPEAT_WINDOW_MS) {\n            recent++;\n        }\n    }\n    return recent;\n}\n\n/* ── Level determination ─────────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic intervention_level_t determine_level(uint16_t duration_ms,\n                                            int repeat_count)\n{\n    /* Repeated events within the window force Level 3 */\n    if (repeat_count >= FOREIGN_EAT_REPEAT_ESCALATE)\n        return INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH;\n\n    if (duration_ms > FOREIGN_EAT_LEVEL2_MS)\n        return INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH;\n    if (duration_ms > FOREIGN_EAT_LEVEL1_MS)\n        return INTERVENTION_LEVEL_ENHANCED;\n\n    return INTERVENTION_LEVEL_SOFT;\n}\n\n/* ── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nvoid decision_engine_feed_rule(const rule_detection_t *detection)\n{\n    if (detection->confidence < CONFIDENCE_MIN) return;\n\n    uint32_t now = get_time_ms();\n    uint8_t idx = (uint8_t)detection->type;\n\n    /* Per-behavior cooldown (skipped for FOREIGN_EATING since the rule\n       engine already throttles reports to every 500ms) */\n    if (detection->type != BEHAVIOR_FOREIGN_EATING) {\n        if (idx < MAX_BEHAVIOR_TYPES &&\n            (now - s_last_event_ms[idx]) < COOLDOWN_MS) {\n            return;\n        }\n    }\n    if (idx < MAX_BEHAVIOR_TYPES) s_last_event_ms[idx] = now;\n\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: event type=%d conf=%d dur=%dms mask=0x%02X\",\n             TAG, detection->type, detection->confidence,\n             detection->duration_ms, detection->condition_mask);\n\n    /* ── Foreign-eating specific: level + repeat escalation ──── */\n    intervention_level_t level = INTERVENTION_LEVEL_SOFT;\n\n    if (detection->type == BEHAVIOR_FOREIGN_EATING) {\n        int repeats = record_and_count_repeats(now);\n        level = determine_level(detection->duration_ms, repeats);\n\n        PR_DEBUG(\"%s: foreign_eat level=%d repeats=%d dur=%dms\",\n                 TAG, level, repeats, detection->duration_ms);\n\n        intervention_execute(INTERVENTION_COMBO, level, 0);\n    }\n\n    /* ── Build and dispatch event report ─────────────────────── */\n    event_report_t report = {\n        .packet_type        = 0x01,\n        .timestamp          = (uint32_t)(get_time_ms() / 1000),\n        .behavior_type      = (uint8_t)detection->type,\n        .confidence         = detection->confidence,\n        .duration_ms        = detection->duration_ms,\n        .intervention_done  = (detection->type == BEHAVIOR_FOREIGN_EATING) ? 1 : 0,\n        .intervention_result = INTERVENTION_RESULT_UNKNOWN,\n        .reserved           = 0,\n    };\n\n    /* Pack condition_mask into reserved low byte, level into high byte */\n    if (detection->type == BEHAVIOR_FOREIGN_EATING) {\n        report.reserved = (uint16_t)((level << 8) | detection->condition_mask);\n    }\n\n    event_manager_push(&report);\n    ble_send_event_report(&report);\n}\n\nint decision_engine_get_repeat_count(void)\n{\n    uint32_t now = get_time_ms();\n    int recent = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < s_fe_ring_count; i++) {\n        if ((now - s_fe_timestamps[i]) <= FOREIGN_EAT_REPEAT_WINDOW_MS) {\n            recent++;\n        }\n    }\n    return recent;\n}\n\nint decision_engine_init(void)\n{\n    memset(s_last_event_ms, 0, sizeof(s_last_event_ms));\n    memset(s_fe_timestamps, 0, sizeof(s_fe_timestamps));\n    s_fe_ring_head = 0;\n    s_fe_ring_count = 0;\n\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: decision engine initialized\", TAG);\n    return OPRT_OK;\n}\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\firmware\\src\\intervention.c",
 "contents": "/**\n * Intervention executor for T5AI-CORE DevKit.\n *\n * Controls vibration motor (GPIO), speaker (PWM), and LED indicators\n * to perform three-level intervention on detected foreign eating.\n *\n * Hardware:\n *   Motor   – PIN_MOTOR (P6),  GPIO push-pull output\n *   Speaker – PIN_SPEAKER (D0), PWM 2kHz square wave (buzzer tone)\n *   LED Red – PIN_LED_RED (P8), GPIO push-pull output\n *   LED Yel – PIN_LED_YELLOW (P9), GPIO push-pull output\n */\n\n#include \"intervention.h\"\n#include \"pet_collar_config.h\"\n#include \"tal_api.h\"\n#include \"tkl_gpio.h\"\n#include \"tkl_pwm.h\"\n\n#define TAG \"interv\"\n\n/* ── PWM channel for speaker ─────────────────────────────────────── */\n#define SPEAKER_PWM_CH        0\n#define SPEAKER_FREQ_HZ       2000\n#define SPEAKER_DUTY_PERCENT  50\n\n/* ── State for Level 3 repeat loop ───────────────────────────────── */\nstatic TIMER_ID s_motor_off_timer   = NULL;\nstatic TIMER_ID s_led_flash_timer   = NULL;\nstatic TIMER_ID s_led_off_timer     = NULL;\nstatic TIMER_ID s_level3_timer      = NULL;\nstatic int      s_level3_remaining  = 0;\nstatic uint8_t  s_level3_slot       = 0;\nstatic volatile bool s_level3_active = false;\n\n/* ── GPIO helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic void motor_on(void)\n{\n    tkl_gpio_write(PIN_MOTOR, TUYA_GPIO_LEVEL_HIGH);\n}\n\nstatic void motor_off(void)\n{\n    tkl_gpio_write(PIN_MOTOR, TUYA_GPIO_LEVEL_LOW);\n}\n\nstatic void led_red_on(void)\n{\n    tkl_gpio_write(PIN_LED_RED, TUYA_GPIO_LEVEL_HIGH);\n}\n\nstatic void led_red_off(void)\n{\n    tkl_gpio_write(PIN_LED_RED, TUYA_GPIO_LEVEL_LOW);\n}\n\nstatic void led_yellow_on(void)\n{\n    tkl_gpio_write(PIN_LED_YELLOW, TUYA_GPIO_LEVEL_HIGH);\n}\n\nstatic void led_yellow_off(void)\n{\n    tkl_gpio_write(PIN_LED_YELLOW, TUYA_GPIO_LEVEL_LOW);\n}\n\nstatic void speaker_on(void)\n{\n    tkl_pwm_start(SPEAKER_PWM_CH);\n}\n\nstatic void speaker_off(void)\n{\n    tkl_pwm_stop(SPEAKER_PWM_CH);\n}\n\n/* ── Timer callbacks ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic void motor_off_timer_cb(TIMER_ID tid, void *arg)\n{\n    motor_off();\n}\n\nstatic void led_off_timer_cb(TIMER_ID tid, void *arg)\n{\n    led_red_off();\n    led_yellow_off();\n    speaker_off();\n}\n\nstatic volatile bool s_led_flash_state = false;\n\nstatic void led_flash_timer_cb(TIMER_ID tid, void *arg)\n{\n    uintptr_t pin = (uintptr_t)arg;\n    s_led_flash_state = !s_led_flash_state;\n    tkl_gpio_write((TUYA_GPIO_NUM_E)pin,\n                   s_led_flash_state ? TUYA_GPIO_LEVEL_HIGH : TUYA_GPIO_LEVEL_LOW);\n}\n\n/* ── Single-shot intervention actions ────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic void execute_level1(uint8_t audio_slot)\n{\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: Level 1 – light vibration 500ms + yellow LED 2s\", TAG);\n\n    speaker_on();\n    motor_on();\n    tal_sw_timer_start(s_motor_off_timer, MOTOR_SOFT_DURATION_MS, TAL_TIMER_ONCE);\n\n    /* Yellow LED flash for 2s */\n    tal_sw_timer_stop(s_led_flash_timer);\n    tal_sw_timer_start(s_led_flash_timer, LED_FLASH_PERIOD_MS, TAL_TIMER_CYCLE);\n    tal_sw_timer_start(s_led_off_timer, 2000, TAL_TIMER_ONCE);\n}\n\nstatic void execute_level2(uint8_t audio_slot)\n{\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: Level 2 – strong vibration 1500ms + red LED 3s\", TAG);\n\n    speaker_on();\n    motor_on();\n    tal_sw_timer_start(s_motor_off_timer, MOTOR_STRONG_DURATION_MS, TAL_TIMER_ONCE);\n\n    /* Red LED flash for 3s */\n    tal_sw_timer_stop(s_led_flash_timer);\n    tal_sw_timer_start(s_led_flash_timer, LED_FLASH_PERIOD_MS, TAL_TIMER_CYCLE);\n    tal_sw_timer_start(s_led_off_timer, 3000, TAL_TIMER_ONCE);\n}\n\n/* ── Level 3 repeat timer callback ───────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic void level3_repeat_cb(TIMER_ID tid, void *arg)\n{\n    if (!s_level3_active || s_level3_remaining <= 0) {\n        s_level3_active = false;\n        tal_sw_timer_stop(s_level3_timer);\n        led_red_off();\n        speaker_off();\n        motor_off();\n        PR_DEBUG(\"%s: Level 3 repeat sequence finished\", TAG);\n        return;\n    }\n\n    s_level3_remaining--;\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: Level 3 repeat %d remaining\", TAG, s_level3_remaining);\n    execute_level2(s_level3_slot);\n}\n\nstatic void execute_level3(uint8_t audio_slot)\n{\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: Level 3 – repeat %d times + red LED solid\", TAG, LEVEL3_MAX_REPEATS);\n\n    s_level3_active = true;\n    s_level3_remaining = LEVEL3_MAX_REPEATS - 1;\n    s_level3_slot = audio_slot;\n\n    led_red_on();\n    execute_level2(audio_slot);\n\n    tal_sw_timer_start(s_level3_timer, LEVEL3_REPEAT_INTERVAL_MS, TAL_TIMER_CYCLE);\n}\n\n/* ── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nint intervention_execute(intervention_cmd_type_t cmd_type,\n                         intervention_level_t level,\n                         uint8_t audio_slot)\n{\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: execute cmd=%d level=%d slot=%d\", TAG, cmd_type, level, audio_slot);\n\n    /* If a Level 3 sequence is already running, only allow escalation */\n    if (s_level3_active && level < INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH) {\n        PR_DEBUG(\"%s: Level 3 active, ignoring lower-level request\", TAG);\n        return OPRT_OK;\n    }\n\n    switch (cmd_type) {\n    case INTERVENTION_VOICE:\n        speaker_on();\n        tal_sw_timer_start(s_led_off_timer, 2000, TAL_TIMER_ONCE);\n        break;\n\n    case INTERVENTION_VIBRATE:\n        motor_on();\n        tal_sw_timer_start(s_motor_off_timer,\n                           (level == INTERVENTION_LEVEL_SOFT)\n                               ? MOTOR_SOFT_DURATION_MS\n                               : MOTOR_STRONG_DURATION_MS,\n                           TAL_TIMER_ONCE);\n        break;\n\n    case INTERVENTION_LED:\n        if (level == INTERVENTION_LEVEL_SOFT) led_yellow_on();\n        else led_red_on();\n        tal_sw_timer_start(s_led_off_timer, 2000, TAL_TIMER_ONCE);\n        break;\n\n    case INTERVENTION_COMBO:\n    default:\n        switch (level) {\n        case INTERVENTION_LEVEL_SOFT:     execute_level1(audio_slot); break;\n        case INTERVENTION_LEVEL_ENHANCED: execute_level2(audio_slot); break;\n        case INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH:     execute_level3(audio_slot); break;\n        }\n        break;\n    }\n\n    return OPRT_OK;\n}\n\nvoid intervention_stop(void)\n{\n    s_level3_active = false;\n    s_level3_remaining = 0;\n\n    tal_sw_timer_stop(s_level3_timer);\n    tal_sw_timer_stop(s_motor_off_timer);\n    tal_sw_timer_stop(s_led_flash_timer);\n    tal_sw_timer_stop(s_led_off_timer);\n\n    motor_off();\n    speaker_off();\n    led_red_off();\n    led_yellow_off();\n\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: all interventions stopped\", TAG);\n}\n\n/* ── Initialization ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic int init_gpio_output(TUYA_GPIO_NUM_E pin)\n{\n    TUYA_GPIO_BASE_CFG_T cfg = {\n        .mode   = TUYA_GPIO_PUSH_PULL,\n        .direct = TUYA_GPIO_OUTPUT,\n        .level  = TUYA_GPIO_LEVEL_LOW,\n    };\n    return tkl_gpio_init(pin, &cfg);\n}\n\nint intervention_init(void)\n{\n    int ret;\n\n    /* Motor GPIO */\n    ret = init_gpio_output(PIN_MOTOR);\n    if (ret != OPRT_OK) {\n        PR_ERR(\"%s: motor GPIO init failed: %d\", TAG, ret);\n        return ret;\n    }\n\n    /* LED GPIOs */\n    ret = init_gpio_output(PIN_LED_RED);\n    if (ret != OPRT_OK) {\n        PR_ERR(\"%s: red LED GPIO init failed: %d\", TAG, ret);\n        return ret;\n    }\n    ret = init_gpio_output(PIN_LED_YELLOW);\n    if (ret != OPRT_OK) {\n        PR_ERR(\"%s: yellow LED GPIO init failed: %d\", TAG, ret);\n        return ret;\n    }\n\n    /* Speaker PWM */\n    TUYA_PWM_BASE_CFG_T pwm_cfg = {\n        .frequency = SPEAKER_FREQ_HZ,\n        .duty      = SPEAKER_DUTY_PERCENT,\n        .polarity  = TUYA_PWM_POSITIVE,\n    };\n    ret = tkl_pwm_init(SPEAKER_PWM_CH, &pwm_cfg);\n    if (ret != OPRT_OK) {\n        PR_ERR(\"%s: speaker PWM init failed: %d\", TAG, ret);\n        return ret;\n    }\n\n    /* Create one-shot / cyclic timers */\n    tal_sw_timer_create(motor_off_timer_cb, NULL, &s_motor_off_timer);\n    tal_sw_timer_create(led_off_timer_cb, NULL, &s_led_off_timer);\n    tal_sw_timer_create(level3_repeat_cb, NULL, &s_level3_timer);\n\n    /* LED flash timer – arg carries the pin number for the current flash */\n    tal_sw_timer_create(led_flash_timer_cb, (void *)(uintptr_t)PIN_LED_YELLOW,\n                        &s_led_flash_timer);\n\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: intervention module initialized\", TAG);\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s:   motor=P%d  speaker=PWM%d  led_red=P%d  led_yellow=P%d\",\n             TAG, PIN_MOTOR, SPEAKER_PWM_CH, PIN_LED_RED, PIN_LED_YELLOW);\n    return OPRT_OK;\n}\n"
}

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\firmware\\src\\event_manager.c",
 "contents": "/**\n * Event manager - ring buffer for offline event storage.\n *\n * Stores up to EVENT_BUFFER_MAX events when BLE is disconnected.\n * Events are uploaded in FIFO order when connection resumes.\n */\n\n#include \"event_manager.h\"\n#include \"tal_api.h\"\n#include <string.h>\n\n#define TAG \"evt_mgr\"\n\nstatic event_report_t s_buffer[EVENT_BUFFER_MAX];\nstatic int s_head  = 0;\nstatic int s_tail  = 0;\nstatic int s_count = 0;\n\nint event_manager_init(void)\n{\n    s_head  = 0;\n    s_tail  = 0;\n    s_count = 0;\n    memset(s_buffer, 0, sizeof(s_buffer));\n    PR_DEBUG(\"%s: event manager initialized (capacity=%d)\", TAG, EVENT_BUFFER_MAX);\n    return OPRT_OK;\n}\n\nint event_manager_push(const event_report_t *report)\n{\n    s_buffer[s_head] = *report;\n    s_head = (s_head + 1) % EVENT_BUFFER_MAX;\n    if (s_count < EVENT_BUFFER_MAX) {\n        s_count++;\n    } else {\n        s_tail = (s_tail + 1) % EVENT_BUFFER_MAX;\n    }\n    return OPRT_OK;\n}\n\nint event_manager_pending_count(void)\n{\n    return s_count;\n}\n\nint event_manager_pop(event_report_t *out)\n{\n    if (s_count == 0) return OPRT_NOT_FOUND;\n    *out = s_buffer[s_tail];\n    s_tail = (s_tail + 1) % EVENT_BUFFER_MAX;\n    s_count--;\n    return OPRT_OK;\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "/**\n * Decision engine (Layer 3) - fuses rule and model outputs.\n *\n * Applies cooldown to avoid duplicate events, determines three-level\n * intervention for foreign eating with repeat-escalation, triggers\n * local intervention, and queues events for BLE upload.\n */\n\n#include \"decision_engine.h\"\n#include \"intervention.h\"\n#include \"event_manager.h\"\n#include \"ble_service.h\"\n#include \"esp_log.h\"\n#include \"esp_timer.h\"\n\nstatic const char *TAG = \"decision\";\n\n#define COOLDOWN_MS                  10000\n#define CONFIDENCE_MIN               50\n#define FOREIGN_EAT_LEVEL1_MS        2000\n#define FOREIGN_EAT_LEVEL2_MS        5000\n#define FOREIGN_EAT_REPEAT_WINDOW_MS 60000\n#define FOREIGN_EAT_REPEAT_ESCALATE  2\n#define MAX_BEHAVIOR_TYPES           8\n\nstatic uint32_t last_event_time[MAX_BEHAVIOR_TYPES] = {0};\n\n/* ── Foreign-eating repeat-escalation ring buffer ────────────────── */\n\n#define REPEAT_RING_SIZE  8\n\nstatic uint32_t s_fe_timestamps[REPEAT_RING_SIZE];\nstatic int      s_fe_ring_head = 0;\nstatic int      s_fe_ring_count = 0;\n\nstatic uint32_t get_time_ms(void)\n{\n    return (uint32_t)(esp_timer_get_time() / 1000);\n}\n\nstatic int record_and_count_repeats(uint32_t now_ms)\n{\n    s_fe_timestamps[s_fe_ring_head] = now_ms;\n    s_fe_ring_head = (s_fe_ring_head + 1) % REPEAT_RING_SIZE;\n    if (s_fe_ring_count < REPEAT_RING_SIZE) s_fe_ring_count++;\n\n    int recent = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < s_fe_ring_count; i++) {\n        if ((now_ms - s_fe_timestamps[i]) <= FOREIGN_EAT_REPEAT_WINDOW_MS) {\n            recent++;\n        }\n    }\n    return recent;\n}\n\nstatic intervention_level_t determine_level(uint16_t duration_ms,\n                                            int repeat_count)\n{\n    if (repeat_count >= FOREIGN_EAT_REPEAT_ESCALATE)\n        return INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH;\n\n    if (duration_ms > FOREIGN_EAT_LEVEL2_MS)\n        return INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH;\n    if (duration_ms > FOREIGN_EAT_LEVEL1_MS)\n        return INTERVENTION_LEVEL_ENHANCED;\n\n    return INTERVENTION_LEVEL_SOFT;\n}\n\nvoid decision_engine_feed_rule(const rule_detection_t *detection)\n{\n    if (detection->confidence < CONFIDENCE_MIN) return;\n\n    uint32_t now = get_time_ms();\n    uint8_t idx = (uint8_t)detection->type;\n\n    if (detection->type != BEHAVIOR_FOREIGN_EATING) {\n        if (idx < MAX_BEHAVIOR_TYPES &&\n            (now - last_event_time[idx]) < COOLDOWN_MS) {\n            return;\n        }\n    }\n    if (idx < MAX_BEHAVIOR_TYPES) last_event_time[idx] = now;\n\n    ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Event: type=%d conf=%d dur=%dms mask=0x%02X\",\n             detection->type, detection->confidence,\n             detection->duration_ms, detection->condition_mask);\n\n    intervention_level_t level = INTERVENTION_LEVEL_SOFT;\n\n    if (detection->type == BEHAVIOR_FOREIGN_EATING) {\n        int repeats = record_and_count_repeats(now);\n        level = determine_level(detection->duration_ms, repeats);\n\n        ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"foreign_eat level=%d repeats=%d dur=%dms\",\n                 level, repeats, detection->duration_ms);\n\n        intervention_execute(INTERVENTION_COMBO, level, 0);\n    }\n\n    event_report_t report = {\n        .packet_type        = 0x01,\n        .timestamp          = (uint32_t)(esp_timer_get_time() / 1000000),\n        .behavior_type      = (uint8_t)detection->type,\n        .confidence         = detection->confidence,\n        .duration_ms        = detection->duration_ms,\n        .intervention_done  = (detection->type == BEHAVIOR_FOREIGN_EATING) ? 1 : 0,\n        .intervention_result = INTERVENTION_RESULT_UNKNOWN,\n        .reserved           = 0,\n    };\n\n    if (detection->type == BEHAVIOR_FOREIGN_EATING) {\n        report.reserved = (uint16_t)((level << 8) | detection->condition_mask);\n    }\n\n    event_manager_push(&report);\n    ble_send_event_report(&report);\n}\n\nint decision_engine_get_repeat_count(void)\n{\n    uint32_t now = get_time_ms();\n    int recent = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < s_fe_ring_count; i++) {\n        if ((now - s_fe_timestamps[i]) <= FOREIGN_EAT_REPEAT_WINDOW_MS) {\n            recent++;\n        }\n    }\n    return recent;\n}\n\nesp_err_t decision_engine_init(void)\n{\n    memset(last_event_time, 0, sizeof(last_event_time));\n    memset(s_fe_timestamps, 0, sizeof(s_fe_timestamps));\n    s_fe_ring_head = 0;\n    s_fe_ring_count = 0;\n\n    ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Decision engine initialized\");\n    return ESP_OK;\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "/**\n * Rule-based behavior detection (Layer 1).\n *\n * Detectors:\n * - Head shaking: high-frequency angular velocity burst\n * - Scratching: repetitive rhythmic limb vibration\n * - Prolonged still: low activity for extended period\n * - Panting: high-frequency short-cycle breathing\n * - Foreign eating: MULTI-CONDITION FUSION\n *     Condition 1: head-down pitch angle < -30 degrees\n *     Condition 2: high-frequency chewing vibration (accel variance)\n *     Condition 3: audio chewing score >= 60\n *     Triggers when >= 2 conditions are simultaneously met.\n */\n\n#include \"rule_engine.h\"\n#include \"decision_engine.h\"\n#include \"esp_log.h\"\n#include \"esp_timer.h\"\n#include <math.h>\n#include <string.h>\n\nstatic const char *TAG = \"rule_eng\";\n\n/* ── Sliding window for IMU analysis ─────────────────────────────── */\n#define WINDOW_SIZE          50   /* 1 second at 50Hz */\n#define CHEW_VAR_WINDOW      10   /* 200ms sub-window */\n\nstatic imu_sample_t imu_window[WINDOW_SIZE];\nstatic int window_idx = 0;\nstatic int window_count = 0;\n\n/* ── Thresholds ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */\n#define HEAD_SHAKE_GYRO_THRESHOLD  15000  /* mdps */\n#define HEAD_SHAKE_MIN_BURSTS      3\n#define SCRATCH_ACCEL_THRESHOLD    2000   /* mg */\n#define SCRATCH_MIN_CYCLES         5\n#define STILL_ACCEL_THRESHOLD      200    /* mg */\n#define STILL_MIN_DURATION_MS      60000\n#define FOREIGN_EAT_PITCH_DEG      (-30)\n#define FOREIGN_EAT_CHEW_VAR       1500   /* mg^2 */\n#define FOREIGN_EAT_AUDIO_THRESH   60\n#define FOREIGN_EAT_MIN_CONDS      2\n#define PANTING_SCORE_THRESHOLD    60\n\n/* ── Foreign eating multi-condition state ────────────────────────── */\nstatic foreign_eat_state_t s_fe_state = {0};\nstatic uint32_t still_start_ms = 0;\nstatic uint32_t s_last_fe_report_ms = 0;\n\nstatic uint32_t get_time_ms(void)\n{\n    return (uint32_t)(esp_timer_get_time() / 1000);\n}\n\n/* ── Head shaking detector ───────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic void check_head_shaking(void)\n{\n    int bursts = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < window_count; i++) {\n        if (abs(imu_window[i].gyro_x) > HEAD_SHAKE_GYRO_THRESHOLD ||\n            abs(imu_window[i].gyro_y) > HEAD_SHAKE_GYRO_THRESHOLD) {\n            bursts++;\n        }\n    }\n    if (bursts >= HEAD_SHAKE_MIN_BURSTS) {\n        rule_detection_t det = {\n            .type = BEHAVIOR_HEAD_SHAKING,\n            .confidence = (uint8_t)((bursts * 100) / window_count),\n            .duration_ms = (uint16_t)(window_count * (1000 / 50)),\n            .condition_mask = 0,\n        };\n        if (det.confidence > 100) det.confidence = 100;\n        decision_engine_feed_rule(&det);\n    }\n}\n\n/* ── Scratching detector ─────────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic void check_scratching(void)\n{\n    int cycles = 0;\n    int prev_sign = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < window_count; i++) {\n        int sign = imu_window[i].accel_z > 0 ? 1 : -1;\n        if (abs(imu_window[i].accel_z) > SCRATCH_ACCEL_THRESHOLD && sign != prev_sign) {\n            cycles++;\n        }\n        prev_sign = sign;\n    }\n    if (cycles >= SCRATCH_MIN_CYCLES) {\n        rule_detection_t det = {\n            .type = BEHAVIOR_SCRATCHING,\n            .confidence = (uint8_t)((cycles * 100) / (window_count / 2)),\n            .duration_ms = (uint16_t)(window_count * (1000 / 50)),\n            .condition_mask = 0,\n        };\n        if (det.confidence > 100) det.confidence = 100;\n        decision_engine_feed_rule(&det);\n    }\n}\n\n/* ── Prolonged still detector ────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic void check_prolonged_still(void)\n{\n    int low_activity = 1;\n    for (int i = 0; i < window_count; i++) {\n        int mag = abs(imu_window[i].accel_x) +\n                  abs(imu_window[i].accel_y) +\n                  abs(imu_window[i].accel_z);\n        if (mag > STILL_ACCEL_THRESHOLD * 3) {\n            low_activity = 0;\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    uint32_t now = get_time_ms();\n    if (low_activity) {\n        if (still_start_ms == 0) still_start_ms = now;\n        uint32_t duration = now - still_start_ms;\n        if (duration >= STILL_MIN_DURATION_MS) {\n            rule_detection_t det = {\n                .type = BEHAVIOR_PROLONGED_STILL,\n                .confidence = 70,\n                .duration_ms = (uint16_t)(duration > 65535 ? 65535 : duration),\n                .condition_mask = 0,\n            };\n            decision_engine_feed_rule(&det);\n        }\n    } else {\n        still_start_ms = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n/* ── Foreign eating: pitch angle calculation ─────────────────────── */\n\nstatic float compute_pitch_deg(const imu_sample_t *s)\n{\n    float ax = (float)s->accel_x;\n    float ay = (float)s->accel_y;\n    float az = (float)s->accel_z;\n    return atan2f(ax, sqrtf(ay * ay + az * az)) * 57.2957795f;\n}\n\n/* ── Foreign eating: condition 1 - sustained head-down pitch ─────── */\n\nstatic bool check_pitch_condition(void)\n{\n    if (window_count < WINDOW_SIZE / 2) return false;\n\n    int low_count = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < window_count; i++) {\n        float pitch = compute_pitch_deg(&imu_window[i]);\n        if (pitch < (float)FOREIGN_EAT_PITCH_DEG) {\n            low_count++;\n        }\n    }\n    return low_count > (window_count * 60 / 100);\n}\n\n/* ── Foreign eating: condition 2 - chewing vibration variance ────── */\n\nstatic bool check_chew_vibration_condition(void)\n{\n    if (window_count < CHEW_VAR_WINDOW) return false;\n\n    int start = (window_idx - CHEW_VAR_WINDOW + WINDOW_SIZE) % WINDOW_SIZE;\n\n    int32_t sum = 0;\n    int32_t sum_sq = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < CHEW_VAR_WINDOW; i++) {\n        int idx = (start + i) % WINDOW_SIZE;\n        int32_t mag = abs(imu_window[idx].accel_x) +\n                      abs(imu_window[idx].accel_y) +\n                      abs(imu_window[idx].accel_z);\n        sum += mag;\n        sum_sq += mag * mag;\n    }\n    int32_t mean = sum / CHEW_VAR_WINDOW;\n    int32_t variance = (sum_sq / CHEW_VAR_WINDOW) - (mean * mean);\n\n    return variance > FOREIGN_EAT_CHEW_VAR;\n}\n\n/* ── Foreign eating: multi-condition fusion ───────────────────────── */\n\nstatic void evaluate_foreign_eating(void)\n{\n    uint8_t mask = 0;\n    uint8_t count = 0;\n\n    if (s_fe_state.imu_pitch_low)       { mask |= COND_MASK_PITCH;     count++; }\n    if (s_fe_state.imu_chew_vibration)  { mask |= COND_MASK_VIBRATION; count++; }\n    if (s_fe_state.audio_chewing)       { mask |= COND_MASK_AUDIO;     count++; }\n\n    s_fe_state.condition_count = count;\n    s_fe_state.condition_mask = mask;\n\n    uint32_t now = get_time_ms();\n\n    if (count >= FOREIGN_EAT_MIN_CONDS) {\n        if (s_fe_state.onset_time_ms == 0) {\n            s_fe_state.onset_time_ms = now;\n        }\n        s_fe_state.duration_ms = now - s_fe_state.onset_time_ms;\n\n        if (now - s_last_fe_report_ms >= 500) {\n            s_last_fe_report_ms = now;\n\n            uint8_t conf = (uint8_t)(count * 30 + 10);\n            if (conf > 100) conf = 100;\n\n            rule_detection_t det = {\n                .type = BEHAVIOR_FOREIGN_EATING,\n                .confidence = conf,\n                .duration_ms = (uint16_t)(s_fe_state.duration_ms > 65535 ?\n                                          65535 : s_fe_state.duration_ms),\n                .condition_mask = mask,\n            };\n            decision_engine_feed_rule(&det);\n        }\n    } else {\n        if (s_fe_state.onset_time_ms != 0) {\n            s_fe_state.onset_time_ms = 0;\n            s_fe_state.duration_ms = 0;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/* ── Public: IMU feed (50Hz) ─────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nvoid rule_engine_feed_imu(const imu_sample_t *sample)\n{\n    imu_window[window_idx] = *sample;\n    window_idx = (window_idx + 1) % WINDOW_SIZE;\n    if (window_count < WINDOW_SIZE) window_count++;\n\n    if (window_idx == 0 && window_count == WINDOW_SIZE) {\n        check_head_shaking();\n        check_scratching();\n        check_prolonged_still();\n    }\n\n    s_fe_state.imu_pitch_low = check_pitch_condition();\n    s_fe_state.imu_chew_vibration = check_chew_vibration_condition();\n    evaluate_foreign_eating();\n}\n\n/* ── Public: Audio feed (~1Hz) ───────────────────────────────────── */\n\nvoid rule_engine_feed_audio(const audio_features_t *features)\n{\n    if (features->panting_score >= PANTING_SCORE_THRESHOLD) {\n        rule_detection_t det = {\n            .type = BEHAVIOR_PANTING,\n            .confidence = features->panting_score,\n            .duration_ms = 1000,\n            .condition_mask = 0,\n        };\n        decision_engine_feed_rule(&det);\n    }\n\n    s_fe_state.audio_chewing = (features->chewing_score >= FOREIGN_EAT_AUDIO_THRESH);\n    evaluate_foreign_eating();\n}\n\n/* ── Public: state accessor ──────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nconst foreign_eat_state_t *rule_engine_get_foreign_eat_state(void)\n{\n    return &s_fe_state;\n}\n\n/* ── Initialization ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nesp_err_t rule_engine_init(void)\n{\n    ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Rule engine initialized\");\n    memset(imu_window, 0, sizeof(imu_window));\n    memset(&s_fe_state, 0, sizeof(s_fe_state));\n\n    imu_register_callback(rule_engine_feed_imu);\n    audio_register_callback(rule_engine_feed_audio);\n\n    return ESP_OK;\n}\n"
}

intervention_execute(intervention_cmd_type_t cmd_type,\n                                intervention_level_t level,\n                                uint8_t audio_slot)\n{\n    ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Intervention: cmd=%d level=%d slot=%d\", cmd_type, level, audio_slot);\n\n    if (s_level3_active && level < INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH) {\n        ESP_LOGD(TAG, \"Level 3 active, ignoring lower-level request\");\n        return ESP_OK;\n    }\n\n    switch (cmd_type) {\n    case INTERVENTION_VOICE:\n        speaker_on();\n        esp_timer_start_once(s_led_off_timer, 2000 * 1000);\n        break;\n\n    case INTERVENTION_VIBRATE:\n        motor_on();\n        esp_timer_start_once(s_motor_timer,\n            (level == INTERVENTION_LEVEL_SOFT ? MOTOR_SOFT_MS : MOTOR_STRONG_MS) * 1000);\n        break;\n\n    case INTERVENTION_LED:\n        if (level == INTERVENTION_LEVEL_SOFT) led_yellow_on();\n        else led_red_on();\n        esp_timer_start_once(s_led_off_timer, 2000 * 1000);\n        break;\n\n    case INTERVENTION_COMBO:\n    default:\n        switch (level) {\n        case INTERVENTION_LEVEL_SOFT:     execute_level1(audio_slot); break;\n        case INTERVENTION_LEVEL_ENHANCED: execute_level2(audio_slot); break;\n        case INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH:     execute_level3(audio_slot); break;\n        }\n        break;\n    }\n\n    return ESP_OK;\n}\n\nvoid intervention_stop(void)\n{\n    s_level3_active = false;\n    s_level3_remaining = 0;\n\n    esp_timer_stop(s_level3_timer);\n    esp_timer_stop(s_motor_timer);\n    esp_timer_stop(s_led_timer);\n    esp_timer_stop(s_led_off_timer);\n\n    motor_off();\n    speaker_off();\n    led_red_off();\n    led_yellow_off();\n\n    ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"All interventions stopped\");\n}\n\n/* ── Initialization ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */\n\nstatic void init_gpio_output(int pin)\n{\n    gpio_config_t cfg = {\n        .pin_bit_mask = (1ULL << pin),\n        .mode = GPIO_MODE_OUTPUT,\n        .pull_up_en = GPIO_PULLUP_DISABLE,\n        .pull_down_en = GPIO_PULLDOWN_DISABLE,\n        .intr_type = GPIO_INTR_DISABLE,\n    };\n    gpio_config(&cfg);\n    gpio_set_level(pin, 0);\n}\n\nesp_err_t intervention_init(void)\n{\n    init_gpio_output(PIN_MOTOR);\n    init_gpio_output(PIN_LED_RED);\n    init_gpio_output(PIN_LED_YELLOW);\n\n    /* Speaker PWM via LEDC */\n    ledc_timer_config_t timer_cfg = {\n        .speed_mode      = LEDC_LOW_SPEED_MODE,\n        .duty_resolution = LEDC_TIMER_13_BIT,\n        .timer_num       = SPEAKER_LEDC_TIMER,\n        .freq_hz         = SPEAKER_FREQ_HZ,\n        .clk_cfg         = LEDC_AUTO_CLK,\n    };\n    ledc_timer_config(&timer_cfg);\n\n    ledc_channel_config_t ch_cfg = {\n        .speed_mode = LEDC_LOW_SPEED_MODE,\n        .channel    = SPEAKER_LEDC_CHANNEL,\n        .timer_sel  = SPEAKER_LEDC_TIMER,\n        .gpio_num   = PIN_SPEAKER,\n        .duty       = 0,\n        .hpoint     = 0,\n    };\n    ledc_channel_config(&ch_cfg);\n\n    /* Create timers */\n    const esp_timer_create_args_t motor_args  = { .callback = motor_off_cb,     .name = \"motor_off\" };\n    const esp_timer_create_args_t led_args    = { .callback = led_flash_cb,     .name = \"led_flash\" };\n    const esp_timer_create_args_t ledoff_args = { .callback = led_off_cb,       .name = \"led_off\" };\n    const esp_timer_create_args_t l3_args     = { .callback = level3_repeat_cb, .name = \"level3\" };\n\n    esp_timer_create(&motor_args,  &s_motor_timer);\n    esp_timer_create(&led_args,    &s_led_timer);\n    esp_timer_create(&ledoff_args, &s_led_off_timer);\n    esp_timer_create(&l3_args,     &s_level3_timer);\n\n    ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Intervention initialized – motor=GPIO%d speaker=GPIO%d led_r=GPIO%d led_y=GPIO%d\",\n             PIN_MOTOR, PIN_SPEAKER, PIN_LED_RED, PIN_LED_YELLOW);\n    return ESP_OK;\n}\n"
}

## 实现总结

### TuyaOpen SDK 版 (`firmware/src/`) — 新增 8 个文件

**决策引擎** `decision_engine.c/h`：

- **三级分档**：基于规则引擎传入的真实 `duration_ms` 判定干预级别
  - `≤ 2000ms` → Level 1 柔性打断
  - `2000~5000ms` → Level 2 增强打断
  - `> 5000ms` → Level 3 持续高风险
- **重复升级**：环形缓冲区记录最近 60s 内的误食事件时间戳，`≥ 2` 次自动强制 Level 3
- **条件掩码**：`event_report_t.reserved` 低字节存 `condition_mask`（bit0:低头 / bit1:震动 / bit2:音频），高字节存干预级别
- **智能冷却**：非误食行为保持 10s 冷却；误食事件由规则引擎 500ms 节流控制，不额外冷却

**干预执行器** `intervention.c/h`：

- **硬件初始化**：马达 GPIO(P6)、扬声器 PWM(D0/2kHz)、红色 LED(P8)、黄色 LED(P9)
- **Level 1**：蜂鸣 + 轻震动 500ms + 黄色 LED 闪烁 2s
- **Level 2**：蜂鸣 + 强震动 1500ms + 红色 LED 闪烁 3s
- **Level 3**：红色 LED 常亮 + 循环执行 Level 2（间隔 3s，最多 5 次）
- **防冲突**：Level 3 执行期间自动忽略低级别请求
- **`intervention_stop()`**：可随时终止所有干预动作

**依赖模块**（编译所需）：
- `event_manager.c/h` — 从 ESP-IDF 版移植的环形事件缓冲
- `ble_service.c/h` — 最小桩实现，日志输出 BLE 通知内容

### ESP-IDF 版 (`firmware/main/`) — 同步更新 6 个文件

- `rule_engine.h/c` — 新增 `condition_mask` 字段、`foreign_eat_state_t`、多条件融合（pitch + 震动方差 + 音频）
- `decision_engine.h/c` — 同步三级分档 + 重复升级逻辑
- `intervention.h/c` — 从 TODO 桩升级为完整 ESP-IDF GPIO + LEDC PWM 实现

### 数据流

```
MPU6050 50Hz ──→ rule_engine ──→ pitch角 + 震动方差 ──┐
                                                       ├── ≥2条件? ──→ decision_engine
麦克风 1Hz ───→ rule_engine ──→ chewing_score ────────┘     │
                                                            ├── duration → Level 1/2/3
                                                            ├── repeat → 强制 Level 3
                                                            ├── intervention_execute(COMBO, level)
                                                            │     ├── 马达 GPIO
                                                            │     ├── 扬声器 PWM
                                                            │     └── LED GPIO
                                                            └── event_report(reserved = level|mask)
                                                                  └── BLE Notify → App
```

{
 "path": "d:\\文档\\Cursor\\pet-collar\\firmware\\main\\decision_engine.c",
 "contents": "/**\n * Decision engine (Layer 3) - fuses rule and model outputs.\n *\n * Applies cooldown to avoid duplicate events, triggers local\n * intervention for high-risk behaviors, and queues events for BLE upload.\n *\n * Foreign-eating specific:\n * - Level 1 (Soft):     duration <= 2000ms\n * - Level 2 (Enhanced): 2000 < duration <= 5000ms\n * - Level 3 (High):     duration > 5000ms\n * - Repeat escalation:  >=2 events within 60s auto-upgrades to Level 3\n */\n\n#include \"decision_engine.h\"\n#include \"intervention.h\"\n#include \"event_manager.h\"\n#include \"ble_service.h\"\n#include \"esp_log.h\"\n#include \"esp_timer.h\"\n\nstatic const char *TAG = \"decision\";\n\n#define COOLDOWN_MS       10000  /* min interval between same-type events */\n#define CONFIDENCE_MIN    50\n\n/* Foreign-eating intervention thresholds (ms) */\n#define FE_LEVEL1_MAX_MS  2000\n#define FE_LEVEL2_MAX_MS  5000\n\n/* Foreign-eating repeat escalation */\n#define FE_REPEAT_WINDOW_MS   60000\n#define FE_REPEAT_THRESHOLD   2\n#define FE_HISTORY_SIZE       8\n\nstatic uint32_t last_event_time[8] = {0};\n\n/* Circular buffer of recent foreign-eating timestamps for repeat detection */\nstatic uint32_t fe_history[FE_HISTORY_SIZE];\nstatic int fe_history_idx = 0;\nstatic int fe_history_count = 0;\n\nstatic uint32_t now_ms(void)\n{\n    return (uint32_t)(esp_timer_get_time() / 1000);\n}\n\nstatic void fe_history_push(uint32_t ts)\n{\n    fe_history[fe_history_idx] = ts;\n    fe_history_idx = (fe_history_idx + 1) % FE_HISTORY_SIZE;\n    if (fe_history_count < FE_HISTORY_SIZE) fe_history_count++;\n}\n\nstatic int fe_recent_count(uint32_t now)\n{\n    int cnt = 0;\n    for (int i = 0; i < fe_history_count; i++) {\n        if ((now - fe_history[i]) <= FE_REPEAT_WINDOW_MS) {\n            cnt++;\n        }\n    }\n    return cnt;\n}\n\nvoid decision_engine_feed_rule(const rule_detection_t *detection)\n{\n    if (detection->confidence < CONFIDENCE_MIN) return;\n\n    uint32_t now = now_ms();\n    uint8_t idx = (uint8_t)detection->type;\n\n    if (idx < 8 && (now - last_event_time[idx]) < COOLDOWN_MS) return;\n    if (idx < 8) last_event_time[idx] = now;\n\n    ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Event: type=%d conf=%d dur=%dms mask=0x%02X\",\n             detection->type, detection->confidence,\n             detection->duration_ms, detection->condition_mask);\n\n    intervention_level_t level = INTERVENTION_LEVEL_SOFT;\n    uint8_t do_intervention = 0;\n\n    if (detection->type == BEHAVIOR_FOREIGN_EATING) {\n        do_intervention = 1;\n\n        if (detection->duration_ms > FE_LEVEL2_MAX_MS)\n            level = INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH;\n        else if (detection->duration_ms > FE_LEVEL1_MAX_MS)\n            level = INTERVENTION_LEVEL_ENHANCED;\n\n        fe_history_push(now);\n        if (fe_recent_count(now) >= FE_REPEAT_THRESHOLD && level < INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH) {\n            ESP_LOGW(TAG, \"Repeat foreign-eating in 60s -> escalate to Level 3\");\n            level = INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH;\n        }\n\n        intervention_execute(INTERVENTION_COMBO, level, 0);\n    }\n\n    event_report_t report = {\n        .packet_type = 0x01,\n        .timestamp = (uint32_t)(esp_timer_get_time() / 1000000),\n        .behavior_type = (uint8_t)detection->type,\n        .confidence = detection->confidence,\n        .duration_ms = detection->duration_ms,\n        .intervention_done = do_intervention,\n        .intervention_result = INTERVENTION_RESULT_UNKNOWN,\n        .reserved = detection->condition_mask,\n    };\n\n    event_manager_push(&report);\n    ble_send_event_report(&report);\n}\n\nesp_err_t decision_engine_init(void)\n{\n    ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Decision engine initialized (3-level + repeat escalation)\");\n    memset(fe_history, 0, sizeof(fe_history));\n    fe_history_idx = 0;\n    fe_history_count = 0;\n    return ESP_OK;\n}\n"
}

 "contents": "/**\n * Intervention executor - controls speaker, vibration motor, and RGB LED.\n *\n * Three-level intervention for foreign-eating:\n *   Level 1 (Soft):     play owner voice + light vibration 500ms + LED yellow 2s\n *   Level 2 (Enhanced): play voice + strong vibration 1500ms + LED red flash 3s\n *   Level 3 (High):     repeat Level 2 (3s interval, max 5 rounds) + LED red solid\n *\n * Hardware pin assignments are defined in pet_collar_config.h.\n * Current implementation uses ESP-IDF GPIO/timer APIs as placeholders;\n * migration to TuyaOpen tkl_gpio/tal_sw_timer is tracked separately.\n */\n\n#include \"intervention.h\"\n#include \"esp_log.h\"\n#include \"esp_timer.h\"\n#include \"driver/gpio.h\"\n#include \"freertos/FreeRTOS.h\"\n#include \"freertos/task.h\"\n\nstatic const char *TAG = \"interv\";\n\n/* Pin assignments (to be moved to pet_collar_config.h) */\n#define PIN_VIBRATION_MOTOR  GPIO_NUM_6\n#define PIN_LED_RED          GPIO_NUM_8\n#define PIN_LED_YELLOW       GPIO_NUM_9\n\nstatic void vibrate_ms(uint32_t ms)\n{\n    gpio_set_level(PIN_VIBRATION_MOTOR, 1);\n    vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(ms));\n    gpio_set_level(PIN_VIBRATION_MOTOR, 0);\n}\n\nstatic void led_flash(gpio_num_t pin, uint32_t on_ms, uint32_t off_ms, int cycles)\n{\n    for (int i = 0; i < cycles; i++) {\n        gpio_set_level(pin, 1);\n        vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(on_ms));\n        gpio_set_level(pin, 0);\n        if (i < cycles - 1) vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(off_ms));\n    }\n}\n\nstatic void execute_level1(uint8_t audio_slot)\n{\n    ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Level 1: voice(slot=%d) + vibrate 500ms + LED yellow 2s\", audio_slot);\n    /* TODO: play audio_slot via PWM/DAC speaker */\n    vibrate_ms(500);\n    led_flash(PIN_LED_YELLOW, 250, 250, 4); /* 4 cycles = 2s */\n}\n\nstatic void execute_level2(uint8_t audio_slot)\n{\n    ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Level 2: voice(slot=%d) + vibrate 1500ms + LED red flash 3s\", audio_slot);\n    /* TODO: play audio_slot via PWM/DAC speaker */\n    vibrate_ms(1500);\n    led_flash(PIN_LED_RED, 200, 200, 7); /* ~3s */\n}\n\ntypedef struct {\n    uint8_t audio_slot;\n} level3_task_arg_t;\n\nstatic void level3_task(void *arg)\n{\n    level3_task_arg_t *a = (level3_task_arg_t *)arg;\n    ESP_LOGW(TAG, \"Level 3: repeated intervention (max 5 rounds)\");\n    gpio_set_level(PIN_LED_RED, 1);\n    for (int round = 0; round < 5; round++) {\n        ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Level 3 round %d/5\", round + 1);\n        /* TODO: play audio via PWM/DAC */\n        vibrate_ms(1500);\n        vTaskDelay(pdMS_TO_TICKS(3000));\n    }\n    gpio_set_level(PIN_LED_RED, 0);\n    free(a);\n    vTaskDelete(NULL);\n}\n\nesp_err_t intervention_init(void)\n{\n    ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Intervention module init\");\n    gpio_config_t io_conf = {\n        .mode = GPIO_MODE_OUTPUT,\n        .pin_bit_mask = (1ULL << PIN_VIBRATION_MOTOR) |\n                        (1ULL << PIN_LED_RED) |\n                        (1ULL << PIN_LED_YELLOW),\n        .pull_down_en = GPIO_PULLDOWN_DISABLE,\n        .pull_up_en = GPIO_PULLUP_DISABLE,\n        .intr_type = GPIO_INTR_DISABLE,\n    };\n    gpio_config(&io_conf);\n    gpio_set_level(PIN_VIBRATION_MOTOR, 0);\n    gpio_set_level(PIN_LED_RED, 0);\n    gpio_set_level(PIN_LED_YELLOW, 0);\n    return ESP_OK;\n}\n\nesp_err_t intervention_execute(intervention_cmd_type_t cmd_type,\n                                intervention_level_t level,\n                                uint8_t audio_slot)\n{\n    ESP_LOGI(TAG, \"Intervention: cmd=%d level=%d slot=%d\", cmd_type, level, audio_slot);\n\n    switch (level) {\n        case INTERVENTION_LEVEL_SOFT:\n            execute_level1(audio_slot);\n            break;\n        case INTERVENTION_LEVEL_ENHANCED:\n            execute_level2(audio_slot);\n            break;\n        case INTERVENTION_LEVEL_HIGH: {\n            level3_task_arg_t *arg = malloc(sizeof(level3_task_arg_t));\n            if (arg) {\n                arg->audio_slot = audio_slot;\n                xTaskCreate(level3_task, \"lvl3_interv\", 2048, arg, 3, NULL);\n            }\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return ESP_OK;\n}\n"
}
